Semantic-ID methods rely on quantization, mutable identifier vocabularies, and token-to-item grounding; embedding-based pipelines train the item encoder separately from the query generator, which limits user-item alignment. We propose EGR, an Embedding-Native Generative Retrieval framework for recommendation and advertising. EGR uses a single shared LLM to learn item representations from item metadata and user representations from interaction histories in one embedding space. Items are indexed directly as dense vectors, and user histories are encoded as dense retrieval queries. Joint contrastive training groups related items and aligns queries with their target items. We evaluate EGR on public benchmarks, industrial data, and live deployment. EGR outperforms published baselines on Amazon Reviews; on Snap DPA, it scales with data, handles cold-start items, and benefits from multimodal input. In production, EGR delivers a +2.91% conversion-rate lift, simplifying system design while improving retrieval quality and ad performance.

title: Actuator-Aware Spatiotemporal Tube Synthesis for Temporal Reach-Avoid-Stay Tasks
summary: This work proposes an actuator-aware spatiotemporal tube (STT) synthesis framework to accomplish temporal reach-avoid-stay (T-RAS) tasks for an unknown nonlinear multi-input and multi-output (MIMO) system under actuator constraints. Existing STT synthesis methods address actuator saturation after the tube generation either through repeated online re-optimization or controller redesign. Instead, the proposed framework incorporates actuator constraints directly into the tube synthesis process. The STT centerline and width are parameterized using Bernstein polynomial basis functions, whose convex-hull property enables sample-free enforcement of geometric and derivative constraints. By analyzing the worst-case closed-loop error dynamics of an approximation-free prescribed performance controller (PPC) used for STT tracking, we derive a linear actuator feasibility constraint. The constraints are embedded directly in terms of the tubes' Bernstein control points into the STT synthesis optimization for actuator-feasible tube generation, eliminating the need for online re-optimization or controller redesign. A simulation study on an omnidirectional mobile robot performing a T-RAS task shows that the proposed framework adheres to the prescribed actuator limits throughout the task and reduces required control effort by approximately $50\%$ compared with an existing STT synthesis method.

title: Application-Driven Architecture Exploration for Cross-Layer Heterogeneous Systems
comments: 20 pages, 15 figures. The first five authors contributed equally. Zhenhua Zhu, Hongyang Jia, and Shuwen Deng are corresponding authors
summary: AI and HPC infrastructure increasingly serves workload portfolios that combine dense tensor computation, sparse kernels, large memory footprints, and communication-intensive collectives. Supporting these portfolios requires coordinated choices across accelerators, memory tiers, scale-up fabrics, and cluster networks. The resulting Cross-layer Heterogeneous System (XHS) design space is difficult to explore: hardware choices change legal task mappings, while rack power, switch radix, cabling, and cost constraints invalidate many candidates. We present CHASE, an application-driven framework that searches physically feasible XHS architectures through the workloads they must execute. CHASE represents candidates as hierarchical typed graphs and rejects designs that violate deployment constraints. It avoids intractable joint hardware-mapping search with a decoupled two-level loop: an inner mapper translates hardware-independent workload DAGs into topology-aware event traces, a calibrated event-driven simulator evaluates each mapping, and an outer telemetry-guided optimizer evolves the hardware graph. We evaluate CHASE on sparse-computing and LLM workloads. Its mapper remains within 6.06% of exhaustive optima while reducing mapping time by 60.5% on average relative to PEFT. Compute-model errors average 4.4-7.5%, and communication validation reproduces key trends across physical platforms. The outer search reaches near-global optima within 64 iterations. End-to-end case studies show that sparse workloads favor criticality-aware heterogeneous pods, whereas LLM inference favors scale-up islands; the resulting designs deliver 6.20$\times$ and 2.12$\times$ geomean speedups, respectively, while reducing cost and power relative to the baselines.

title: Stress-testing large language model agents in a robotic chemistry laboratory
summary: AI is evaluated through knowledge, reasoning and plan generation, yet scientific agency requires reliable physical action and adaptation to evidence. Here, we use a robotic chemistry laboratory as a physical-world testbed to make scientific agency measurable. Its 45 modular workstations exposed as machine-readable skills enabled 4,608 trials. Only 3.3% of trials produced expert-assessed executable workflows under laboratory constraints; even the best system achieved 28.1%. Long-horizon planning remained a challenge: only three executable workflows exceeded 30 operations, although the longest contained 44. Across five rounds, experimental feedback prompted local adjustments but no workflow-level replanning or analytical-method redesign. By making physical executability and evidence-driven replanning measurable, our study provides an evidence-based assessment of deployment readiness and a diagnostic framework to guide closed-loop improvements towards physically grounded autonomous research.

title: Structured Redundancy Modeling for Efficient Visual Token Pruning in High-Resolution MLLMs
summary: Recent high-resolution Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) generate thousands of visual tokens per input, leading to a visual token explosion that introduces severe latency bottlenecks. While token pruning mitigates this issue, state-of-the-art subset-optimization methods typically rely on iterative subset construction to jointly capture visual diversity and instruction relevance. As visual token counts scale, this sequential dependency introduces significant selection overhead, severely limiting the translation of theoretical FLOPs reductions into actual wall-clock speedups. To address this limitation, we propose Single-Forward Pruner (SFPruner), a structural reformulation of visual token pruning that embeds redundancy control directly into the scoring space, bypassing the need for iterative combinatorial optimization. Our non-iterative framework achieves redundancy-aware importance selection in a single forward pass through two complementary mechanisms. First, to attenuate redundancy at the covariance level, we introduce a semantics-guided ridge leverage scheme. By integrating instruction relevance and visual saliency, this mechanism suppresses dominant covariance directions and mitigates representation bias. Second, ranking-based directional masking resolves residual overlap through asymmetric similarity competition, where higher-scoring tokens explicitly suppress redundant lower-scoring alternatives via parallel tensor operations. Extensive evaluations demonstrate that our approach maintains stable selection costs, reducing the token selection process by up to 110 ms, from 112.4 ms to just 2.5 ms at 512 tokens in Qwen2.5-VL. This structural efficiency successfully translates theoretical token reductions into tangible inference speedups while preserving highly competitive performance against state-of-the-art techniques under aggressive compression.

title: MixQuant: Adaptive Mixed-Precision Quantization for Large Language Models
summary: Mixed-precision quantization improves the accuracy of post-training quantization by allocating higher bitwidths to sensitive layers, but existing methods solve the allocation for a single fixed memory budget. In practice the budget varies across deployments and is unknown at calibration time. Adaptive quantization addresses this with one offline calibration that serves any budget, yet current methods score layer sensitivity in a manner that does not consider its dependency on quantization levels of other layers. We show that a layer's sensitivity depends strongly on the bitwidths of its upstream layers and that this dependence shifts the resulting preferred bit allocation. We propose MixQuant, a technique-agnostic adaptive framework that wraps any base quantizer. MixQuant marginalizes each layer's distortion over random quantized upstream configurations to obtain budget-agnostic scores, calibrates the quantizer's parameters on plans the allocator itself produces, and penalizes allocations that leave layers at the lowest bitwidths. A single greedy pass then serves any budget at deployment. Across Llama-3.2-3B, Llama-2-7B, and Mistral-7B under AWQ and GPTQ, MixQuant outperforms adaptive and mixed-precision baselines in every setting, improving average accuracy by up to 8 points and reducing perplexity from 12.43 to 10.70 at the tightest budget, while matching an ILP solver at negligible deployment cost.

title: On the Power of Deception in Repeated Games
summary: In repeated games, opponents often predict what we'll do next by looking at what we have done so far. This allows us to deceive them: we can deliberately behave one way for a period of time to shape their expectations, then switch strategies to profit from the induced response. We study deception in repeated two-player normal-form games against count-based learners, whose behavior depends only on how often we have played each action in the past. We formalize deceptive and non-deceptive play, and introduce the notion of a deception bonus, the payoff gain of the best deceptive strategy over the best fixed mixed strategy. We establish structural results on deception in general-sum games. We design exact dynamic programs for optimizing against any count-based learner when the action space or opponent's memory is small, and develop approximation algorithms for settings where the opponent's memory or the time horizon is large. We also provide an approximation algorithm for learning to deceive an opponent whose count-based learning rule is unknown. To complement our algorithmic results, we show that approximating the optimal deceptive payoff against the classic Empirical Risk Minimization (ERM) learning rule is NP-hard, including obtaining any constant-factor approximation or even a $T^α$-additive approximation for any $0 < α< 1$. Finally, we empirically measure the deception bonus in random games with i.i.d. payoffs.

title: The Entropic Bound for Transformers: Why Static Rank Fails and Attention-Native Rank Recovers
comments: 11 pages, 1 figure, 5 tables. Code and reproduction scripts included as supplementary material
summary: Neural scaling laws describe how loss decreases as models, data, and compute grow, but they do not answer a prior question: for a fixed task, what is the minimum model capacity required to solve it? We study this through the Entropic Bound, a spectral notion of task-intrinsic capacity for Transformers. We first prove that, in a linear attention surrogate, the intrinsic rank $r^*$ of the token-mixing operator is a tight lower bound: any rank-deficient model incurs unavoidable excess risk, and the bound is achievable at $r^*$. We further show that gradient descent recovers this rank under standard low-rank implicit-bias assumptions, confirm all three properties empirically, and show $r^*$ is recoverable from data before training. We then ask whether this transfers to real attention. A naive transfer fails, and a controlled interpolation ladder localizes the cause precisely: it is not softmax and not a rank constraint, but the input-conditioned nature of attention's mixing operator, which a static weight kernel cannot summarize. Motivated by this, we introduce an attention-native intrinsic rank -- the minimum query-key kernel rank realizing the task within the attention class -- and show that under this definition the full Entropic Bound structure (deficiency, achievability, recovery) is restored for both linear and softmax attention, with the energy effective rank as the estimator robust to softmax distortion. Finally, we map the boundary of data-only predictability: $r^*$ is exactly recoverable for linear QK attention, even without the value map at scale, while softmax attention admits only partial pre-training recovery due to nonlinear inversion and kernel-value identifiability effects. Our results reframe the Entropic Bound from a post-hoc descriptor into an attention-native capacity measure with a precisely characterized predictability frontier.

title: Similarity Is Not Logic: Factored Inference for Dual-Encoder Vision-Language Models
comments: Accepted at ICML 2026. 18 pages, 8 figures. Project page: https://sultanmo.github.io/factored-vlm Code and benchmark: https://github.com/SultanMo/factored-vlm
summary: Dual-encoder vision-language models (VLMs) expose a similarity interface that enables zero-shot retrieval but fails compositional constraints: queries like "umbrella and no person" retrieve images containing both, even when concept detection is reliable. We trace this to an interface-level Bag-of-Concepts effect, where similarity scores approximate mean pooling of concept evidence regardless of operators. Although operator-dependent signals exist in text embeddings, they are too weak or misaligned to affect rankings. Fine-tuning does not reliably resolve this failure because the dominant bottleneck is how similarity aggregates evidence rather than what encoders represent. We propose factored inference, which separates evidence extraction from constraint execution, and introduce LCSE (Logic-Constrained Score Editing), a training-free method that executes constraints externally using concept scores from frozen encoders. We also introduce FACTOR-Bench, where LCSE achieves 85.5% accuracy versus 73.2% for the best fine-tuned baseline, 90.7% when applied to SigLIP 2, and improves NegBench COCO MCQ accuracy from 27.2% to 65.2% while preserving retrieval performance.
comment: Accepted at ICML 2026. 18 pages, 8 figures. Project page: https://sultanmo.github.io/factored-vlm Code and benchmark: https://github.com/SultanMo/factored-vlm

title: Through the Bottleneck: How Multi-head Latent Attention Separates Content from Position in Language Models
summary: Multi-head Latent Attention (MLA), introduced in DeepSeek-V2, compresses key-value pairs through a shared low-rank bottleneck (cKV), achieving 81% KV-cache reduction during inference. Despite its adoption in massive production models, no prior work has studied what information this bottleneck preserves or discards, nor how it reshapes internal transformer circuits. We present the first comprehensive mechanistic interpretability study of MLA, training a 114M-parameter transformer (pretrained on a web/code/math mixture, fine-tuned on TinyStories) and analyzing its representations through SVD, attention head taxonomy, linear probing, and a disruption-attribution analysis. Our key findings are: (1) the cKV bottleneck learns a pure content representation, preserving entity identity (98% retention) while discarding positional information, validating MLA's separation of content from position via RoPE; (2) induction heads co-locate at a single layer (Layer 12), unlike their distributed formation in standard MHA; (3) a single "semantic hub" layer (Layer 15) simultaneously exhibits the highest SVD effective rank and strongest disruption-attribution score; and (4) the bottleneck is globally over-provisioned, using only 46% of its capacity on average. These findings suggest MLA does not merely compress attention passively, but reshapes how the model organizes content, position, and circuit structure. We view this as an initial data point and detail scope limitations in Section 5.

AI.title_translation: 穿过瓶颈：多头潜注意力机制如何在语言模型中实现内容与位置的分离
AI.tldr: 本文对DeepSeek-V2的MLA机制进行了首次可解释性研究，发现低秩瓶颈能纯化内容表示并丢弃位置信息，同时重塑了模型内部的线路结构。
AI.motivation: 尽管MLA（多头潜注意力）在DeepSeek-V2等大型生产模型中被广泛应用并实现了高达81%的KV缓存削减，但此前尚无研究探讨其低秩瓶颈（cKV）究竟保留或丢弃了哪些信息，以及它如何改变Transformer模型的内部电路结构。
AI.method: 训练了一个1.14亿参数的Transformer模型（在Web/代码/数学混合数据集上预训练，并在TinyStories上微调），并运用奇异值分解（SVD）、注意力头分类、线性探测（Linear Probing）以及破坏-归因分析（Disruption-Attribution Analysis）对其内部表示进行机制可解释性研究。
AI.result: 1) cKV瓶颈学习到了纯内容表示，保留了98%的实体身份信息并丢弃了位置信息，验证了其通过RoPE分离内容与位置的能力；2) 归纳头（induction heads）高度集中于单一层（第12层）；3) 存在单一“语义枢纽”层（第15层），同时具备最高的SVD有效秩和最强的破坏-归因得分；4) 瓶颈存在全局过度供给现象，平均仅使用了46%的容量。
AI.conclusion: MLA不仅是被动地压缩键值缓存，更深刻地重塑了语言模型组织内容、位置以及内部线路结构的方式。
AI.translation: DeepSeek-V2中引入的多头潜注意力（MLA）通过共享低秩瓶颈（cKV）压缩键值对，在推理期间实现了81%的KV缓存减少。尽管它已在大型生产模型中得到采用，但此前尚无工作研究该瓶颈保留或丢弃了哪些信息，以及它如何重塑Transformer内部线路。本文提出了针对MLA的首次全面机制可解释性研究，训练了一个1.14亿参数的Transformer（在Web/代码/数学混合数据集上预训练，并在TinyStories上微调），并通过SVD、注意力头分类、线性探测和破坏-归因分析对其表示进行了分析。我们的主要发现包括：(1) cKV瓶颈学习到了纯内容表示，在保留实体身份（保持率98%）的同时丢弃了位置信息，验证了MLA通过RoPE实现内容与位置分离的设计；(2) 归纳头集中在单一层（第12层），这与标准MHA中的分散分布不同；(3) 单一的“语义枢纽”层（第15层）同时表现出最高的SVD有效秩和最强的破坏-归因得分；(4) 瓶颈在全局上是过度供给的，平均仅使用了46%的容量。这些发现表明，MLA不仅被动地压缩注意力，还重塑了模型组织内容、位置和线路结构的方式。我们将此视为一个初步的数据点，并在第5节详细介绍了适用范围的局限性。
AI.summary: 本文对DeepSeek-V2中引入的多头潜注意力（MLA）进行了首次全面的机制可解释性研究。通过分析1.14亿参数模型的内部表示，研究发现MLA的低秩瓶颈能有效分离内容与位置信息，保留实体特征的同时丢弃位置特征。同时，MLA改变了模型线路的组织方式（如归纳头向单层集中、出现语义枢纽层），且瓶颈容量存在明显的过度供给。
AI.keywords: 多头潜注意力, DeepSeek-V2, 机制可解释性, 内容与位置分离, 低秩瓶颈
AI.comments: 本文的创新之处在于首次从机制可解释性角度对DeepSeek-V2的核心组件——多头潜注意力（MLA）进行了深入剖析。研究不仅验证了MLA成功实现内容与位置分离的设计初衷，还揭示了低秩压缩对模型内部线路（如归纳头集中化、语义枢纽层）的深刻影响，为注意力机制的压缩与架构设计提供了重要理论启示。局限在于实验主要基于1.14亿参数的小模型，其结论在超大规模模型上的通用性仍待验证。

title: SymStep: Symbolic Step Verification for Logical Reasoning
summary: Chain-of-thought (CoT) prompting can fail severely on constraint-dense logical reasoning tasks, where unverified errors accumulate silently across steps. We introduce SymStep: an LLM makes one atomic claim at a time (DEDUCE: Alice, pet, Cat), then a lightweight constraint propagator checks the claim for consistency with prior accepted deductions, rejects contradictions, and cascades implied facts automatically. SymStep+G additionally provides MRV guidance after each accepted step, directing the LLM toward the most constrained unresolved variable. On a 35-puzzle retained subset of ZebraLogicBench, a benchmark of 1,000 Einstein-style logic puzzles, Direct and CoT both achieve 0%, while SymStep+G reaches 97%. On AR-LSAT analytical reasoning problems, SymStep achieves 100% vs. CoT's 87%. On LGP-14, SymStep+G achieves 100% vs. 0% for CoT and Logic-LM, the strongest prior symbolic+LLM baseline we compare against. Ablation studies reveal that MRV guidance is a key mechanism for reducing directionless cycling, while consistency checking provides a safety net against explicit contradictions. Across six benchmarks spanning five task domains, SymStep variants match or exceed every baseline on constraint-dense and arithmetic tasks. Experiments on AQUA-RAT algebra confirm the advantage is constraint-density-specific.

AI.title_translation: SymStep：逻辑推理的符号步骤验证
AI.tldr: SymStep是一个结合LLM和符号验证的系统，通过逐步验证和约束传播解决了CoT在复杂逻辑推理中错误积累的问题，在多个基准测试中显著超越了现有方法。
AI.motivation: 链式思考（CoT）提示在约束密集型逻辑推理任务中表现不佳，因为未经验证的错误会在步骤中无声积累。
AI.method: SymStep让大型语言模型（LLM）一次只提出一个原子声明，然后一个轻量级约束传播器检查该声明与先前接受的推论的一致性，拒绝矛盾，并自动级联隐含事实。SymStep+G额外在每个接受的步骤后提供MRV（Most Constrained Variable）指导，将LLM引导至约束最多的未解决变量。
AI.result: 在ZebraLogicBench的35个谜题子集上，SymStep+G达到97%，而Direct和CoT均为0%。在AR-LSAT分析推理问题上，SymStep达到100%，CoT为87%。在LGP-14上，SymStep+G达到100%，CoT和Logic-LM为0%。MRV指导是减少无方向循环的关键机制，一致性检查提供了防止显式矛盾的安全网。SymStep变体在约束密集型和算术任务上匹配或超越所有基线，且优势是约束密度特异性的。
AI.conclusion: SymStep及其变体通过结合LLM的生成能力与符号验证及指导机制，显著提高了LLM在约束密集型逻辑推理任务上的性能，有效解决了CoT提示中错误积累和方向性不足的问题。
AI.translation: 链式思考（CoT）提示在约束密集型逻辑推理任务中可能会严重失败，因为未经验证的错误会在步骤中无声地积累。我们引入了SymStep：一个大型语言模型（LLM）一次只提出一个原子声明（推断：爱丽丝，宠物，猫），然后一个轻量级约束传播器检查该声明与先前接受的推论的一致性，拒绝矛盾，并自动级联隐含事实。SymStep+G额外在每个接受的步骤后提供MRV（Most Constrained Variable）指导，将LLM引导至约束最多的未解决变量。在ZebraLogicBench（一个包含1000个爱因斯坦式逻辑谜题的基准测试）的35个谜题保留子集上，Direct和CoT均达到0%，而SymStep+G达到97%。在AR-LSAT分析推理问题上，SymStep达到100%，而CoT为87%。在LGP-14上，SymStep+G达到100%，而CoT和Logic-LM（我们比较的最强先前的符号+LLM基线）均为0%。消融研究表明，MRV指导是减少无方向循环的关键机制，而一致性检查提供了防止显式矛盾的安全网。在跨越五个任务领域的六个基准测试中，SymStep变体在约束密集型和算术任务上匹配或超越了所有基线。AQUA-RAT代数实验证实这种优势是针对约束密度的。
AI.summary: 本文介绍了SymStep，一个结合大型语言模型（LLM）和符号验证的系统，旨在解决链式思考（CoT）在约束密集型逻辑推理任务中错误积累的问题。SymStep通过让LLM逐步提出原子声明，并利用轻量级约束传播器进行一致性检查和事实级联。其增强版SymStep+G进一步引入了MRV指导，以引导LLM解决最受约束的变量。实验结果表明，SymStep在ZebraLogicBench、AR-LSAT和LGP-14等多个逻辑推理基准测试中取得了显著优于CoT和其他基线的性能提升，证明了符号步骤验证和MRV指导在提高LLM逻辑推理准确性方面的有效性。
AI.keywords: 符号推理, 大型语言模型, 逻辑验证, 链式思考, 约束传播
AI.comments: SymStep的创新之处在于它有效地结合了LLM的语言理解和生成能力与符号推理的严谨性，通过精细的步骤验证和智能的搜索指导（MRV）克服了CoT在复杂逻辑问题上的固有缺陷。这种混合方法为LLM在需要高精度和可解释性的推理任务中的应用开辟了新途径，尤其是在处理约束密集型问题时表现出强大的潜力。

title: ADAGE: A Language-Agnostic Pipeline for Analogical Reasoning Evaluation
summary: Multilingual reasoning evaluation overwhelmingly relies on translating English benchmarks, a practice that introduces linguistic artifacts and fails to test culturally-grounded reasoning. We introduce ADAGE (Analogical Difficulty-by-design Assessment for Grounded Evaluation), a language-agnostic pipeline that combines native-speaker curation with LLM-assisted generation to construct challenging, translation-free benchmarks for abstract analogical reasoning. We validate ADAGE by constructing benchmarks for Arabic, Amharic, and Japanese. Evaluating 14 open-weight models, we find a consistent cultural reasoning gap: models that perform well on English proverb reasoning struggle substantially on all three native benchmarks, with accuracy dropping by 12--52 percentage points relative to English. We release the pipeline, all three benchmarks, and the full evaluation suite.

AI.title_translation: ADAGE：一种语言无关的类比推理评估流程
AI.tldr: ADAGE是一个语言无关的流程，用于构建抽象类比推理的翻译无关基准，发现LLM在非英语文化推理上存在显著差距。
AI.motivation: 现有多语言推理评估过度依赖翻译英文基准，这种做法引入了语言伪影，并且未能测试文化接地的推理。
AI.method: ADAGE（Analogical Difficulty-by-design Assessment for Grounded Evaluation）是一个语言无关的流程，它结合了母语使用者策展和LLM辅助生成，以构建具有挑战性的、无翻译的抽象类比推理基准。
AI.result: 通过对阿拉伯语、阿姆哈拉语和日语的基准构建和14个开源模型的评估，发现存在一致的文化推理差距：在英语谚语推理中表现良好的模型在所有三个原生基准上表现显著挣扎，准确率相对英语下降12-52个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 论文发现模型在非英语文化接地推理方面存在显著且一致的文化推理差距，表明现有模型在处理不同文化背景下的抽象类比推理时存在局限性。
AI.translation: 多语言推理评估绝大多数依赖于翻译英语基准，这种做法引入了语言伪影，并且未能测试文化接地的推理。我们引入了ADAGE（Analogical Difficulty-by-design Assessment for Grounded Evaluation），一个语言无关的流程，它结合了母语使用者策展和LLM辅助生成，以构建具有挑战性的、无翻译的抽象类比推理基准。我们通过为阿拉伯语、阿姆哈拉语和日语构建基准来验证ADAGE。评估了14个开源模型后，我们发现了一个一致的文化推理差距：在英语谚语推理中表现良好的模型在所有三个原生基准上表现显著挣扎，准确率相对英语下降12-52个百分点。我们发布了该流程、所有三个基准和完整的评估套件。
AI.summary: 本文介绍了ADAGE，一个语言无关的流程，旨在通过结合母语使用者策展和LLM辅助生成，为抽象类比推理构建无翻译的、具有挑战性的基准，以解决现有评估对英语基准翻译的过度依赖问题。通过在阿拉伯语、阿姆哈拉语和日语上构建基准并评估14个开源模型，研究发现模型在不同文化背景下的推理能力存在显著差距，表明当前模型在文化接地推理方面表现不佳。
AI.keywords: 类比推理, 语言无关, 文化推理差距, LLM评估, 基准构建
AI.comments: ADAGE的创新之处在于其语言无关的基准构建方法，有效避免了翻译引入的语言伪影和文化偏见。该研究揭示了大型语言模型在文化接地推理方面的显著局限性，对未来多语言和跨文化AI推理能力的研究具有重要指导意义。

title: GLST: Defending Confidence-Driven V2X Collaborative Perception Against Stealthy Multi-Attacker Feature Injection
summary: Collaborative perception (CP) improves autonomous-driving perception by enabling connected vehicles to exchange intermediate features via V2X. Confidence-driven sparse communication reduces bandwidth by transmitting only perception-critical spatial regions, but creates a security risk: once a collaborator is compromised, malicious features in high-confidence or ego-uncertain regions may be preferentially selected and amplified during fusion. Using Where2comm as a representative framework, we show that the proposed Pretend Benign attack exploits its spatial-confidence mechanism by injecting stealthy perturbations into uncertain yet perception-critical regions, substantially degrading 3D object detection while preserving benign-like feature characteristics. Beyond this attack-framework pair, we identify a broader weakness of existing trust-based defenses: their reliance primarily on a single consistency signal leaves them vulnerable when multiple attackers form a pseudo-consensus that biases trust estimation. We therefore propose Global-Local Structural Trust (GLST), a lightweight defense that assesses collaborator reliability through three complementary perspectives: global feature consistency, multi-scale local residual consistency, and structural consistency with ego-side semantic topology. The resulting trust scores guide feature fusion to suppress unreliable collaborators. Experiments on OPV2V show that GLST achieves competitive performance against single-attacker Pretend Benign attacks and substantially stronger robustness in multi-attacker settings. Under a four-attacker Pretend Benign attack, GLST maintains 0.69 AP@0.3, whereas existing single-signal defenses degrade severely. GLST also remains effective against gradient-based attacks such as PGD, indicating that multi-level trust modeling is essential for securing confidence-driven CP.

AI.title_translation: GLST：防御针对信心驱动V2X协同感知的隐蔽多攻击者特征注入
AI.tldr: 信心驱动的V2X协同感知容易受到隐蔽的多攻击者特征注入攻击。GLST是一种新的防御方法，通过多级信任评估来抑制不可靠的协作方，优于现有防御，尤其在多攻击者设置下表现更强。
AI.motivation: 信心驱动的稀疏通信协同感知存在安全风险，恶意特征可能在高置信度或自我不确定区域被优先选择和放大。现有基于信任的防御主要依赖单一一致性信号，在多攻击者形成伪共识时容易失效。
AI.method: 提出了一种名为全局-局部结构信任（GLST）的轻量级防御方法。它通过三个互补的视角评估协作方的可靠性：全局特征一致性、多尺度局部残差一致性以及与自我侧语义拓扑的结构一致性。生成的信任分数用于指导特征融合，以抑制不可靠的协作方。
AI.result: GLST在单攻击者“假装良性”攻击下表现出具有竞争力的性能，并在多攻击者设置下展现出显著更强的鲁棒性。在四攻击者“假装良性”攻击下，GLST保持0.69 AP@0.3，而现有单一信号防御严重退化。GLST对PGD等基于梯度的攻击也有效。
AI.conclusion: 多级信任建模对于保护信心驱动的协同感知至关重要，GLST在对抗单攻击者和多攻击者隐蔽注入以及基于梯度的攻击方面的有效性证明了这一点。
AI.translation: 协同感知（CP）通过使联网车辆通过V2X交换中间特征来改善自动驾驶感知。信心驱动的稀疏通信通过仅传输感知关键的空间区域来减少带宽，但这也带来了安全风险：一旦协作方被攻破，高置信度或自我不确定区域中的恶意特征可能在融合过程中被优先选择和放大。我们以Where2comm作为一个代表性框架，展示了所提出的“假装良性”攻击如何利用其空间置信机制，通过向不确定但感知关键的区域注入隐蔽扰动，显著降低3D目标检测性能，同时保留类似良性特征的特性。除了这种攻击-框架配对，我们还识别出现有基于信任防御的一个更广泛的弱点：它们主要依赖单一一致性信号，使得当多个攻击者形成偏向信任估计的伪共识时，它们变得脆弱。因此，我们提出了全局-局部结构信任（GLST），这是一种轻量级防御，通过三个互补的视角评估协作方的可靠性：全局特征一致性、多尺度局部残差一致性以及与自我侧语义拓扑的结构一致性。由此产生的信任分数指导特征融合，以抑制不可靠的协作方。在OPV2V上的实验表明，GLST在对抗单攻击者“假装良性”攻击时取得了具有竞争力的性能，并在多攻击者设置中展现出显著更强的鲁棒性。在四攻击者“假装良性”攻击下，GLST保持0.69 AP@0.3，而现有单一信号防御严重退化。GLST对PGD等基于梯度的攻击也保持有效，这表明多级信任建模对于保护信心驱动的CP至关重要。
AI.summary: 本研究探讨了信心驱动V2X协同感知在面对隐蔽特征注入攻击时的脆弱性，特别是在多攻击者场景下现有单一信号防御的局限性。为此，提出了GLST（全局-局部结构信任）防御机制，它通过结合全局特征、多尺度局部残差和语义拓扑结构的一致性来评估协作方信任。实验证明，GLST在单攻击者和多攻击者攻击下均表现出卓越的鲁棒性，显著优于现有方法，强调了多级信任建模对保障协同感知安全的重要性。
AI.keywords: V2X协同感知, 安全, 特征注入, 多攻击者, 信任防御, GLST
AI.comments: 这篇论文解决了信心驱动V2X协同感知中的一个关键安全漏洞，这对于自动驾驶越来越重要。“假装良性”攻击通过针对不确定但关键的区域，突出了一种新颖而隐蔽的威胁。所提出的GLST防御创新性地超越了单一信号信任机制，采用了多级方法，这对于抵御复杂的多攻击者协同攻击至关重要。其对隐蔽攻击和基于梯度的攻击都有效，突显了其多方面信任建模的强大之处。

title: Touching or Chatting: The Utility of LLMs and Tactile Charts for Learning about Complex Chart Types by BLV Individuals
summary: Visualizations are central to communicating data, yet blind and low-vision (BLV) people often lack support for understanding chart types---knowledge that is essential for interpreting new visualizations and collaborating with sighted peers. Prior work found that BLV individuals viewed example tactile charts as more helpful than text-only approaches and preferred them for learning advanced chart types, particularly for understanding spatial layouts and shapes. Meanwhile, large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used by BLV individuals for chart explanation and question answering (QA), but have been studied primarily for dataset exploration rather than chart-type learning. Existing LLM-based chart QA also shows that users frequently ask about layout and structure, yet struggle with spatial concepts and misdirect questions when mental models are weak. We investigate how LLMs influence chart-type learning and whether tactile learning improves subsequent LLM-supported exploration. We extend our tactile chart learning tools with an LLM chatbot that provides interactive explanations and supports follow-up questions. In an interview study with 12 BLV participants, we compare two learning formats: (1) a tactile chart, a textual explanation, and an LLM chatbot; and (2) a textual explanation and an LLM chatbot. The learning phase was followed by exploration of an unfamiliar dataset using alt text and an LLM. Thematic analysis shows that tactile templates support BLV participants' formation of chart-type mental models, which scaffolds subsequent LLM-mediated data exploration. Text+LLM explanations without tactile support show weaknesses for spatial-reasoning tasks.

AI.title_translation: 触摸还是聊天：LLM和触觉图表在盲人和低视力个体学习复杂图表类型中的效用
AI.tldr: 对于盲人和低视力（BLV）个体，结合触觉图表和大型语言模型（LLM）能更有效地学习复杂的图表类型，特别是在空间理解方面，这反过来又能改善LLM支持的数据探索。
AI.motivation: 盲人和低视力（BLV）人群在理解图表类型方面缺乏支持，这对于解释新可视化和与有视力同伴协作至关重要。现有研究发现触觉图表对学习高级图表类型有帮助，而大型语言模型（LLMs）虽用于图表解释，但主要针对数据集探索而非图表类型学习。当前的LLM图表问答在空间概念理解上存在弱点，尤其当心理模型不完善时。本研究旨在调查LLMs如何影响图表类型学习，以及触觉学习是否能改善后续的LLM支持探索。
AI.method: 研究扩展了触觉图表学习工具，并加入了一个提供交互式解释和支持后续问题的LLM聊天机器人。通过对12名BLV参与者进行访谈研究，比较了两种学习形式：（1）触觉图表、文本解释和LLM聊天机器人；以及（2）文本解释和LLM聊天机器人。学习阶段之后，参与者使用替代文本和LLM探索一个不熟悉的数据集。最后采用主题分析法对结果进行分析。
AI.result: 主题分析表明，触觉模板支持BLV参与者形成图表类型的心理模型，这为随后的LLM介导的数据探索提供了支架。缺乏触觉支持的文本+LLM解释在空间推理任务中表现出弱点。
AI.conclusion: 结合触觉图表和LLMs对BLV个体学习复杂图表类型（特别是空间理解）大有裨益，并能改善后续LLM支持的数据探索。对于纯文本+LLM解释难以处理的空间推理任务，触觉支持至关重要。
AI.translation: 可视化是数据交流的核心，但盲人和低视力（BLV）人群通常缺乏理解图表类型的支持——而这些知识对于解释新可视化和与有视力同伴协作至关重要。先前的研究发现，BLV个体认为触觉图表示例比纯文本方法更有帮助，并且更喜欢它们来学习高级图表类型，特别是理解空间布局和形状。同时，大型语言模型（LLMs）正越来越多地被BLV个体用于图表解释和问答（QA），但主要研究集中在数据集探索而非图表类型学习。现有的基于LLM的图表QA也表明，用户经常询问布局和结构，但在心理模型薄弱时，难以理解空间概念并错误地提出问题。我们调查了LLMs如何影响图表类型学习，以及触觉学习是否改善了随后的LLM支持的探索。我们通过一个提供交互式解释和支持后续问题的LLM聊天机器人扩展了我们的触觉图表学习工具。在对12名BLV参与者进行的访谈研究中，我们比较了两种学习形式：（1）触觉图表、文本解释和LLM聊天机器人；以及（2）文本解释和LLM聊天机器人。学习阶段之后是使用替代文本和LLM探索一个不熟悉的数据集。主题分析表明，触觉模板支持BLV参与者形成图表类型的心理模型，这为随后的LLM介导的数据探索提供了支架。缺乏触觉支持的文本+LLM解释在空间推理任务中表现出弱点。
AI.summary: 本文探讨了结合大型语言模型（LLMs）和触觉图表对于盲人和低视力（BLV）个体学习复杂图表类型的效用。通过对12名BLV参与者进行访谈研究，比较了有无触觉支持与LLM结合的学习方式，结果表明触觉模板显著帮助参与者形成图表类型的心理模型，进而增强了LLM支持下的数据探索。研究发现，纯文本加LLM的解释方式在空间推理任务中效果较差。
AI.keywords: BLV个体, 触觉图表, 大型语言模型 (LLMs), 图表类型学习, 可访问性
AI.comments: 这篇论文揭示了BLV个体在数据可视化可访问性方面的一个重要空白。触觉反馈与LLM能力的结合提供了一种有前景的混合方法。研究发现触觉支持对于形成空间心理模型至关重要，进而为LLM交互提供了支架，这是一个关键见解。这表明LLM单独可能不足以进行某些类型的概念学习，特别是那些需要空间理解的学习。这项工作对设计更有效的数据素养辅助技术具有重要意义。

title: Attention-Guided Layer Selection for Contrastive Decoding in Large Language Models
summary: Contrastive decoding methods such as DoLa improve the factuality of Large Language Models (LLMs) by contrasting the output distributions of mature and premature layers. However, DoLa's dynamic layer selection relies solely on divergences in output vocabulary distributions. In this work, we propose three attention-guided strategies: Attention-JSD, Attention-Entropy-Max, and Attention-Entropy-Min, which leverage structural information carried by internal self-attention mechanisms as a signal for layer selection. Experimental results on TruthfulQA demonstrate that our strategies, particularly Attention-JSD and Attention-Entropy-Min, consistently outperform the original DoLa. We observe significant gains on multi-answer metrics (MC2 and MC3), suggesting that attention distributions can provide a more sensitive signal for resolving factual knowledge than output vocabulary distributions.

AI.title_translation: 大型语言模型对比解码中的注意力引导层选择
AI.tldr: 本文提出注意力引导策略，利用自注意力机制的结构信息改进大型语言模型对比解码中的层选择，实验证明其在提高LLM事实性方面优于现有方法DoLa。
AI.motivation: 现有对比解码方法（如DoLa）在层选择时仅依赖输出词汇分布的差异，未能利用内部自注意力机制携带的结构信息，导致在提升LLM事实性方面可能不够敏感。
AI.method: 提出三种注意力引导策略：Attention-JSD、Attention-Entropy-Max和Attention-Entropy-Min。这些策略利用内部自注意力机制携带的结构信息作为层选择的信号。
AI.result: 在TruthfulQA上的实验结果表明，所提出的策略，特别是Attention-JSD和Attention-Entropy-Min，始终优于原始的DoLa。在多答案指标（MC2和MC3）上观察到显著增益。
AI.conclusion: 注意力分布可以为解决事实知识提供比输出词汇分布更敏感的信号，从而有效提升大型语言模型的事实性。
AI.translation: 对比解码方法，例如DoLa，通过对比成熟层和未成熟层的输出分布来提高大型语言模型（LLM）的事实性。然而，DoLa的动态层选择仅依赖于输出词汇分布的差异。在这项工作中，我们提出了三种注意力引导策略：Attention-JSD、Attention-Entropy-Max和Attention-Entropy-Min，它们利用内部自注意力机制携带的结构信息作为层选择的信号。在TruthfulQA上的实验结果表明，我们的策略，特别是Attention-JSD和Attention-Entropy-Min，始终优于原始的DoLa。我们在多答案指标（MC2和MC3）上观察到显著增益，这表明注意力分布可以为解决事实知识提供比输出词汇分布更敏感的信号。
AI.summary: 本文提出三种注意力引导策略（Attention-JSD、Attention-Entropy-Max和Attention-Entropy-Min），以改进大型语言模型对比解码中的层选择，克服了DoLa仅依赖输出词汇分布的局限性。通过利用内部自注意力机制的结构信息，这些策略在TruthfulQA数据集上显著提升了LLM的事实性，证明注意力分布在分辨事实知识方面更为有效。
AI.keywords: 对比解码, 大型语言模型, 注意力引导, 层选择, 事实性
AI.comments: 这项工作通过引入注意力机制的结构信息来改进对比解码中的层选择，提供了一种新颖且有效的提升LLM事实性的方法。其创新之处在于将注意力分布作为更敏感的信号，解决了现有方法仅依赖词汇分布的局限性。

title: Geometry-aware LegONet for PDE Learning on Arbitrary Domains
summary: Learned PDE solvers often entangle governing operators with the geometry, boundary conditions, and discretization used for training. This limits reuse when the same physics is posed on new domains, and it also makes physical-law discovery geometry-dependent. We introduce Geometry-aware LegONet (gLegONet), a boundary-manifold extension of Lego-like operator learning. Physical mechanisms are pretrained once as modular variational blocks on an ambient spectral domain. For a target geometry, sampled boundary constraints define an affine admissible manifold. Its mass-orthonormal tangent coordinates are used to evolve the dynamics and evaluate candidate law-discovery features directly. Changing the domain therefore changes only an algebraic coordinate interface, not the learned operator blocks. This converts arbitrary-domain PDE learning from geometry-specific retraining or soft penalty enforcement into boundary-guaranteed assembly of reusable mechanisms. In forward simulations and sparse identification tests on unseen domains, the method maintains boundary residuals near the algebraic tolerance and yields predictive governing laws from short-time observations.

AI.title_translation: 几何感知LegONet用于任意域上的偏微分方程学习
AI.tldr: gLegONet是一种新的PDE求解器，它将物理机制与几何解耦，通过预训练模块化变分块和使用质量正交切线坐标来处理任意域，从而实现可重用机制的边界保证组装。
AI.motivation: 现有的学习型PDE求解器通常将控制算子与几何、边界条件和离散化纠缠在一起，这限制了在不同域上重用相同物理模型的能力，并使物理定律的发现依赖于几何。
AI.method: 本文引入了几何感知LegONet (gLegONet)，它是Lego式算子学习的边界流形扩展。物理机制作为模块化变分块在环境谱域上进行一次预训练。对于目标几何，采样的边界约束定义了一个仿射可允许流形。其质量正交切线坐标用于直接演化动力学和评估候选定律发现特征。因此，改变域仅改变代数坐标接口，而不改变学习到的算子块。
AI.result: 在对未见域进行正向模拟和稀疏识别测试中，该方法将边界残差保持在接近代数容差的水平，并能从短时间观测中得出预测性的控制定律。
AI.conclusion: gLegONet将任意域上的PDE学习从几何特定的再训练或软惩罚强制转换为可重用机制的边界保证组装，显著提高了学习型PDE求解器的通用性和效率。
AI.translation: 学习型偏微分方程（PDE）求解器通常将控制算子与用于训练的几何、边界条件和离散化纠缠在一起。当在新的域上提出相同的物理问题时，这限制了重用，并且也使得物理定律的发现依赖于几何。我们引入了几何感知LegONet (gLegONet)，它是Lego式算子学习的边界流形扩展。物理机制作为模块化变分块在环境谱域上进行一次预训练。对于目标几何，采样的边界约束定义了一个仿射可允许流形。其质量正交切线坐标用于直接演化动力学并直接评估候选定律发现特征。因此，改变域仅改变代数坐标接口，而不改变学习到的算子块。这将任意域上的PDE学习从几何特定的再训练或软惩罚强制转换为可重用机制的边界保证组装。在对未见域进行正向模拟和稀疏识别测试中，该方法将边界残差保持在接近代数容差的水平，并能从短时间观测中得出预测性的控制定律。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种名为Geometry-aware LegONet (gLegONet) 的新型框架，旨在解决学习型PDE求解器中物理算子与几何形状、边界条件和离散化之间的耦合问题。gLegONet通过在环境谱域上预训练模块化变分块来解耦物理机制，并利用目标几何的边界约束定义的仿射可允许流形的质量正交切线坐标来演化动力学和发现物理定律。这种方法使得改变计算域仅需调整代数坐标接口，而无需重新训练学习到的算子块，从而将任意域上的PDE学习转化为可重用机制的边界保证组装。实验结果表明，gLegONet在未见域上的正向模拟和稀疏识别测试中表现出色，边界残差接近代数容差，并能从短时观测中推断出预测性控制定律。
AI.keywords: PDE学习, 几何感知, 算子学习, LegONet, 任意域
AI.comments: 这项工作的创新之处在于它成功地将PDE求解器中的物理机制与几何形状解耦，通过引入模块化的变分块和几何感知的坐标转换，大大提高了模型在不同几何域上的泛化能力和可重用性。这对于加速物理定律发现和构建更通用的PDE求解器具有重要意义。其核心思想是将几何依赖性从学习到的算子中分离出来，使其成为一个可插拔的接口，这在当前机器学习应用于科学计算的背景下是一个重要的进步。

title: DishSeg24k: A Large-Scale Benchmark for Food Segmentation with Stochastic Expert Decoding
summary: Food segmentation is essential for applications such as intelligent catering, dietary assessment, and recommendation. However, existing benchmarks fail to capture the complexity of real-world dining scenes. The challenges of dense inter-dish overlap, fine-grained class similarity, and extreme long-tail class distributions exceed the fidelity of current datasets. To fill this gap, we introduce \textbf{DishSeg24k}, a large-scale dish-level segmentation benchmark with 24,096 images, 112,281 instances, and 278 fine-grained categories in real-world dining environments. Based on DishSeg24k, we further propose \textbf{Food Expert-Adaptive Segmentation Transformers (FEAST)} to address these challenges. FEAST models query-based decoding as a Markov Decision Process (MDP), where each decoder layer update is treated as a sequential decision step that explores uncertainty along dish boundaries. We further redesign the decoder with a reinforcement learning (RL)-guided Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) module, in which a dual-critic decoupled optimization scheme separates task-oriented query refinement from structure-aware expert routing. This design promotes expert specialization and prevents expert collapse under long-tail category distributions. Finally, extensive experiments on DishSeg24k demonstrate the state-of-the-art performance of FEAST, which outperforms previous methods by {+3.21\%} mIoU, {+3.68\%} mDice, and {+4.00\%} mAcc, respectively. We further validate the effectiveness of FEAST on FoodSeg103. The dataset and code will be publicly released.

AI.title_translation: DishSeg24k：一个采用随机专家解码的大规模食物分割基准
AI.tldr: 本文介绍了DishSeg24k，一个大规模的食物分割基准，以及FEAST，一种新的食物分割模型，它通过强化学习引导的专家混合模块解决了真实世界中复杂的食物场景分割挑战，并在新基准上取得了最先进的性能。
AI.motivation: 食物分割对于智能餐饮、饮食评估和推荐等应用至关重要。然而，现有的基准未能捕捉真实世界用餐场景的复杂性，面临盘子间密集重叠、细粒度类别相似性和极端长尾类别分布等挑战，超出了当前数据集的保真度。
AI.method: 本文引入了DishSeg24k，一个包含24,096张图像、112,281个实例和278个细粒度类别的大规模菜肴级分割基准。在此基础上，提出了Food Expert-Adaptive Segmentation Transformers (FEAST) 模型。FEAST将基于查询的解码建模为马尔可夫决策过程 (MDP)，并将每个解码器层更新视为探索菜肴边界不确定性的顺序决策步骤。解码器通过强化学习 (RL) 引导的专家混合 (MoE) 模块重新设计，其中双评论家解耦优化方案将面向任务的查询细化与结构感知的专家路由分离，以促进专家特化并防止长尾类别分布下的专家崩溃。
AI.result: 在DishSeg24k上的大量实验表明，FEAST模型实现了最先进的性能，mIoU、mDice和mAcc分别比以前的方法提高了+3.21%、+3.68%和+4.00%。FEAST在FoodSeg103上也验证了其有效性。
AI.conclusion: 本文提出了DishSeg24k，一个大规模的食物分割基准，以及FEAST模型，该模型通过新颖的RL-guided MoE模块有效解决了真实世界食物场景中的复杂分割挑战，并在多个指标上取得了显著的性能提升。
AI.translation: 食物分割对于智能餐饮、饮食评估和推荐等应用至关重要。然而，现有的基准未能捕捉真实世界用餐场景的复杂性。盘子间密集重叠、细粒度类别相似性和极端长尾类别分布等挑战超出了当前数据集的保真度。为了填补这一空白，我们引入了DishSeg24k，一个大规模的菜肴级分割基准，包含24,096张图像、112,281个实例和278个细粒度类别，这些数据均来自真实世界用餐环境。基于DishSeg24k，我们进一步提出了食物专家自适应分割Transformer (FEAST) 来应对这些挑战。FEAST将基于查询的解码建模为马尔可夫决策过程 (MDP)，其中每个解码器层更新被视为探索菜肴边界不确定性的顺序决策步骤。我们进一步使用强化学习 (RL) 引导的专家混合 (MoE) 模块重新设计了解码器，其中双评论家解耦优化方案将面向任务的查询细化与结构感知的专家路由分离。这种设计促进了专家特化，并防止了长尾类别分布下的专家崩溃。最后，在DishSeg24k上的大量实验证明了FEAST的最先进性能，它在mIoU、mDice和mAcc上分别比以前的方法提高了+3.21%、+3.68%和+4.00%。我们还在FoodSeg103上验证了FEAST的有效性。数据集和代码将公开发布。
AI.summary: 本文介绍了DishSeg24k，一个针对真实世界复杂用餐场景的大规模食物分割基准，旨在解决现有数据集的局限性。在此基础上，提出Food Expert-Adaptive Segmentation Transformers (FEAST)，该模型将查询解码视为马尔可夫决策过程，并引入了基于强化学习引导的专家混合模块，通过双评论家解耦优化来提升专家特化和处理长尾分布。实验证明FEAST在DishSeg24k和FoodSeg103上均取得了优于现有方法的先进性能。
AI.keywords: 食物分割, DishSeg24k, FEAST, 专家混合, 强化学习
AI.comments: 这篇论文的创新点在于提出了一个大规模且更贴近真实世界复杂性的食物分割基准DishSeg24k，这对于推动相关领域的研究具有重要意义。同时，FEAST模型通过将解码过程建模为MDP并引入RL引导的MoE模块，巧妙地解决了食物分割中密集重叠和长尾分布等难题，其双评论家解耦优化设计也很有新意。该研究结合了计算机视觉和强化学习技术，为食物分割任务提供了强大的工具和新的研究方向。

title: Traceable LLM Reasoning for Fake-Order Fraud Detection
summary: Detecting fake-order fraud at scale remains a critical challenge for large online-to-offline (O2O) service platforms, as existing approaches often rely on expert-designed features, produce black-box decisions, and provide limited interpretability. To address these limitations, we propose DeepScrub, a reinforcement learning framework built upon large language models (LLMs) for fake-order fraud detection with traceable reasoning. DeepScrub introduces three innovations. First, a semantic unification module converts heterogeneous risk signals into textual descriptions that LLMs can understand. Second, continued pre-training on risk-control corpora injects domain knowledge, and task rewards jointly evaluate prediction correctness and reasoning quality. Third, the SUggest-REflect (SURE) mechanism incorporates expert feedback and model self-checking to iteratively refine reasoning paths. On a real-world fake-order fraud detection dataset, DeepScrub achieves a macro-F1 score of 85.3%, outperforming the best baseline by 2.7 percentage points. Our task-optimized 8B model further surpasses a 32B model, showing that domain adaptation can matter more than model scale in this setting. In a four-week live pilot, DeepScrub achieved 91.8% precision and 88.5% recall, improving over first-stage human reviewers by 16.6 and 38.8 percentage points. It reduced first-stage manual review workload by 94% and saved nearly one million RMB annually. These results show that DeepScrub improves fraud review accuracy, reduces first-stage review workload, and provides traceable evidence for production risk-review workflows.

AI.title_translation: 可追溯的LLM推理用于虚假订单欺诈检测
AI.tldr: DeepScrub是一个基于LLM的强化学习框架，通过可追溯的推理来检测虚假订单欺诈，并显著提升了检测精度和效率。
AI.motivation: 现有虚假订单欺诈检测方法依赖专家设计的特征，产生黑盒决策，且可解释性有限，难以大规模应用，给大型O2O服务平台带来挑战。
AI.method: 本文提出了DeepScrub，一个基于大型语言模型（LLM）的强化学习框架，用于实现可追溯的虚假订单欺诈检测。它包含三项创新：1. 语义统一模块将异构风险信号转换为LLM可理解的文本描述。2. 在风险控制语料库上进行持续预训练以注入领域知识，并通过任务奖励共同评估预测正确性和推理质量。3. SUggest-REflect (SURE) 机制结合专家反馈和模型自检来迭代优化推理路径。
AI.result: 在真实虚假订单欺诈检测数据集上，DeepScrub宏观F1得分达到85.3%，比最佳基线高2.7个百分点。经过领域适应的8B模型性能超越了32B模型。在为期四周的实际试点中，DeepScrub精度达到91.8%，召回率达到88.5%，分别比第一阶段人工审核员提高了16.6和38.8个百分点。它将第一阶段人工审核工作量减少了94%，每年节省近一百万人民币。
AI.conclusion: DeepScrub提高了欺诈审核准确性，减少了第一阶段审核工作量，并为生产风险审核流程提供了可追溯的证据，有效解决了大规模虚假订单欺诈检测的挑战。
AI.translation: 大规模检测虚假订单欺诈对于大型线上到线下（O2O）服务平台来说仍然是一个严峻的挑战，因为现有方法通常依赖专家设计的特征，产生黑盒决策，并提供有限的可解释性。为了解决这些局限性，我们提出了DeepScrub，一个基于大型语言模型（LLM）的强化学习框架，用于具有可追溯推理的虚假订单欺诈检测。DeepScrub引入了三项创新。首先，语义统一模块将异构风险信号转换为LLM可以理解的文本描述。其次，在风险控制语料库上的持续预训练注入了领域知识，任务奖励共同评估预测正确性和推理质量。第三，SUggest-REflect (SURE) 机制结合了专家反馈和模型自检，以迭代地完善推理路径。在真实世界的虚假订单欺诈检测数据集上，DeepScrub实现了85.3%的宏观F1分数，比最佳基线高出2.7个百分点。我们经过任务优化的8B模型进一步超越了32B模型，表明在此设置中，领域适应可能比模型规模更重要。在为期四周的实际试点中，DeepScrub实现了91.8%的准确率和88.5%的召回率，比第一阶段人工审核员分别提高了16.6和38.8个百分点。它将第一阶段人工审核工作量减少了94%，每年节省了近一百万人民币。这些结果表明，DeepScrub提高了欺诈审核准确性，减少了第一阶段审核工作量，并为生产风险审核流程提供了可追溯的证据。
AI.summary: 本文提出了DeepScrub，一个基于大型语言模型（LLM）的强化学习框架，旨在解决O2O平台虚假订单欺诈检测中现有方法可解释性差和效率低的问题。DeepScrub通过语义统一模块将异构风险信号转化为文本描述，通过在领域语料库上进行持续预训练注入专业知识并优化推理质量，以及通过SUggest-REflect (SURE) 机制迭代完善推理路径。实验和实际试点结果表明，DeepScrub在欺诈检测准确性上显著优于基线，并大幅提升了审核效率，减少了人工工作量和成本，同时提供了可追溯的欺诈检测推理过程。
AI.keywords: 虚假订单欺诈检测, 大型语言模型, 强化学习, 可追溯推理, 领域适应
AI.comments: 这篇论文通过结合LLM与强化学习，并引入领域适应和可追溯推理机制，有效地解决了虚假订单欺诈检测中的黑盒决策和可解释性差的问题。其创新点在于将异构数据转化为LLM可处理的文本，并利用专家反馈和自检机制优化推理路径，展示了LLM在特定领域进行深度应用和提升业务价值的巨大潜力。尤其值得关注的是，领域适应的8B模型超越了32B模型，强调了领域知识注入的重要性。

title: Structure over Depth: A Single-Block Spatio-Temporal Transformer for Multi-Entity Reasoning
summary: Modeling multi-entity temporal data requires capturing dependencies across entities, time, and their interactions. Transformer-based approaches perform well but often rely on deep stacks of layers to learn these heterogeneous dependencies implicitly, increasing computational cost. We revisit this problem from a structural perspective and decompose multi-entity temporal dynamics into three interaction types: spatial interactions among entities, temporal interactions across time, and cross interactions coupling the two domains. We propose a structured spatio-temporal transformer block that explicitly models all three within a single stage. It uses parallel spatial and temporal self-attention, followed by bidirectional cross-attention, and combines the outputs through learnable gated fusion. By directly encoding these complementary views, the model reduces the need for deep stacking. We evaluate the approach on video-based group activity recognition, skeleton-based human interaction analysis, and wearable sensor-based activity recognition. Despite its simplicity, the single structured Transformer block matches or outperforms deeper architectures with only 1.76M parameters. The results suggest that depth in prior models partly compensates for implicit and entangled interaction modeling, whereas explicit factorization offers a more efficient and transparent alternative. More broadly, this work supports a structure-first design principle: expressive multi-entity temporal reasoning can emerge by exposing interaction structure rather than relying on depth.

AI.title_translation: 深度之上的结构：用于多实体推理的单块时空Transformer
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种单块结构化时空Transformer，通过明确建模空间、时间和交叉交互来处理多实体时间数据，在保持或超越深度模型性能的同时显著降低了计算成本，证明了“结构优先”设计原则的有效性。
AI.motivation: 现有的基于Transformer的多实体时间数据建模方法通常依赖于深度堆叠层来隐式学习异构依赖关系，这增加了计算成本。本文旨在通过结构化方法明确建模这些依赖，以提高效率和透明度。
AI.method: 本文将多实体时间动态分解为三种交互类型：实体间的空间交互、时间上的时间交互以及耦合两者的交叉交互。提出了一种单块结构化时空Transformer，在一个阶段内明确建模所有三种交互。它使用并行的空间和时间自注意力，接着是双向交叉注意力，并通过可学习的门控融合结合输出。
AI.result: 该方法在视频群组活动识别、基于骨架的人类交互分析和可穿戴传感器活动识别任务上进行了评估。结果显示，尽管模型简单，但这个单块结构化Transformer在参数量仅为1.76M的情况下，其性能与更深的架构相当或更优。这表明先前模型中的深度部分是为了弥补隐式和纠缠的交互建模，而显式分解提供了更高效和透明的替代方案。
AI.conclusion: 本文支持“结构优先”的设计原则：表达性的多实体时间推理可以通过揭示交互结构而不是依赖深度来产生。明确的交互分解比深度堆叠层更高效和透明。
AI.translation: 建模多实体时间数据需要捕获实体之间、时间之间及其交互之间的依赖关系。基于Transformer的方法表现良好，但通常依赖于深度堆叠的层来隐式学习这些异构依赖关系，这增加了计算成本。我们从结构角度重新审视这个问题，并将多实体时间动态分解为三种交互类型：实体间的空间交互、时间上的时间交互以及耦合这两个领域的交叉交互。我们提出了一种结构化时空Transformer块，在一个阶段内明确建模所有这三种交互。它使用并行的空间和时间自注意力，接着是双向交叉注意力，并通过可学习的门控融合结合输出。通过直接编码这些互补视图，模型减少了对深度堆叠的需求。我们在基于视频的群组活动识别、基于骨架的人类交互分析和基于可穿戴传感器的活动识别上评估了该方法。尽管其简单，但这个单块结构化Transformer块以仅1.76M的参数量匹配或超越了更深的架构。结果表明，先前模型中的深度部分是为了弥补隐式和纠缠的交互建模，而显式分解提供了一种更高效和透明的替代方案。更广泛地说，这项工作支持“结构优先”的设计原则：通过揭示交互结构而不是依赖深度，可以产生富有表现力的多实体时间推理。
AI.summary: 本文针对多实体时间数据建模中Transformer模型依赖深度堆叠导致计算成本高的问题，提出了一种名为“结构化时空Transformer块”的单块模型。该模型通过明确分解并建模空间、时间和交叉三种交互类型，在一个阶段内完成复杂依赖的学习。实验结果表明，该单块模型在多种任务上以更少的参数量（1.76M）达到或超越了更深的现有架构，证明了“结构优先”设计原则的有效性，即通过显式暴露交互结构可以实现高效且透明的多实体时间推理。
AI.keywords: 多实体推理, 时空Transformer, 结构化交互, 单块, 计算效率
AI.comments: 这篇论文的创新点在于提出了“结构优先”的设计原则，通过明确分解和建模多实体时间数据中的空间、时间和交叉交互，成功地用一个浅层Transformer块实现了与深度模型相当甚至更优的性能。这挑战了传统上通过增加模型深度来提升性能的范式，提供了一种更高效、更透明的替代方案。其重要性在于为未来设计处理复杂关系（如多实体交互）的模型提供了新的思路，特别是在资源受限或需要模型可解释性的场景中具有巨大潜力。

title: Inverse Bayesian Inference for Extracting Lesion Dynamics from Longitudinal Spectral CT
summary:
Longitudinal medical imaging captures temporal evolution of lesions, yet extracting the underlying dynamical parameters governing this evolution remains challenging. We propose an inverse Bayesian framework for inferring lesion dynamics from longitudinal spectral CT. We decompose spectral feature ($x$) evolution into three components: \begin{equation*}
  \frac{dx_i}{dt} = A_i x_i + B \cdot n + C \cdot Δx_{\text{sat}} \end{equation*} where $A_i$ captures intrinsic dynamics (lesion-autonomous evolution), $B$ captures local environment tumour burden (organ tumour burden through satellite count coupling), and $C$ captures environment/satellite state change (i.e., whether surrounding lesions move similarly or not).
  We demonstrate the framework on photon-counting NSCLC CT data from metastases, recovering distinct dynamical regimes: lung lesions exhibit significant satellite count coupling ($B=-0.34$, $p<0.05$) suggesting competitive dynamics, while liver lesions show synergistic satellite behaviour coupling ($C\approx+1.0$, $p<0.05$). Synthetic validation confirms parameter recovery, and cross-coupling analysis validates that our method detects non-zero coupling when present.
  This work establishes inverse dynamical inference as a principled methodology for extracting interpretable parameters from longitudinal imaging, moving beyond static feature extraction toward mechanistic characterisation of lesion behaviour. The code and data are available at: https://github.com/lukasf98/inverse-bayesian-inference

AI.title_translation: 纵向光谱CT中病变动力学提取的逆贝叶斯推断
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种逆贝叶斯框架，用于从纵向光谱CT数据中推断病变动力学，并揭示了不同器官病变的不同动态机制。
AI.motivation: 纵向医学成像能够捕捉病变的演变，但提取控制这种演变的基础动力学参数仍然具有挑战性。
AI.method: 本文提出了一种逆贝叶斯框架，用于从纵向光谱CT中推断病变动力学。该方法将光谱特征的演变分解为三个分量：内在动力学（病变自主演变）、局部环境肿瘤负荷（通过卫星计数耦合的器官肿瘤负荷）和环境/卫星状态变化（周围病变是否以相似方式移动）。
AI.result: 在光子计数NSCLC CT转移数据上验证了该框架，恢复了不同的动态机制：肺部病变表现出显著的卫星计数耦合（$B=-0.34$, $p<0.05$），提示竞争性动力学；而肝脏病变则显示出协同的卫星行为耦合（$C\approx+1.0$, $p<0.05$）。合成验证证实了参数恢复，交叉耦合分析验证了该方法能够检测到非零耦合。
AI.conclusion: 这项工作确立了逆动力学推断作为一种从纵向成像中提取可解释参数的原则性方法，超越了静态特征提取，实现了病变行为的机制性表征。
AI.translation:
纵向医学成像捕捉病变的随时间演变，但提取控制这种演变的基础动力学参数仍然具有挑战性。我们提出了一种逆贝叶斯框架，用于从纵向光谱CT中推断病变动力学。我们将光谱特征($x$)的演变分解为三个分量：

  $ rac{dx_i}{dt} = A_i x_i + B \cdot n + C \cdot \Delta x_{	ext{sat}}$

其中，$A_i$捕捉内在动力学（病变自主演变），$B$捕捉局部环境肿瘤负荷（通过卫星计数耦合的器官肿瘤负荷），$C$捕捉环境/卫星状态变化（即周围病变是否以相似方式移动）。
我们在转移性光子计数NSCLC CT数据上演示了该框架，恢复了不同的动态机制：肺部病变表现出显著的卫星计数耦合（$B=-0.34$, $p<0.05$），提示竞争性动力学；而肝脏病变则显示出协同的卫星行为耦合（$C\approx+1.0$, $p<0.05$）。合成验证证实了参数恢复，交叉耦合分析验证了我们的方法在存在非零耦合时能够检测到它。
这项工作确立了逆动力学推断作为一种从纵向成像中提取可解释参数的原则性方法，超越了静态特征提取，实现了病变行为的机制性表征。代码和数据可在以下网址获取：https://github.com/lukasf98/inverse-bayesian-inference
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种逆贝叶斯框架，用于从纵向光谱CT数据中提取病变的动态参数。通过将光谱特征演变分解为内在动力学、局部环境肿瘤负荷和环境/卫星状态变化三个部分，该框架能够揭示不同器官（如肺和肝）病变的不同耦合机制。研究结果表明，该方法能够从纵向成像中提取可解释的机制性参数，从而深入理解病变行为。
AI.keywords: 逆贝叶斯推断, 病变动力学, 纵向光谱CT, 肿瘤负荷, 卫星耦合
AI.comments: 这项工作创新性地将逆贝叶斯推断应用于纵向光谱CT数据，实现了对病变动力学的机制性表征，超越了传统的静态特征提取。通过量化病变与周围环境（卫星病变）的耦合关系，为肿瘤生物学和治疗反应的理解提供了新的视角。其局限性可能在于模型的复杂性和对高质量纵向数据的依赖。

title: A mixed residual method for biharmonic equations in spectral Barron spaces
summary: We propose a mixed residual method (MIM) for numerically solving the biharmonic equation with nonhomogeneous clamped boundary conditions. By establishing the well-posedness of the biharmonic equation in spectral Barron spaces, we derive an error bound for MIM that relates shallow neural network approximations to the exact solution and overcomes the curse of dimensionality. This error bound consists of two components: the first corresponds to the approximation error of the neural network, while the second represents the generalization error arising from randomly sampled training data. Several numerical experiments are presented to demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed method.

AI.title_translation: 谱巴伦空间中双调和方程的混合残差法
AI.tldr: 提出了一种混合残差法（MIM），用于在谱巴伦空间中求解带有非齐次钳位边界条件的双调和方程，并导出了克服维度灾难的误差界。
AI.motivation: 解决带有非齐次钳位边界条件的双调和方程的数值求解问题，并克服维度灾难。
AI.method: 本文提出了一种混合残差法（MIM）。通过在谱巴伦空间中建立双调和方程的适定性，推导了MIM的误差界，该误差界将浅层神经网络近似与精确解联系起来，并由神经网络的近似误差和随机采样训练数据引起的泛化误差两部分组成。
AI.result: 导出了一个克服维度灾难的误差界，该误差界将浅层神经网络近似与精确解联系起来。数值实验证明了所提方法的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 提出的混合残差法（MIM）能有效数值求解带有非齐次钳位边界条件的双调和方程，并在谱巴伦空间中克服维度灾难。
AI.translation: 我们提出了一种混合残差法（MIM），用于数值求解带有非齐次钳位边界条件的双调和方程。通过在谱巴伦空间中建立双调和方程的适定性，我们为MIM推导了一个误差界，该误差界将浅层神经网络近似与精确解联系起来，并克服了维度灾难。这个误差界由两部分组成：第一部分对应于神经网络的近似误差，第二部分代表了由随机采样训练数据引起的泛化误差。一些数值实验被用来证明所提方法的有效性。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种混合残差法（MIM），用于在谱巴伦空间中数值求解带有非齐次钳位边界条件的双调和方程。研究建立了双调和方程的适定性，并推导了MIM的误差界，该误差界将浅层神经网络近似与精确解联系起来，并有效克服了维度灾难。该误差界包含神经网络近似误差和泛化误差两部分。数值实验验证了该方法的有效性。
AI.keywords: 混合残差法, 双调和方程, 谱巴伦空间, 神经网络近似, 维度灾难
AI.comments: 该论文的创新点在于提出了混合残差法（MIM）来解决双调和方程的数值求解问题，尤其是在谱巴伦空间中建立了适定性并推导了克服维度灾难的误差界，这对于高维问题具有重要意义。结合浅层神经网络的近似能力和对泛化误差的分析，为解决复杂偏微分方程提供了一种新的思路。

title: Scoping Review of AI, Metrology, and ESG in the Semiconductor Sector: Implications for Safe and Sustainable by Design (SSbD)
comments: to be published in the 32nd IEEE ICE/ITMC Conference (Porto, Portugal) proceedings
summary: The semiconductor sector faces a dual transition: scaling manufacturing execution through Artificial Intelligence (AI) while satisfying stringent sustainability mandates, such as the EU Carbon Border Adjustment Mechanism (CBAM). This paper presents a scoping review of 1,465 documents indexed in Web of Science and Scopus, spanning AI-integrated metrology, supply chain ESG, and federated industrial data spaces. Network analysis reveals a highly fragmented "core-periphery" knowledge structure, emphasizing a critical structural hole between AI-driven process optimization and downstream sustainability governance. To close these gaps, this study proposes a 6-layer Safe and Sustainable by Design (SSbD) architecture grounded in a System of Systems (SoS) paradigm. By establishing distinct "grid-to-core" and "standards-through-supply-chain" integration pathways, the proposed framework demonstrates how virtual metrology (VM), localized federated learning, and defensive RegTech mechanisms can build provenance-aware data fabrics. Ultimately, this architecture positions regulatory compliance as a driver for innovation, enabling secure, climate-neutral, and circular value chains in semiconductor manufacturing.

AI.title_translation: 半导体领域中AI、计量和ESG的范围审查：对安全可持续设计（SSbD）的影响
AI.tldr: 本论文对半导体领域中AI、计量和ESG相关文献进行了范围审查，揭示了AI驱动的工艺优化与下游可持续性治理之间的知识结构碎片化和结构性鸿沟。为此，提出了一种基于系统之系统（SoS）范式的6层安全可持续设计（SSbD）架构，以实现安全、气候中和和循环的半导体制造价值链。
AI.motivation: 半导体行业面临双重转型挑战：一方面需要通过人工智能（AI）扩展制造执行，另一方面需要满足欧盟碳边境调节机制（CBAM）等严格的可持续性要求。本研究旨在解决AI驱动的工艺优化与下游可持续性治理之间存在的知识结构碎片化和结构性鸿沟。
AI.method: 本研究对Web of Science和Scopus中收录的1,465份文档进行了范围审查，涵盖AI集成计量、供应链ESG和联邦工业数据空间。通过网络分析揭示了知识结构。
AI.result: 网络分析揭示了高度碎片化的“核心-边缘”知识结构，强调了AI驱动的工艺优化与下游可持续性治理之间存在关键的结构性鸿沟。为弥补这些差距，本研究提出了一种基于系统之系统（SoS）范式的6层安全可持续设计（SSbD）架构。
AI.conclusion: 本研究提出的SSbD架构通过建立独特的“电网到核心”和“标准贯穿供应链”集成路径，展示了虚拟计量（VM）、本地化联邦学习和防御性监管科技机制如何构建具备溯源感知能力的数据结构。最终，该架构将法规遵从性定位为创新的驱动力，从而实现半导体制造中安全、气候中和和循环的价值链。
AI.translation: 半导体行业正面临双重转型：通过人工智能（AI）扩展制造执行，同时满足欧盟碳边境调节机制（CBAM）等严格的可持续性要求。本文对Web of Science和Scopus中收录的1,465份文档进行了范围审查，涵盖AI集成计量、供应链ESG和联邦工业数据空间。网络分析揭示了高度碎片化的“核心-边缘”知识结构，强调了AI驱动的工艺优化与下游可持续性治理之间存在关键的结构性鸿沟。为弥补这些差距，本研究提出了一种基于系统之系统（SoS）范式的6层安全可持续设计（SSbD）架构。通过建立独特的“电网到核心”和“标准贯穿供应链”集成路径，所提出的框架展示了虚拟计量（VM）、本地化联邦学习和防御性监管科技机制如何构建具备溯源感知能力的数据结构。最终，该架构将法规遵从性定位为创新的驱动力，从而实现半导体制造中安全、气候中和和循环的价值链。
AI.summary: 本论文对半导体领域中AI、计量和ESG的文献进行了范围审查，共分析了1,465份文档。研究发现，AI驱动的工艺优化与下游可持续性治理之间存在显著的知识结构碎片化和结构性鸿沟。为解决此问题，论文提出了一种基于系统之系统（SoS）范式的6层安全可持续设计（SSbD）架构，该架构通过虚拟计量、本地化联邦学习和防御性监管科技等机制，旨在构建支持安全、气候中和及循环价值链的半导体制造数据基础。
AI.keywords: AI, 计量, ESG, 半导体, SSbD, 范围审查
AI.comments: 本研究的创新之处在于其对半导体行业AI、计量和ESG交叉领域的系统性范围审查，并识别出关键的知识鸿沟。提出的6层SSbD架构提供了一个全面的框架，将监管合规性转化为创新的驱动力，有望促进半导体制造的可持续发展。其将虚拟计量、联邦学习和监管科技整合的思路具有前瞻性。

title: LoRA for Gender-Inclusive Rewriting and Activation Steering for Counter-Narrative Generation
summary: Gender-inclusive language generation seeks to transform biased text into inclusive alternatives while preserving semantic meaning and contextual coherence. This paper presents the IHLC system for the LT-EDI 2026 Shared Task, addressing both gender-inclusive rewriting and counter-narrative generation. For gender-inclusive rewriting, we employ parameter-efficient Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) fine-tuning, achieving an official score of 80.00%. Our primary contribution is a compute-efficient inference-time representation engineering approach for counter-narrative generation. We derive a principal steering direction from contrastive hidden-state activations using principal component analysis (PCA) and inject it into the intermediate representations of Gemma-3-4B-it during inference, enabling behavioral steering toward inclusive responses without modifying model weights. Combined with constrained prompting, this approach produces polite and contextually appropriate counter-narratives, achieving an official score of 78.12%. We further present a manual analysis of steering behavior, identifying key failure modes including semantic drift, residual bias leakage, layer sensitivity, over-steering, and text degeneration. Our findings highlight both the practical potential and current limitations of activation steering as a lightweight alternative to parameter updates for controllable and socially aligned language generation.

title: Common-Neighbor-Count-Based Representative Possible World Finding on Uncertain Graphs
summary: A representative possible world (RPW) is a deterministic graph derived from an uncertain graph $\mathcal{G}$ where a designated structural feature closely approximates its expected value in $\mathcal{G}$. Serving as a proxy for $\mathcal{G}$, the RPW allows conventional deterministic algorithms to be directly executed on it for mining tasks targeting this feature, thereby avoiding computationally expensive enumeration or sampling on $\mathcal{G}$. Existing studies on RPWs primarily focus on individual node features, e.g., degree or triangle degree. However, many mining tasks, such as link prediction, critically rely on the number of common neighbors between two nodes, which is a pairwise feature. To bridge this gap, we study the \underline{C}ommon-neighbor-count-based \underline{R}epresentative \underline{P}ossible \underline{W}orld (CRPW) problem, extending RPWs from preserving node-level statistics to preserving pairwise structural relationships. The problem seeks the possible world that best preserves the expected numbers of common neighbors between node pair, and we prove that is NP-hard. To address it, we develop a two-stage basic algorithm that quickly initializes a possible world and then refines it iteratively. We next accelerate the refinement by replacing its costly floating-point evaluation with an efficient integer counting strategy, as the refinement only requires determining whether a change is beneficial, rather than computing its exact magnitude. Moreover, we design a Beta-based adaptive termination method to automatically stop the refinement once the desired quality of the possible world is reached, preventing over- or under-execution. Extensive experiments on real-world uncertain graphs demonstrate the effectiveness of our algorithms on diverse mining tasks. Especially on common-neighbor-related tasks, we achieve the best performance among all compared methods.

title: Poster: Rethinking Security in LLM Code Generation through Real-World Risk Scenarios
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) are widely used for code generation, yet their security behavior in realistic development workflows remains underexplored. Existing benchmarks often rely on explicitly specified security requirements, failing to capture real-world scenarios where prompts are frequently ambiguous or incomplete. In this paper, we adopt a developer-centric perspective and identify three representative risk scenarios that commonly lead to security vulnerabilities in LLM-generated code: Ambiguous Requirements, Under-Specified Operational Context, and Security--Functionality Conflict. Based on these scenarios, we construct a large-scale benchmark comprising 2,700 test cases, enabling fine-grained evaluation of LLM security under realistic conditions. Extensive evaluation of eight state-of-the-art LLMs reveals that all models exhibit average vulnerability rates exceeding 56\% across risk scenarios. We further demonstrate that security-aware prompting can substantially mitigate these risks, achieving up to 45\% improvement.

title: Compiler-Grounded Hierarchical Diagnosis for LLM-Based Triton Kernel Optimization
summary:
Recent advances in large language models (LLMs) have enabled automated kernel generation and optimization, but most existing approaches rely on surface signals such as compilation feedback and profiling metrics. These signals reveal that a kernel is slow, but not why the backend compiler fails to realize a profitable optimization, especially on emerging accelerators such as NPUs. We therefore formulate kernel optimization as a progressive cross-layer diagnosis problem that links runtime symptoms to IR structure and compiler behavior before rewriting source. Based on this insight, we present our system, a compiler-grounded and hierarchical optimization framework for Triton kernels. the system escalates from lightweight pattern triage and profiling diagnosis to IR attribution and compiler-grounded analysis only when deeper evidence is needed, then proposes evidence-backed source-level rewrites.
  We implement the system on Triton for Ascend NPUs and evaluate it on 37 successfully converted entries from a standardized NPUKernelBench-derived Ascend 950 benchmark. Across these entries, the system attains a geometric-mean speedup of 4.35$\times$ and a median speedup of 2.73$\times$ from the initial to optimized Triton kernel; 22/37 exceed 2$\times$ and 13/37 exceed 5$\times$. The complete distribution ranges from near-baseline entries to large wins, motivating transparent reporting of the current system's scope and limitations.

title: SHReg: Strictly Rotation-Equivariant Point Cloud Registration via Spherical Harmonics
summary: Point cloud registration critically depends on local features that are both distinctive and robust to arbitrary 3D rotations. Existing learning-based methods typically approximate rotation invariance via fragile local reference frames or extensive data augmentation, providing only empirical invariance and often degrading under unseen rotational transformations. In this paper, we propose SHReg, a strictly rotation-equivariant point cloud registration framework grounded in the representation theory of $SO(3)$. By representing local geometric features as irreducible representations of $SO(3)$, SHReg guarantees exact equivariance under arbitrary rotations without relying on local reference frames. Built upon a spherical-harmonics-based equivariant backbone, SHReg jointly learns rotation-invariant descriptors for robust correspondence matching and rotation-equivariant features that preserve fine-grained orientation information. The preserved equivariant structure enables each correspondence to directly hypothesize a rigid transformation, reducing reliance on large-scale hypothesis sampling in conventional RANSAC-based pipelines and leading to improved robustness under challenging rotational variations. Extensive experiments on 3DMatch, 3DLoMatch, and KITTI demonstrate that SHReg consistently outperforms state-of-the-art methods in registration accuracy, particularly under large rotational perturbations.

title: An Online Sparsification Algorithm from the Book
summary:
In their seminal paper [Cohen et al., 2016], Cohen, Musco, and Pachocki proposed a natural and simple online spectral sparsification algorithm: rows $a_1, a_2, \ldots \in \mathbb{R}^d$ of a matrix $A$ arrive one-by-one, and when row $a_i$ arrives, it is appended to sparsifier $\tilde{A}$ (after appropriately reweighting it) with probability proportional to its current leverage score $$ τ^{\mathrm{OL}}(a_i)=a_i^\top(A_i^\top A_i)^\dagger a_i, \text{ where }A_i = [a_1, a_2, \ldots, a_i]^\top $$ or otherwise discarded forever. For oblivious streams, they showed that this maintains a $(1\pmε)$-spectral approximation $\tilde{A}$ of every $A$ with $O(dε^{-2}\log^2 d)$ many rows.
  A natural question is whether the same algorithm works for adaptive streams, where each row may depend on the algorithm's previous random choices. The original proof does not extend directly: it analyzes the process in isotropic position with respect to the final matrix $A$, which is not fixed in advance under adaptivity. As an extension of this proof framework remained elusive, various algorithmic variants have since been suggested.
  In this paper, we show that the original online leverage-score sampling algorithm is indeed robust to adaptive adversaries. Our main technical contribution is a Freedman-type matrix martingale inequality with an evolving isotropic map, allowing the isotropic map used in the concentration argument to change with the stream.
  As a consequence, this gives the first online sparsification algorithm for adaptive streams that yields a sparsifier of near-optimal size $O(d \varepsilon^{-2}\log^2 d)$ whose working memory is proportional to the size of the sparsifier. For the special case of spectral graph sparsification, we provide an implementation that additionally runs in time near-linear in the stream size.

title: Decoding the Skew: Distribution-Aware MoE Inference with Adaptive Kernel Dispatch
summary: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) inference consists of sparse expert GEMMs whose shapes vary with the runtime routing distribution. Existing serving systems typically select fused-MoE kernels using static token-count buckets, ignoring the per-expert routing distribution that determines tile padding, memory reuse, and kernel efficiency. We introduce a distribution-aware framework for modeling and benchmarking MoE inference. The framework combines the compact Effective Experts metric with a Dirichlet-based reverse-modeling procedure that generates controllable routing distributions for systematic hardware studies. Using it, we show that the best fused-MoE kernel changes with routing skew and token count. We further present DA-MoE, a GPU-resident kernel-dispatch runtime for NVIDIA GPUs that matches the live routing histogram to offline-tuned distributions and selects a near-optimal fused-MoE kernel without CPU--GPU synchronization. On HumanEval-X serving traces, DA-MoE improves geomean fused-MoE latency by 1.16X on DeepSeek-V3 and 1.29X on Kimi K2, with peak speedups of 1.40X and 1.56X.

title: Shapley Meets Tutte
summary:
We initiate the study of cooperative games where there exist groups of pre-aligned agent. For example, in a road network, the agents are cross-roads and pre-aligned groups are road-segments. For a set of datasets, the agents are attributes and each database which connects two (or more) attributes is pre-aligned. In this paper, each pre-aligned group has size two.
  Our goal is to find a way to determine the contribution of each individual local connection (pre-aligned couple) to the connectivity of the network, having an adversarial attack in mind or planning a defense of the network, or wanting to split the profits of the network between various owners of the individual local connections of the network. We model these contributions by Shapley values of the connectivity augmented 'local values' which are characteristic functions determined, e.g., by failure probabilities of local connections.
  We link the concepts of potential and Shapley values of these connectivity augmented local values to the world of chromatic and Tutte polynomials and the partition function of the Potts model from statistical physics.

title: The Curse of Precision: A Data Scaling Law for High-Precision Robotic Manipulation
comments: 8 pages, 4 figures. Accepted to the 2026 IEEE International Conference on Robotics and Automation (ICRA 2026)
summary: While scaling laws for imitation learning have primarily focused on generalization in open-world settings, the relationship between data and precision in closed-world tasks like robotic assembly remains largely unexplored. This paper systematically investigates this relationship and introduces a novel scaling law. We find that to achieve a fixed success rate, the required number of demonstrations $N$ grows super-exponentially as the target precision $P$ approaches a limit $c$. This relationship is accurately captured by the model $\log(N) \propto 1/(P-c)$. Crucially, we reveal that the limit precision $c$ is not a static physical constant of the task but an emergent property of the entire agent system, including its sensors and expert policy. Through experiments on canonical manipulation tasks, we validate this law and demonstrate that improving system components, such as adding a wrist camera or using a more effective expert, measurably lowers $c$, thus expanding the system's achievable precision. Our work provides a new theoretical framework for precision in robotics and a quantitative metric to evaluate system capabilities. Furthermore, these findings provide a practical methodology for guiding the development and debugging of high-precision manipulation systems.
comment: 8 pages, 4 figures. Accepted to the 2026 IEEE International Conference on Robotics and Automation (ICRA 2026)

title: Algorithms and results on multiparameter counting of numerical semigroups
summary:
There have been many efforts to count numerical semigroups by the genus and by the Frobenius number. It is known that the number of semigroups of each genus grows asymptotically with the genus like the Fibonacci numbers and that the number of semigroups of each Frobenius number grows asymptotically in such a way that each number doubles the previous but one. We prove a formula for the number of semigroups of each Frobenius number, genus, and multiplicity, under the assumption that the multiplicity $m$ and the Frobenius number $F$ satisfy $m\geq\frac{F+1}{3}$. This formula gives, under the required restriction, a multiparameter exact version of the increasing behaviours just mentioned.
  We also present two adaptations of the seeds algorithm to explore both the unleaved tree of numerical semigroups up to a given genus and the Frobenius-leaf-discriminating tree, whose leaves are exactly the semigroups of a given Frobenius number. For this purpose we adapted the recursive descending algorithm for trimming the tree exactly at those nodes with no descendants with a given genus, in the first case, or with no descendants with a given Frobenius number, in the second case. We refined the parallelizing strategies and we overcame the previous limitation of the length of integers in the bitwise representation of the gap sequence and the seed sequence. We extended the knowledge of three different sequences. We obtained $n_{78}, n_{79}, n_{80}$, we computed the number of semigroups of each Frobenius number up to 128, and we computed the number of irreducible numerical semigroups of each Frobenius number up to 128 as well. We also computed the multiparameter decomposition of the numbers in the first sequence up to genus 80 by the first three jumps, and the multiparameter decomposition of the numbers in the second sequence up to Frobenius number 128 by multiplicity and genus.

title: Gleam: Adaptive Network-Efficient CUDA API Remoting for Cross-Device GPU Sharing over LANs
summary: This paper aims to enable computation- and communication-efficient GPU sharing across devices within local area networks (LANs), facilitating ubiquitous AI inference on heterogeneous personal devices. We achieve distributed task offloading via CUDA API remoting. However, beyond raw computation, network constraints emerge as the primary bottleneck: limited bandwidth, high-frequency API invocations, and cross-task contention significantly hinder performance. To address these challenges, we propose Gleam, a novel and network-efficient framework for task-generic GPU sharing across local-area CUDA devices, with three key contributions. First, we reduce bandwidth overhead in CUDA API remoting through automatic model weight caching, and mitigate accumulated latency from frequent API calls by asynchronous execution. Second, we design a runtime task scheduler that dynamically determines API remoting pairs between LAN clients and servers, explicitly accounting for both network conditions and GPU resource contention under parallel workloads. Finally, we introduce dedicated mechanisms to ensure CUDA context consistency across distributed executions. Extensive experiments on heterogeneous NVIDIA GPUs and diverse AI workloads show Gleam consistently outperforms state-of-the-art baselines, achieving 1.4-24.2 times improvements in API remoting efficiency and up to 1.79 times higher system throughput.

title: Pure Pairing Heaps
summary: The pairing heap is a "self-adjusting" implementation of a heap (priority queue) that is widely used in practice because it is simple and efficient. We introduce and analyze a simplified version of the pairing heap that we call the pure pairing heap. Our innovation is to eliminate the assembly pass during delete-min operations. We obtain the following amortized time bounds for operations on pure pairing heaps: $O(\log n)$ time per delete-min, $O(\log\log n \cdot \log\log\log n)$ time per decrease-key operation, and $O(1)$ time for each insert or meld. These bounds match those recently obtained for a more complicated version of pairing heaps, the multipass pairing heap}. These bounds also match the known lower bounds for self-adjusting heaps, except for the decrease-key bound, which is within a factor of $\log\log\log n$ of the lower bound. The main novelty in our analysis is to partition heap items into groups and to analyze each group separately. Our analysis extends to give the same bounds for lazy pairing heaps, a multitree version of pairing heaps.

title: A scalable online machine learning approach for Stock Recommendation
summary: Stock recommendation systems face the dual challenge of adapting to rapidly changing market conditions while maintaining low-latency predictions for end users. Traditional batch-trained models fail to capture concept drift, and monolithic architectures struggle to provide fault tolerance under load. This paper presents a scalable online deep learning-based stock recommendation system built on a distributed microservices architecture using Kubernetes, Docker, and RabbitMQ. The system employs a hybrid leader-follower architecture where a primary model continuously trains on streaming financial data, including EPS, MACD, and price, from the Alpha Vantage API while multiple replica models serve user-facing recommendations in parallel. A multilayer perceptron implemented with TensorFlow Recommenders generates content-based recommendations using explicit user ratings (1-5) and transfer learning. The architecture ensures high availability. The leader persists model weights to Google Cloud Object Storage, allowing replicas to recover seamlessly upon failure, while RabbitMQ provides message durability and replay. Results demonstrate that the system serves stock recommendations in 23 seconds per request and processes up to 500 portfolio addition requests per second per follower. Key limitations include data staleness (up to 150 minutes due to API rate limits) and the absence of a service mesh for inter-cluster security. This work contributes a production-ready reference architecture for online recommender systems that balances consistency, availability, and scalability in a financial domain context

title: SMART: LLM-Augmented Hybrid Retrieval for Dynamic Product Ads
comments: To be published in the 20th ACM Conference on Recommender Systems (recsys'26), September 27 - October 2, 2026, Minneapolis, MN, USA
summary: Dynamic Product Ads (DPA) require retrieving relevant items from multi-million product catalogs, balancing two competing objectives: retargeting (re-surfacing known interests) and prospecting (discovering new categories). While Large Language Models (LLMs) capture semantic intent better than traditional embedding models, deploying them at scale introduces prohibitive inference costs and lexical mismatch issues. Through controlled experiments on millions of users, we demonstrate a critical retrieval decomposition: rule-generated queries excel at retargeting on a lexical BM25 index, while LLM-generated queries excel at prospecting on a dense ANN index. Building on this, we propose SMART (SeMantic-aware Adaptive ReTrieval). To manage costs, a lightweight quality gate identifies coverage gaps in initial keyword results, adaptively routing only the ~10% of users who benefit from semantic prospecting to the LLM path. Offline evaluation demonstrates that this gated approach captures the bulk of semantic prospecting gains in Relevance Score while maintaining competitive re-targeting performance at a 90% reduction in LLM costs. Finally, in a 2-week online A/B test at Snap, SMART improved the ad conversion rate by +27.6% over a strong embedding-based baseline.
