AI.title_translation: 通过政治轴审计大语言模型中的对齐可控性
AI.tldr: 大语言模型的政治倾向主要由提示词上下文决定而非模型本身，审计应关注模型的可控性与分散度而非静态坐标。
AI.motivation: 传统的政治审计通常将大语言模型简化为政治罗盘上的一个静态点，但这忽视了模型通过系统提示词进行动态操纵和转向的可控性能力。
AI.method: 采用基于离散度优先的压力测试方法，跨越12个意识形态角色加上一个未干预基准、70个政治罗盘测试项、10个复本以及7个主流大语言模型，共收集63700个响应进行分析。
AI.result: 上下文框架解释了经济和社会轴上约88%-93%的方差，而模型身份的贡献不到3%；模型在受到极端框架时表现出不同的移动幅度和饱和度特征。
AI.conclusion: 政治坐标审计需要引入分散度、对称性、饱和度和拒绝底线等可控性指标，而非仅仅关注静态的政治立场。
AI.translation: 大型语言模型（LLM）的政治审计通常将每个模型简化为政治罗盘上的一个点。然而，这个静止点在实际部署中几乎没有意义：模型总会落在一个位置，真正重要的是其答案可以被引导多远以及朝哪个方向引导。这种引导通过系统提示词进行：即平台设置的个性化层，或者是从用户历史中诱导出的个性化层，且不一定由人工编写。我们对12个意识形态角色加上一个未干预基准、70个政治罗盘测试项、10个复本以及7个领先的LLM（GPT-5、Claude、Grok、Gemini、DeepSeek、Kimi和Qwen，共63700个回答）进行了基于离散度优先的提示词可控性压力测试。上下文框架解释了经济和社会轴上大约88%-93%的方差，而模型身份的解释率则低于3%：模型的响应对指令具有高度的可调节性。模型的偏移情况各不相同：一些模型移动更多，另一些在极端框架下会饱和。一旦认识到基准并非处于中心位置，先前审计中冲突的方向性引导结果便迎刃而解：位移与接近度存在分歧，因此其效果是几何上的，而非差异化的依从性。在威权主义提示词下，模型在相同问题上产生相似的偏移。因此，政治坐标审计需要进行报告离散度、对称性、饱和度和拒绝底线的可控性审计。我们已开源了提示词、基准数据和代码。
AI.summary: 该论文通过政治轴线对大型语言模型的对齐可控性进行了审计，发现上下文框架对模型政治立场的影响远大于模型自身的身份特征，并强调了评估模型可控性、分散度和饱和度的必要性。
AI.keywords: 大语言模型, 对齐可控性, 政治坐标, 提示词工程, 压力测试
AI.comments: 本文创新性地提出通过政治坐标轴来审计大语言模型对齐的可控性，指出了传统静态政治坐标审计的局限性，并强调了基于提示词的可控性和离散度的重要性。

title: Additive Bases from Primitive Dyck Words: Regular Underapproximations, Motzkin Coding, and Digit Lifting
summary: We study additive representations by integers whose canonical binary expansions are primitive Dyck words. Pairing consecutive bits yields a positional form of the classical relation between Dyck paths and two-colored Motzkin paths: except for 10, primitive Dyck words are exactly the binary block images of base-4 words 3w0, where w is a two-colored Motzkin word. This exposes a regular underapproximation, digit closure, and sharp generation bounds. We prove an interval digit-lifting theorem for digitally closed sets and a constructive base-4 propagation algorithm that lifts finite sumset certificates to infinite tails in logarithmically many recursive stages. Combining these tools with exact finite certificates and generation-gap lower bounds, we classify all positive even integers requiring more than six primitive Dyck summands. The integer 46 requires eight, and 34, 44, 98, 154, 198, 202, 206, 838, 842, and 846 require seven; every other positive even integer requires at most six. Thus 848 is the sharp eventual threshold. The bound is asymptotically optimal because 10*4^(k+1)-6 requires six summands for every k >= 2. The associated halved family has exact asymptotic additive order five. Supplementary programs reproduce all finite certificates using exact integer arithmetic.

AI.title_translation: 源自本原Dyck词的加法基：正则下近似、Motzkin编码与数字提升
AI.tldr: 本文通过研究由原始Dyck词构成的加法基底，证明了848是需要超过六个加数的正偶数的最终尖锐阈值，并给出了完整的分类。
AI.motivation: 研究规范二进制展开为原始Dyck词的整数所构成的加法表示，以探索其加法基底性质、正则下近似以及由加数个数决定的整数分类和渐近阈值。
AI.method: 利用二进制位配对建立Dyck路径与双色Motzkin路径的联系，发展了正则下近似、数字闭包、区间数字提升定理以及基于基4的传播算法，并结合有限证书和生成间隙下界进行分类。
AI.result: 证明了848是所有正偶数需要超过六个原始Dyck加数的尖锐最终阈值，精确找出了需要七个和八个加数的特定正偶数，并证明了对应的平分族具有渐近加法阶五。
AI.conclusion: 本文成功利用原始Dyck词构成的加法基底研究了正偶数的表示复杂性，精确分类了需要极多加数的例外偶数，并证明了848是尖锐的渐近阈值。
AI.translation: 我们研究了其规范二进制展开为本原Dyck词的整数所构成的加法表示。将连续的位进行配对，得到了Dyck路径与双色Motzkin路径之间经典关系的位置形式：除了10之外，本原Dyck词正好是基4词3w0的二进制块图像，其中w是一个双色Motzkin词。这揭示了一个正则下近似、数字闭包以及尖锐的生成界。我们证明了针对数字闭包集的区间数字提升定理，以及一种构造性的基4传播算法，该算法能在对数级递归阶段将有限和集证书提升为无限尾。将这些工具与精确的有限证书和生成间隙下界相结合，我们对所有需要六个以上本原Dyck加数的正偶数进行了分类。整数46需要八个，34、44、98、154、198、202、206、838、842和846需要七个；所有其他正偶数最多需要六个。因此，848是尖锐的最终阈值。该界限是渐近最优的，因为对于所有k >= 2，10*4^(k+1)-6都需要六个加数。相关的平分族具有确切的渐近加法阶五。辅助程序使用精确的整数算术重现了所有有限证书。
AI.summary: 本文研究了以规范二进制展开为原始Dyck词的整数所构成的加法表示。通过将Dyck词与双色Motzkin词建立联系，并引入正则下近似、数字提升定理与传播算法，本文对所有正偶数所需的加数个数进行了精确分类，证明了848是需要超过六个加数的最终尖锐阈值。
AI.keywords: 原始Dyck词, Motzkin编码, 数字提升, 加法基底, 和集证书
AI.comments: 本文巧妙地将组合计数中的Dyck词与数论中的加法基底问题结合起来，利用Motzkin编码和数字提升技术，精确刻画了偶数的加法表示复杂性，具有很高的理论创新性和严谨性。

title: ATCNet-CIAM for Multi-Session Motor Imagery EEG Signal Classification
comments: This manuscript has been accepted for publication in the International Conference on Intelligence Systems and Robotics for Sustainable Development (ISRSD) 2026
summary: Motor imagery (MI)-based electroencephalography is widely used in non-invasive brain--computer interfaces (BCIs), but robust decoding remains challenging due to inter-subject variability and cross-session non-stationarity. This work proposes ATCNet-CIAM, an enhanced attention temporal convolutional network that integrates a lightweight channel-integrated attention module (CIAM) into the ATCNet framework to improve channel-spatial feature representation for MI decoding. The proposed model is evaluated on BCI Competition IV-2a, BCI Competition IV-2b, and the multi-day WBCIC-MI dataset under standard, within-session, and cross-session protocols. Experimental results show that ATCNet-CIAM achieves 86.32% accuracy on BCI IV-2a and 87.96% on BCI IV-2b under the standard protocol, while reaching 89.46% and 83.64% in the within-session WBCIC-MI on 2C and 3C, respectively. The proposed framework consistently improves classification stability and robustness under session-varying conditions, and ablation study confirms the complementary contribution of the proposed architectural components.
comment: This manuscript has been accepted for publication in the International Conference on Intelligence Systems and Robotics for Sustainable Development (ISRSD) 2026

AI.title_translation: 用于多会话运动想象脑电信号分类的ATCNet-CIAM
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种名为ATCNet-CIAM的增强型注意力时间卷积网络，通过引入轻量级通道集成注意力模块，有效解决了运动想象脑电信号解码中跨会话非平稳性的难题，大幅提升了脑机接口的分类精度与鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 由于受试者间变异性和跨会话的非平稳性，基于运动想象（MI）的脑机接口（BCI）在实现鲁棒解码方面依然面临挑战。
AI.method: 提出ATCNet-CIAM模型，将轻量级通道集成注意力模块（CIAM）整合到ATCNet框架中，并在BCI Competition IV-2a、IV-2b以及多天WBCIC-MI数据集上进行标准、会话内和跨会话协议的评估与消融实验。
AI.result: 在标准协议下，ATCNet-CIAM在BCI IV-2a和IV-2b上的准确率分别达到86.32%和87.96%；在会话内WBCIC-MI的2C和3C上分别达到89.46%和83.64%，并显著提升了会话多变条件下的分类稳定性和鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: ATCNet-CIAM通过集成通道集成注意力模块，显著增强了运动想象EEG信号在跨会话和多受试者条件下的分类鲁棒性与准确率。
AI.translation: 基于运动想象（MI）的脑电图被广泛应用于非侵入式脑机接口（BCI），但由于受试者间的变异性和跨会话的非平稳性，稳健的解码依然具有挑战性。本工作提出了ATCNet-CIAM，这是一种增强的注意力时间卷积网络，它将轻量级的通道集成注意力模块（CIAM）集成到ATCNet框架中，以改善MI解码的通道-空间特征表征。所提出的模型在标准、会话内和跨会话协议下，于BCI Competition IV-2a、BCI Competition IV-2b以及多天WBCIC-MI数据集上进行了评估。实验结果表明，ATCNet-CIAM在标准协议下的BCI IV-2a和IV-2b上分别达到了86.32%和87.96%的准确率，而在会话内的WBCIC-MI（2C和3C）上分别达到了89.46%和83.64%的准确率。所提出的框架在会话多变条件下持续提高了分类稳定性和鲁棒性，消融实验也证实了所提架构组件的互补贡献。
AI.summary: 该论文提出了ATCNet-CIAM模型，通过在ATCNet中引入通道集成注意力模块来增强运动想象EEG信号的通道-空间特征表示，从而有效克服跨会话非平稳性，并在多个公开数据集上展现出优异的分类性能和鲁棒性。
AI.keywords: 运动想象, 脑机接口, 脑电图, 注意力时间卷积网络, 通道集成注意力模块
AI.comments: 该论文针对脑机接口中跨会话非平稳性和受试者间变异性的挑战，提出了一种改进的注意力时间卷积网络（ATCNet-CIAM），通过引入轻量级通道集成注意力模块（CIAM），有效提升了通道-空间特征表征能力。实验在多个公开数据集上验证了其优异的准确率和鲁棒性。

title: CircuitWeave: Topology-Behavior Alignment for Executable Multimodal RTL Generation
summary: Text-only LLMs generate RTL from natural-language specifications, but prose can leave connectivity, register boundaries, and state-output relations implicit even when interfaces and cycle-level behavior are specified. Schematics can make these structural relations explicit and thereby complement the behavioral constraints conveyed by text. Yet simply adding an image creates a fusion challenge: direct multimodal decoding does not explicitly separate the evidence roles of text and schematics or make missing and conflicting constraints explicit before code generation.We present CircuitWeave, a contract-mediated multimodal framework that extracts a topology contract from the schematic and a behavior contract from the text. It fuses these records into a circuit contract that serializes correspondences, missing evidence, and conflicts, then generates RTL only from this contract. A joint objective supervises both contracts, serialized fusion, contract-conditioned RTL generation, and reverse reconstruction of covered contract fields from reference RTL.We construct 5,000 executable-qualified packages, each containing a specification, generated schematic, structured contracts, reference RTL, and self-checking testbench, and use the training split to adapt Qwen with LoRA. On VerilogEval-Human, CircuitWeave reaches 46.60% pass@1, 61.49% pass@5, and 65.39% pass@10. These point estimates are 8.46, 5.85, and 2.57 percentage points above those of the same adapted checkpoint without the schematic. On RTLLM, it reaches 40.00%, 48.00%, and 52.00%, two percentage points above the adapted text-only condition at each cutoff.The dataset is publicly available at https://huggingface.co/datasets/fengjiahao0421/CircuitWeave.

AI.title_translation: CircuitWeave：用于可执行多模态 RTL 生成的拓扑-行为对齐方法
AI.tldr: 提出 CircuitWeave 框架，通过将文本行为规范与原理图拓扑结构进行合同化对齐与融合，显著提升了大模型生成 RTL 代码的准确性。
AI.motivation: 纯文本大模型生成 RTL 代码时，自然语言往往无法显式表达电路的连接性、寄存器边界和状态输出关系，而引入图像则会带来多模态融合的挑战，导致文本和原理图的证据角色混淆以及冲突无法显式化。
AI.method: 提出 CircuitWeave 框架，分别从原理图中提取拓扑合同、从文本中提取行为合同，将两者融合成电路合同（序列化对应关系、缺失证据和冲突），并仅基于该合同进行 RTL 生成；采用联合目标监督合同提取、序列化融合、合同条件下的 RTL 生成以及从参考 RTL 进行的反向重建。
AI.result: 在 VerilogEval-Human 上，CircuitWeave 的 pass@1、pass@5 和 pass@10 分别达到 46.60%、61.49% 和 65.39%，比不带原理图的基线分别高出 8.46、5.85 和 2.57 个百分点；在 RTLLM 上也有稳定提升。
AI.conclusion: CircuitWeave 通过拓扑-行为对齐的合同机制，有效整合了文本与电路图信息，显著提升了多模态大模型生成 RTL 代码的性能，并为后续研究提供了高质量的数据集与基准。
AI.translation: 纯文本大模型根据自然语言规范生成RTL，但即使指定了接口和周期级行为，文字描述往往也会使连接性、寄存器边界和状态输出关系保持隐式。原理图可以使这些结构关系显式化，从而补充文本传达的行为约束。然而，简单地添加图像会带来融合挑战：直接的多模态解码无法显式分离文本和原理图的证据角色，也无法在代码生成之前显式暴露出缺失和冲突的约束。我们提出了 CircuitWeave，这是一个由合同介导的多模态框架，它从原理图中提取拓扑合同，从文本中提取行为合同。它将这些记录融合成一个电路合同，该合同序列化了对应关系、缺失证据和冲突，然后仅根据此合同生成 RTL。联合目标监督了合同提取、序列化融合、合同条件下的 RTL 生成，以及从参考 RTL 反向重建被覆盖的合同字段。我们构建了 5,000 个可执行合格的包，每个包包含规范、生成的原理图、结构化合同、参考 RTL 和自检测试平台，并使用训练集通过 LoRA 对 Qwen 进行微调。在 VerilogEval-Human 上，CircuitWeave 的 pass@1、pass@5 和 pass@10 分别达到了 46.60%、61.49% 和 65.39%。这些点估计值比没有原理图的相同微调检查点分别高出 8.46、5.85 和 2.57 个百分点。在 RTLLM 上，它分别达到了 40.00%、48.00% 和 52.00%，在每个截断点上都比微调的纯文本条件高出两个百分点。数据集已在 https://huggingface.co/datasets/fengjiahao0421/CircuitWeave 公开。
AI.summary: CircuitWeave 是一个基于合同介导的多模态框架，用于可执行的多模态 RTL 代码生成。它通过分别提取电路原理图的拓扑合同与文本的行为合同，将其融合成统一的电路合同，从而显式化缺失信息与冲突并指导 RTL 生成，在多个基准测试中展现出优越的性能。
AI.keywords: RTL Generation, Multimodal LLMs, Circuit Topology, Contract-mediated, VerilogEval
AI.comments: CircuitWeave 通过引入合同介导（contract-mediated）的多模态框架，成功将电路图的拓扑结构与文本的行为规范相结合，显式地解决了解码过程中的冲突与缺失证据问题，显著提升了 LLM 生成可执行 RTL 代码的准确率与鲁棒性。

title: Delegation Intelligence in Deep Search: A Controllable Framework for Disentangled Capability Diagnosis
summary: Deep search is becoming a core capability of modern agent systems, yet it is typically evaluated solely based on end-to-end answer accuracy. This coupled evaluation paradigm entangles retrieval quality, long-context comprehension, evidence verification, and tool-use decisions, making it difficult to determine whether a model truly knows when and how to delegate information seeking to search. To this end: (1) We formalize this meta-capability as Delegation Intelligence in deep search and decompose it into complementary dimensions-Search Decision-Making (recognizing information insufficiency and deciding whether, when, and how to search) and Information Synthesis and Verification (aggregating evidence from multiple sources, judging source reliability, and synthesizing information under noisy, potentially adversarial conditions). (2) To enable disentangled and reproducible measurement, we develop a controllable synthesis pipeline built on document-grounded reverse engineering. This yields a general recipe for constructing controlled deep-search evaluations rather than a single fixed dataset. (3) As a concrete instantiation, we construct DelegSearchBench, together with a disentangled evaluation protocol that isolates each capability dimension by varying document composition and tool access. (4) Across representative models, we demonstrate that deep-search competence cannot be adequately characterized by final-answer accuracy alone...

AI.title_translation: 深度搜索中的委托智能：解耦能力诊断的可控框架
AI.tldr: 本文提出了深度搜索中的“委托智能”概念及可控解耦评估框架（DelegSearchBench），解决了传统仅依赖端到端准确率评估模型的局限性。
AI.motivation: 当前的深度搜索评估通常仅基于端到端的答案准确率，这耦合了检索质量、长上下文理解、证据验证和工具使用决策，无法准确诊断模型在信息搜寻委托方面的真实能力。
AI.method: 1. 将委托智能解耦为搜索决策、信息合成与验证两个维度；2. 开发基于文档基础逆向工程的可控合成流水线；3. 构建DelegSearchBench基准以及通过改变文档组成和工具访问来隔离各个能力维度的解耦评估协议。
AI.result: 通过在代表性模型上的实验，证明了仅凭最终答案准确率无法充分表征深度搜索能力，验证了所提出的解耦评估框架的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 论文表明，仅凭最终答案的准确率无法充分表征深度搜索能力，必须通过解耦评估来诊断模型的具体能力缺陷。
AI.translation: 深度搜索正在成为现代智能体系统的一项核心能力，然而它通常仅根据端到端的答案准确率进行评估。这种耦合的评估范式将检索质量、长上下文理解、证据验证和工具使用决策纠缠在一起，使得难以确定模型是否真正知道何时以及如何将信息寻求委托给搜索。为此：（1）我们将深度搜索中的这一元能力形式化为“委托智能”，并将其分解为互补的维度——搜索决策（识别信息不足并决定是否、何时以及如何搜索）和信息 synthesis 与验证（聚合来自多个来源的证据，判断来源可靠性，并在噪声和潜在对抗条件下合成信息）。（2）为了实现解耦和可重复的测量，我们开发了一个基于文档接地逆向工程的可控合成流水线。这产生了一个构建受控深度搜索评估的通用配方，而不是单一的固定数据集。（3）作为具体的实例化，我们构建了 DelegSearchBench，以及一个通过改变文档组成和工具访问来隔离每个能力维度的解耦评估协议。（4）通过代表性模型，我们证明了仅凭最终答案的准确率无法充分表征深度搜索能力……
AI.summary: 该论文提出了深度搜索中的“委托智能”概念及其解耦评估框架。针对传统端到端评估的局限，文章将该元能力分解为搜索决策、信息合成与验证两个维度，设计了可控的合成流水线和DelegSearchBench基准，并通过实验证明了多维度解耦评估的必要性。
AI.keywords: 深度搜索, 智能体系统, 能力诊断, 可控评估, 委托智能
AI.comments: 该论文针对现代智能体系统中深度搜索能力的评估难题，创新性地提出了‘委托智能（Delegation Intelligence）’概念，并将其解耦为搜索决策与信息合成验证两个维度。通过构建可控的合成流程和基准（DelegSearchBench），克服了传统仅靠端到端准确率评估的局限性，对理解和提升大模型的高级搜索与智能体能力具有重要意义。

title: $\partial^2 ( \mathrm{TO} ) $: A Dual Topological Derivative-Based Enriched Topology Optimization for Fracture Mitigation in 3-D Brittle Solids
summary: We propose a fracture-mitigation topology optimization framework for 3-D brittle solids. The topology is described by a level set function parameterized by radial basis functions, and the structural response is computed using an interface-enriched finite element formulation. Dual topological derivatives serve two purposes. First, they are used to nucleate holes within the solid during the optimization process. Second, they are used to evaluate energy release rates (ERRs) along the entire boundary, requiring only the stress field from a single enriched finite element analysis of the uncracked geometry. For this purpose, penny-shaped cracks are assumed to nucleate using the maximum hoop stress criterion, at the locations of enriched nodes introduced along the boundary for accurate finite element analysis. Because ERR estimates depend sensitively on stress accuracy, we compute a nodal stress field using a non-local stress-recovery procedure. The topology optimization objective aggregates the boundary ERRs using a $p$-mean function. Three-dimensional numerical examples, including the commonly studied L-bracket benchmark problem, demonstrate the capability of the proposed framework.

AI.title_translation: $\partial^2 ( \mathrm{TO} ) $：基于对偶拓扑导数的增强拓扑优化，用于三维脆性固体的裂纹抑制
AI.tldr: 提出了一种利用对偶拓扑导数进行三维脆性固体裂纹抑制的新型拓扑优化框架。
AI.motivation: 为了解决三维脆性固体中的裂纹抑制问题，开发一种能够高效且准确评估能量释放率并在优化过程中处理复杂裂纹形核与扩展的拓扑优化框架。
AI.method: 采用由径向基函数参数化的水平集函数描述拓扑，使用界面增强有限元法计算结构响应，并利用对偶拓扑导数进行孔洞形核和能量释放率评估；同时结合非局部应力恢复程序计算节点应力场，并利用 p-mean 函数聚合边界能量释放率作为优化目标。
AI.result: 通过包括经典的L形支架基准问题在内的三维数值算例，验证了所提框架在三维脆性固体裂纹抑制方面的有效能力。
AI.conclusion: 提出的基于对偶拓扑导数的拓扑优化框架成功实现了三维脆性固体中的裂纹抑制，并通过数值算例验证了其有效性和优越性。
AI.translation: 我们提出了一种针对三维脆性固体的裂纹抑制拓扑优化框架。拓扑结构由径向基函数参数化的水平集函数描述，结构响应则使用界面增强有限元公式计算。对偶拓扑导数具有两个用途：首先，它们在优化过程中用于在实体内部形核孔洞；其次，它们用于评估整个边界上的能量释放率（ERRs），这只需要对未裂纹几何体进行单次增强有限元分析的应力场。为此，假设圆形裂纹根据最大环向应力准则在沿边界引入的增强节点位置处形核，以便进行精确的有限元分析。由于 ERR 估计值对应力精度高度敏感，我们采用非局部应力恢复程序计算节点应力场。拓扑优化目标使用 $p$-均值函数聚合边界 ERR。三维数值算例（包括常被研究的 L 形支架基准问题）证明了所提框架的功能。
AI.summary: 该文提出了一种面向三维脆性固体的裂纹抑制拓扑优化框架，该框架利用径向基函数水平集法描述拓扑，通过界面增强有限元法计算响应，并创新性地采用对偶拓扑导数来形核孔洞及高效评估全边界的能量释放率，最终通过数值算例验证了其有效性。
AI.keywords: 拓扑优化, 脆性固体, 裂纹抑制, 对偶拓扑导数, 界面增强有限元法
AI.comments: 该论文提出了一种新颖的基于对偶拓扑导数的三维脆性固体裂纹抑制拓扑优化框架，创新性地结合了径向基函数水平集法、界面增强有限元法及非局部应力恢复技术，高效且精确地评估了能量释放率并实现了裂纹减缓。

title: Geometry Meets Semantics: Fractional Gradient Stabilization for Semantic-Driven Bounding Box Optimization in Visual Detection Tasks
summary: Bounding boxes are fundamental for object localization in visual detection tasks. Among them, oriented bounding boxes are widely used in visual detection tasks, which provide a more precise directional representation. Generally, IoU-based losses are widely adopted to optimize box regression. However, we observed that IoU-driven box optimization suffers from two key issues: (1) it relies solely on geometric properties while ignoring semantic cues; (2) orientation optimization suffers from unstable gradients, causing oscillations in orientation convergence. In this paper, we propose a Fractional Semantic IoU loss to achieve unified semantic-geometric learning with gradient stabilization. First, we design a semantic similarity metric to guide IoU optimization, building a Semantic IoU loss (SIoU loss) with an adaptive gradient gating mechanism. Then, we revisit the gradient instability issue in oriented box optimization and extend the SIoU loss to a fractional-order formulation to build the \textbf{Fr}actional \textbf{S}emantic \textbf{IoU} \textbf{loss} (FrSIoU loss). The FrSIoU loss accumulates historical IoU states to regularize abnormal gradients during bounding box optimization process. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our approach achieves stable performance gains across different bounding box formulations and diverse visual detection tasks. The code will be available on GitHub.

AI.title_translation: 几何与语义的交汇：视觉检测任务中语义驱动边界框优化的分数阶梯度稳定方法
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种分数阶语义IoU损失（FrSIoU loss），通过融合语义线索与分数阶梯度稳定机制，有效解决了视觉检测中边界框优化的梯度震荡与几何单一问题，提升了检测性能。
AI.motivation: 现有的基于IoU的边界框优化方法存在两个关键问题：一是仅依赖几何属性而忽视了语义线索；二是方向优化时存在梯度不稳定问题，导致方向收敛时产生震荡。
AI.method: 提出分数阶语义IoU损失（FrSIoU loss），首先设计语义相似度指标引导IoU优化并构建带自适应梯度门控机制的语义IoU损失（SIoU loss），随后将其扩展为分数阶形式，通过累积历史IoU状态来正则化异常梯度。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，该方法在不同的边界框公式和各种视觉检测任务中均实现了稳定的性能提升。
AI.conclusion: 提出的FrSIoU损失函数通过结合语义线索和分数阶梯度稳定机制，有效解决了传统IoU驱动优化中的几何局限与梯度震荡问题，在视觉检测任务中取得了稳定的性能提升。
AI.translation: 边界框是视觉检测任务中目标定位的基础。其中，定向边界框被广泛应用于视觉检测任务中，它提供了更精确的方向表示。通常，基于IoU的损失被广泛用于优化框回归。然而，我们观察到基于IoU的框优化存在两个关键问题：（1）它仅依赖几何属性而忽略了语义线索；（2）方向优化受到梯度不稳定的困扰，导致方向收敛时产生震荡。在本文中，我们提出了分数阶语义IoU损失，以实现具有梯度稳定性的统一语义-几何学习。首先，我们设计了一个语义相似度指标来指导IoU优化，构建了具有自适应梯度门控机制的语义IoU损失（SIoU损失）。然后，我们重新审视了定向框优化中的梯度不稳定问题，并将SIoU损失扩展为分数阶公式，构建了分数阶语义IoU损失（FrSIoU损失）。FrSIoU损失通过累积历史IoU状态来正则化边界框优化过程中的异常梯度。大量实验证明，我们的方法在不同的边界框公式和各种视觉检测任务中都实现了稳定的性能提升。代码将在GitHub上开源。
AI.summary: 本文针对视觉检测中边界框优化忽视语义和方向梯度不稳定的问题，提出了一种分数阶语义IoU损失（FrSIoU loss）。该方法结合了语义相似度与分数阶梯度稳定机制，通过累积历史状态正则化异常梯度，从而实现了统一的语义-几何学习并提升了检测性能。
AI.keywords: 视觉检测, 目标定位, 边界框优化, 分数阶语义IoU, 梯度稳定
AI.comments: 该论文创新性地将几何特性与语义线索相结合，并引入分数阶微积分来解决边界框优化中的梯度不稳定问题，方法新颖且在视觉检测任务中表现出色。

title: The JEPA Paradox in Language: The Geometry of Linguistic Alternatives
summary: Joint-Embedding Predictive Architectures (JEPAs) are effective for images, video, and audio, yet deterministic JEPA-style latent prediction has not become a standard objective for text encoders. We argue that this gap reflects a mismatch between squared-error latent prediction and the conditional structure of language. The key requirement is conditional concentration: given a context and target location, the target representation should lie near a single meaningful point. Local image prediction often satisfies this through spatial continuity, whereas masked text can admit multiple valid token or span completions whose representations need not share a coherent center. We formalize this mismatch through three conditions---predictability, non-collapse, and low conditional variance---and show how their failure creates centroid degeneracy and collapse pressure in text. Matched I-JEPA and T-JEPA experiments reveal the predicted sequence: mutual-information saturation and elevated target variance precede train--validation instability, effective-rank degeneration, cosine collapse, and poor downstream transfer. The same pattern appears across five independent data seeds, indicating that it is not a sampling artifact. These results do not rule out predictive learning for language; they show that text-compatible JEPA objectives must preserve multiple plausible completions rather than compress them into a single latent point.

AI.title_translation: 语言中的JEPA悖论：语言替代项的几何学
AI.tldr: 本文揭示了确定性JEPA风格的潜在预测在文本领域失败的原因：由于文本中存在多种合法的补全项，平方误差预测会导致中心简并和模型坍塌，因此文本兼容的JEPA必须能保留多种合理的预测结果。
AI.motivation: 探究为什么联合嵌入预测架构（JEPA）在图像、视频和音频中非常有效，但在文本编码器中却未能成为标准目标的深层原因。
AI.method: 通过形式化三个条件（可预测性、非坍塌性和低条件方差）来分析平方误差潜在预测与语言条件结构之间的错配，并在匹配的I-JEPA和T-JEPA实验中观察多数据种子的训练动力学与转移性能。
AI.result: 实验揭示了预测序列：互信息饱和与目标方差升高先于训练-验证不稳定、有效秩退化、余弦坍塌以及下游迁移性能差，且这一模式在五个独立数据种子中一致出现。
AI.conclusion: 文本兼容的JEPA目标函数必须能够保存多个合理的完成项，而不是将它们压缩为单一的潜在点。
AI.translation: 联合嵌入预测架构（JEPA）对图像、视频和音频非常有效，但确定性的JEPA风格潜在预测尚未成为文本编码器的标准目标。我们认为，这种差距反映了平方误差潜在预测与语言条件结构之间的错配。关键要求是条件集中度：给定上下文和目标位置，目标表示应位于单个有意义的点附近。局部图像预测通常通过空间连续性满足这一点，而掩码文本可以容纳多个有效的标记或跨度补全，其表示不需要共享一个相干的中心。我们通过三个条件——可预测性、非坍塌性和低条件方差——将这种错配形式化，并展示了它们的失效如何在文本中产生中心简并和坍塌压力。匹配的I-JEPA和T-JEPA实验揭示了预测序列：互信息饱和和升高的目标方差先于训练-验证不稳定、有效秩退化、余弦坍塌以及较差的下游迁移。同样的模式出现在五个独立的数据种子中，表明它不是采样伪影。这些结果并不排除语言的预测学习；它们表明，文本兼容的JEPA目标必须保留多个合理的补全，而不是将它们压缩为单个潜在点。
AI.summary: 该论文研究了联合嵌入预测架构（JEPA）在文本领域应用时面临的几何困境。作者指出，文本中掩码位置常存在多个合法的补全项，平方误差潜在预测会导致中心简并和坍塌压力。实验证实了这一理论分析，表明文本兼容的JEPA必须支持多点预测而非单点压缩。
AI.keywords: Joint-Embedding Predictive Architectures, 语言模型, 潜在预测, 条件方差, 几何坍塌
AI.comments: 该论文深入探讨了联合嵌入预测架构（JEPA）在文本领域应用受限的根本原因，通过理论形式化和实验验证揭示了几何上的冲突（中心简并和坍塌压力），为未来文本兼容的JEPA设计指明了方向。

title: Mission-Level Runtime Assurance for LLM-Assisted ISR Swarms over a Verification-Aware Fabric
summary: Swarms of LLM-assisted autonomous robots are increasingly proposed for cooperative intelligence, surveillance, and reconnaissance (ISR) in contested environments. A growing class of their assurance failures arises not within any single platform but across the swarm: individually-compliant actions compose into a mission-level violation: a prohibited objective split across platforms to evade per-platform lim- its, or a collective budget quietly exceeded. Per-platform guardrails miss these by construction, and contested communications let the violation hide behind lost or delayed evidence. We present a three-tier (platfor- m/squad/mission) compositional runtime-verification framework that de- composes a mission policy into per-agent and cross-agent aspects, aggre- gates per-platform verdicts over a verification-aware messaging fabric, and fuses them with an evidence-aware, two-axis (security x complete- ness) algebra whose provenance names the platforms that jointly trig- gered a violation. Because the fabric makes evidence loss and silence observable, unsupported negative verdicts are downgraded to an explicit unknown rather than reported as mission-wide all-clears. On a simulated ISR mission, an indirect prompt injection that causes real LLM planners to split a prohibited collection task across four platforms is invisible to every per-platform monitor yet detected compositionally with full prove- nance; under an injected fault campaign a best-effort central monitor emits silent false all-clears while the verification-aware fabric emits none

AI.title_translation: 面向具备验证感知架构的大模型辅助ISR集群的任务级运行时保障
AI.tldr: 提出了一种三层运行时验证框架和通信架构，解决了大模型机器人集群中跨平台的任务级安全违规检测与通信丢失问题。
AI.motivation: 现有的单平台安全护栏无法检测多平台协同产生的任务级违规行为，且在对抗性通信环境下，证据丢失或延迟会导致违规行为被掩盖。
AI.method: 提出了一种三层（平台/小队/任务）组合式运行时验证框架，结合验证感知的消息传输架构以及基于安全性和完整性的双轴代数，实现对分布式违规的溯源和检测。
AI.result: 在模拟的ISR任务中，该框架成功检测出被四个平台分摊的间歇性提示注入违规行为，并具备完整溯源能力；在注入故障的实验中，避免了传统中心化监控器产生静默错误全绿（false all-clears）的情况。
AI.conclusion: 该论文提出的三层运行时验证框架与验证感知底层通信架构能够有效检测并处理LLM集群在对抗环境下的任务级违规与通信故障，显著提升了系统的安全可靠性。
AI.translation: 由大语言模型（LLM）辅助的自主机器人集群越来越多地被提议用于对抗环境中的协同情报、监视和侦察（ISR）。它们的一类日益增长的安全保障失败不是发生在单个平台内部，而是跨越整个集群：单个合规的动作组合成了任务级别的违规：即为了逃避单个平台的限制而将违规目标拆分到多个平台执行，或者悄悄超出了集体预算。单平台护栏在设计上无法发现这些问题，而在对抗性通信环境下，丢失或延迟的证据则使违规行为得以隐藏。我们提出了一种三层（平台/小队/任务）组合式运行时验证框架，该框架将任务策略分解为按代理和跨代理的方面，通过具备验证感知的消息传输 fabric 聚合各平台的判定结果，并将其与一个证据感应的双轴（安全性 x 完整性）代数相融合，该代数的来源标识了共同触发违规的平台。由于该通信架构使证据丢失和沉默变得可观察，不受支持的否定判定将被降级为显式的未知状态，而不是报告为全网的安全全绿（all-clears）。在一次模拟的ISR任务中，一个导致真实LLM规划器将禁止的收集任务拆分到四个平台的间接提示注入，对于每个单平台监控器来说都是不可见的，但通过组合式方法被检测到并带有完整的来源信息；在注入的故障攻击活动中，尽力而为的中央监控器会发出静默的错误全绿信号，而具备验证感知的 fabric 则没有发出任何此类信号。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种针对大模型辅助的ISR机器人集群的任务级运行时验证框架。通过三层组合验证和验证感知的消息架构，解决了单平台护栏无法发现跨平台协同违规以及对抗通信掩盖证据的问题，实验证明了其有效性和鲁棒性。
AI.keywords: 大语言模型集群, 运行时验证, 智能监视与侦察, 分布式安全保障
AI.comments: 该论文针对大模型辅助的机器人集群在ISR任务中的安全保障问题，创新性地提出了三层组合式运行时验证框架和具备验证意识的通信架构，有效解决了分布式违规和通信受限带来的安全盲区，具有很高的实用价值和理论意义。

title: Sensitivity Analysis of Dynamic Line Rating for ACSR Conductors using IEEE-738
summary: Dynamic Line Rating (DLR) is a novel technique that enhances the utilization of transmission line capacity. It is nevertheless unclear how much measurement uncertainty in important environmental parameters affects the DLR calculation. Using the IEEE-738 standard, this paper presents a systematic parametric sensitivity analysis of DLR for a 795 kcmil ACSR Drake conductor. The DLR computation encompasses 832 operating points which includes daytime/nighttime solar scenarios, clear/non-clear atmospheric clearness conditions, wind speeds ranging from 0 to 15.25 m/s, and ambient temperatures between 15 and 50 degrees Celsius. According to sensitivity analysis, wind sensitivity tends to decrease at higher ambient temperatures, whereas temperature sensitivity tends to increase with wind speed. Pearson correlation analysis indicates a strong negative linear association between DLR and ambient temperature, and a strong positive linear association with wind speed. A regression model incorporates both individual and interactive effects of wind and temperature, and explains over 93% of the observed DLR variability across all cases. Finally, the observations serve as a guide for operational planning and uncertainty assessment in DLR-based transmission systems.

AI.title_translation: 基于IEEE-738的ACSR导线动态增容敏感性分析
AI.tldr: 本文利用IEEE-738标准分析了环境变量对ACSR导线动态增容（DLR）的影响，发现风速和环境温度是决定DLR的核心因素，并构建了高解释度的回归模型。
AI.motivation: 动态增容（DLR）是提升输电线路容量的新技术，但关键环境变量的测量不确定性对DLR计算的具体影响尚不明确，因此需要进行系统的敏感性分析。
AI.method: 利用IEEE-738标准，对795 kcmil ACSR Drake导线在涵盖不同昼夜、大气条件、风速（0-15.25 m/s）和环境温度（15-50℃）的832个运行点进行了系统的参数敏感性分析、Pearson相关性分析以及回归建模。

AI.conclusion: 本研究通过敏感性分析和回归建模，阐明了环境变量对DLR计算的影响规律，为基于DLR的输电系统运维规划和不确定性评估提供了重要指导。

title: ObsDriveBench: Benchmarking Multimodal Understanding under Adverse Weather with Observability Awareness
summary: Autonomous driving under adverse weather remains a critical challenge, yet existing vision-language benchmarks mainly evaluate under standard conditions, synthetic corruptions, or single modality. As a result, it remains unclear how vision-language models behave under real-world adverse weather with multi-modal inputs. We argue that a key difficulty lies in degraded environmental observability: under fog, rain, snow, and low illumination, multi-modal observations become unreliable and cross-modally inconsistent, posing challenges to scene understanding, and subsequent decision-making. To study this, we introduce \textbf{ObsDriveBench}, a real-world multi-modal benchmark for adverse-weather autonomous driving. Our benchmark is designed with three capability dimensions: \textbf{observability awareness}, \textbf{spatial reliability}, and \textbf{risk-aware decision-making}, enabling fine-grained diagnosis of model behavior under degraded observations. We construct the benchmark through observability meta-annotation, scene description, and capability oriented multiple-choice tasks over synchronized camera, LiDAR, and radar inputs, forming a benchmark with over 14k training and 13k test questions. Experiments reveal consistent performance degradation of existing vision-language models. We further introduce \textbf{ObsDrive} model with normal-weather supervised fine-tuning and adverse-weather reinforcement learning, improving robustness across all three capabilities. The dataset and evaluation code will be released at \href{https://github.com/russellyq/ObsDriveBench}{\texttt{ObsDriveBench}}.

AI.title_translation: ObsDriveBench：基于可观测性感知的恶劣天气下多模态理解基准评测
AI.tldr: 本文推出了ObsDriveBench基准和ObsDrive模型，用于评估和提升多模态视觉语言模型在恶劣天气自动驾驶中的鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉-语言基准主要在标准条件、合成损坏或单一模态下评估，缺乏对真实世界恶劣天气下多模态输入和环境可观测性退化行为的研究。
AI.method: 构建了ObsDriveBench基准，包含可观测性元标注、场景描述以及面向能力的的多项选择任务，覆盖相机、LiDAR和雷达输入；并提出了结合正常天气监督微调与恶劣天气强化学习的ObsDrive模型。
AI.result: 实验表明现有视觉语言模型在恶劣天气下性能显著下降；而提出的ObsDrive模型在可观测性感知、空间可靠性和风险决策三个能力维度上均展现出了更好的鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: ObsDriveBench为评估和提升多模态大模型在恶劣天气自动驾驶中的鲁棒性提供了一个全面的真实世界基准，而提出的ObsDrive模型也证明了强化学习在应对降级观测时的有效性。
AI.translation: 在恶劣天气下的自动驾驶仍然是一个严峻的挑战，然而现有的视觉-语言基准主要在标准条件、合成损坏或单一模态下进行评估。因此，视觉-语言模型在具有多模态输入的真实恶劣天气下的表现仍不明确。我们认为，一个关键的困难在于环境可观测性的退化：在雾、雨、雪和低光照条件下，多模态观测变得不可靠且跨模态不一致，这对场景理解和后续决策构成了挑战。为了研究这一点，我们推出了 ObsDriveBench，这是一个用于恶劣天气自动驾驶的真实世界多模态基准。我们的基准设计了三个能力维度：可观测性感知、空间可靠性和风险感知决策，从而能够对模型在退化观测下的行为进行细粒度诊断。我们通过可观测性元注释、场景描述和针对相机、LiDAR和雷达输入同步的多选题任务来构建该基准，形成了一个包含超过 14k 个训练问题和 13k 个测试问题的基准。实验揭示了现有视觉-语言模型性能的一致性下降。我们进一步推出了 ObsDrive 模型，该模型采用正常天气下的监督微调和恶劣天气下的强化学习，提高了所有三个能力的鲁棒性。数据集和评估代码将在 https://github.com/russellyq/ObsDriveBench 发布。
AI.summary: 论文提出了ObsDriveBench——一个基于真实世界、多模态、考虑可观测性感知的恶劣天气自动驾驶基准，包含三大能力维度和海量问答对，并推出了通过强化学习提升鲁棒性的ObsDrive模型。
AI.keywords: 自动驾驶, 恶劣天气, 多模态理解, 基准测试, 视觉语言模型
AI.comments: 该论文填补了现有视觉语言模型在恶劣天气和多模态融合自动驾驶基准上的空白，通过引入可观测性感知、空间可靠性和风险决策三个维度，以及ObsDrive模型，对提升自动驾驶在复杂环境下的鲁棒性具有重要意义。

title: Guiding Language Models to Be More Empathetic: Culturally Sensitive Mental Health Advice Generation Through Human-LLM Collaboration
summary: Despite recent advances in large language models (LLMs), their ability to generate empathetic mental health counseling responses in low-resource languages remains largely unexplored. To address this gap, we curate 625 authentic mental health cases from three complementary sources: (1) publicly available Facebook posts discussing mental health concerns, (2) transcripts from the Bangladeshi television program "Ami Akhon Ki Korbo", and (3) anonymized student questionnaire responses covering diverse emotional and psychological challenges. Based on these cases, we build an evaluation corpus comprising advice written by licensed clinical psychologists and responses generated by three modern proprietary LLMs: GPT-4o Mini, Claude 4.5 Haiku, and Gemini 2.5 Pro. We further propose the Role-Playing Reflective Chain-of-Thought Advisory Framework (RP-RCAF), a task-specific prompting strategy that combines expert-authored few-shot examples with structured self-reflection to produce supportive, culturally aware, and ethically aligned counseling through a compassionate advisor persona. We also introduce the Grok 4-Based Response Evaluation and Scoring Framework (G-REFS), which integrates automated assessment with expert psychologist validation across emotional sensitivity, cultural appropriateness, linguistic clarity, and ethical soundness. Experimental results show that RP-RCAF consistently outperforms conventional prompting across all evaluated models and produces responses that more closely align with professional psychological counseling.

title: Private Again: AI Agents Restore Anonymity---Foreclosing Discrimination and Its Proof
summary: AI agents can transact online on behalf of a human principal---browsing, paying, receiving, and reviewing---without linking a transaction to a principal. That architecture starves algorithmic discrimination of its inputs---identity, purchase history, location history, behavioral traces, and demographic proxies---but also forecloses its proof. Disparate-treatment needs comparators; disparate-impact needs protected-class baselines; and Iqbal-era pleading needs specific factual allegations---doctrinal predicates that anonymous transactions never generate. The effects fall asymmetrically: those most vulnerable to discrimination are least able to afford the shield and, when harms remain, least able to prove them. The challenge for the law shifts from detecting and remedying algorithmic discrimination to governing agent-mediated anonymity as civil rights infrastructure: ensuring access to privacy-preserving agents, regulating abuse without forced identification, and deciding whether retailers may refuse to deal with agents at all.

title: GaitFace: A Multimodal Dataset for Long-Range Person Identification
summary: Efficient border control is becoming a significant global challenge, mainly due to severe congestion and extended passenger waiting times. To mitigate these bottlenecks and facilitate passenger flow, biometric technologies are increasingly deployed to streamline identity verification and enhance crossing efficiency. Technical limitations frequently impede biometric identification, particularly in long-range surveillance, where systems must deal with adverse atmospheric conditions and degraded image quality. While high-quality frameworks like BRIAR exist, they are frequently restricted to specific government agencies. This paper introduces GaitFace, a new public dataset that contains face and gait data captured at long distances. To ensure that the research reflects authentic border scenarios, we use Pre-Enrollment data, where a traveler registers via a mobile device, and "In-the-Wild" captures, which records individuals at a distance across multiple viewing angles and different cameras. Benchmarking SOTA face and gait models reveals that current architectures fail under low-resolution and elevated viewpoints despite success with optical assistance. GaitFace exposes these critical vulnerabilities, providing a rigorous public benchmark to drive more robust, unconstrained biometric research.

title: Language Shapes Instruction Hierarchy Compliance in Multilingual LLMs
comments: Code and data are available at https://github.com/g1moon/Language-Shapes-IH
summary: Instruction hierarchy (IH) requires models to prioritize instructions by source, ensuring that higher-priority instructions override lower-priority ones. Despite its importance for safe and controllable deployment, existing evaluations have focused almost exclusively on English, leaving it unclear whether IH compliance remains stable in multilingual settings. We introduce XIH-Bench, a benchmark for multilingual IH evaluation with both same-language and cross-language conflicts across six languages, four domains, and three IH settings. Across models, we find two consistent patterns. First, IH compliance exhibits a clear language-dependent asymmetry: a language that strengthens compliance in the higher-priority position can become disruptive in the lower-priority position. Second, cross-language conflicts yield higher compliance than same-language conflicts, a phenomenon we term the Language Boundary Effect. We further show that language specialization can make lower-priority instructions in model-favored languages harder to override, creating multilingual reliability and security risks.
comment: Code and data are available at https://github.com/g1moon/Language-Shapes-IH

title: Optimal Microgrid Operation with Open-cycle Ocean Thermal Energy Conversion for Islands
comments: 10 pages, 8 figures, submitted to IEEE Transactions on Smart Grid
summary: Ocean thermal energy conversion (OTEC) is a zero-carbon technology that harnesses the ocean's thermal gradient to generate electricity. Among OTEC variants, open-cycle OTEC is particularly attractive to island communities, as it can co-generate electricity and freshwater. This paper develops an integrated model that captures both the thermodynamic process of open-cycle OTEC and its operational role in an island microgrid. A two-stage robust scheduling model is formulated for the island microgrid, with a budget uncertainty set to capture the renewable output deviations. The resulting model is solved via an inexact column-and-constraint generation algorithm, which accelerates convergence by permitting inexact solutions of the first-stage problem in early iterations. Numerical experiments demonstrate that open-cycle OTEC can fully substitute for conventional generators on island microgrids and provide more reliable and dispatchable output than volatile renewable sources.
comment: 10 pages, 8 figures, submitted to IEEE Transactions on Smart Grid

title: A Fixed-Parameter Algorithm for Extending Upward Planar Drawings
comments: Conference version to appear in Graph Drawing (GD 2026)
summary:
An upward planar drawing of a directed acyclic graph is a planar drawing where every edge is pointed upward from its tail to head. Upward planar drawings are among the most natural drawing styles of directed graphs and have been researched in a variety of different settings, recently including that of drawing extension. In the drawing extension setting, one asks: given a graph $G$ and a (typically connected) subgraph $H$ of $G$ with a drawing $Γ(H)$, can we complete $Γ(H)$ to a drawing of $G$?
  Drawing extension problems have been studied for numerous drawing styles; the vast majority of these are NP-hard and a typical approach aimed at circumventing their intractability is to design parameterized algorithms where the parameter measures "how much" of $G$ is still missing from the pre-drawn graph $H$. Most algorithms obtained within this framework require only a small number of edges to be missing from $H$ in order to remain efficient. In this article, we present a fixed-parameter algorithm for extending upward planar drawings which overcomes this drawback by using the $\textit{vertex+edge deletion distance}$ as the parameter, thus achieving tractability even for instances with many missing edges. A key ingredient towards our result is a novel characterization of "canonical" sets of missing edges which cross a horizontal line segment in the drawing.
comment: Conference version to appear in Graph Drawing (GD 2026)

title: Tempo: Reconstructing Synchronous Reactive Programming with OCaml 5 Effects
comments: 17 pages, 2 figures, 8 listings. Accepted at PPDP 2026; this is the submitted version
summary: Synchronous reactive programming gives reactive systems a deterministic temporal structure by organizing execution into logical instants and signal-based communication. Boussinot's synchronous reactive model extends this setting with cooperative threads, broadcast signals, and dynamic processes; ReactiveML brings that model into a strict, typed, higher-order functional language. This paper studies whether the same core mechanisms can be reconstructed inside ordinary OCaml 5, rather than exposed by a dedicated language extension. We present Tempo, a library runtime based on algebraic effects and deep handlers: effect operations delimit reactive suspension points, and the handler reifies captured continuations as tasks scheduled by logical-instant semantics. A comparative study with ReactiveML quantifies the overhead of this library-level reconstruction and identifies the runtime mechanisms that dominate its cost.
comment: 17 pages, 2 figures, 8 listings. Accepted at PPDP 2026; this is the submitted version

title: Collusion-Resistant Image-Agnostic Watermarking for Multi-Screen Shooting
summary: Screen-shooting poses a significant threat to confidential information protection. While existing screen-shooting watermarking methods enable copyright verification, the copyrighted images carrying the same copyright watermark across different screens often exhibit highly similar and estimable watermark patterns. These shared patterns can be exploited for watermark removal and forgery, a threat we term the multi-screen collusion attack. To mitigate this threat, we propose CoMSMark, a collusion-resistant image-agnostic watermarking framework for multi-screen shooting, which reduces shared residual components across screens to resist multi-screen collusion attacks. Specifically, we incorporate screen ID through a style modulation mechanism, enabling the encoder to generate screen-specific watermark residuals for reliable source attribution. We further introduce a collusion suppression loss that reduces shared residual components and encourages high-entropy predictions for forged samples, improving resistance to collusion attacks. Finally, to enable efficient large-scale distribution, CoMSMark employs an image-agnostic encoding paradigm that generates watermark residuals independently of image content. Extensive experiments demonstrate that CoMSMark effectively resists both collusion-based watermark removal and forgery. It maintains an average watermark accuracy above 90% under removal attacks while keeping forged-watermark accuracy near 50%. Moreover, CoMSMark achieves competitive robustness under diverse screen-shooting conditions, including varying capture distances and angles.

title: Neonatal Hypoxic-ischaemic Encephalopathy Classification from the EEG and HRV Signals Using a Conformer based Masked Autoencoder
comments: Paper submits to IEEE Transactions on Neural Networks and Learning Systems
summary: In this paper, we propose the MAEConformer, a novel self-supervised learning framework that combines the Conformer architecture with the Masked Autoencoder (MAE) paradigm for large-scale representation learning from unlabelled electroencephalography (EEG) and heart rate variability (HRV) signals. By integrating convolutional operations with Transformer-based self-attention, MAEConformer effectively captures both local temporal patterns and long-range contextual dependencies in physiological time series. To enhance reconstruction fidelity and representation quality, a multi-resolution short-time Fourier transform (MR-STFT) loss is incorporated alongside the reconstruction objective, enabling the model to jointly learn temporal and spectral characteristics across multiple scales. Modality-specific EEG and HRV MAEConformer models were pretrained on 6,030h and 4,868h of unlabelled recordings, respectively, and subsequently transferred to expert-annotated downstream tasks. Experimental results demonstrate that the learned representations provide strong transferability and data efficiency. In EEG-based hypoxic ischemic encephalopathy (HIE) severity classification, the pretrained MAE-EEG model achieved test AUCs of 97.19% and 96.56% for binary and four-class classification tasks, respectively, outperforming a range of state-of-the-art supervised and self-supervised baselines. On the HRV-based HIE severity classification task, MAE-HRV achieved a test AUC of 82.42%, surpassing both self-supervised Transformer-based and supervised convolutional baselines. These findings demonstrate the effectiveness of MAEConformer for learning robust and transferable representations across multiple physiological modalities.
comment: Paper submits to IEEE Transactions on Neural Networks and Learning Systems

title: GTIN: A Unified Framework for Joint Event and Time Prediction in Temporal Graphs
summary: Temporal graphs are increasingly used to model dynamic systems in diverse domains such as social networks, financial networks, and traffic networks. Predicting both what the next event will be and when it will occur in these systems is crucial for understanding and anticipating complex behaviors, but has not been studied much. To address this gap, we propose a unified mathematical framework capable of capturing varying degrees of complexity across temporal graphs. Our framework is flexible and expressive enough to accommodate a wide range of network structures and temporal dynamics. Building upon this analysis, we introduce our novel approach for jointly predicting the next event and its occurrence time. Empirical evaluations across multiple datasets demonstrate that our method consistently outperforms existing techniques, particularly in scenarios involving irregular event patterns and complex temporal dependencies. These findings highlight the potential of our framework as a robust foundation for future research in temporal event prediction.

title: An Unofficial FastLAS Tutorial: A Programmer's Guide
comments: 49 pages. A tutorial on the FastLAS input language. All examples are verified against FastLAS 2.2.0 and clingo 5.8.0; the accompanying task files are available at https://github.com/dasaro/fastlas_manual
summary: FastLAS is a scalable system for Inductive Logic Programming (ILP): you give it some background knowledge, a language bias, and a set of examples, and it searches for a set of logic program rules (a hypothesis) that explains the examples. These notes are a hands-on introduction to writing FastLAS programs. They are organised as a programmer's guide: syntax first, then a ladder of worked, numbered examples of increasing difficulty. Every self-contained example here has been run against FastLAS 2.2.0 and shows the tool's actual output. We keep theory to the minimum needed to write correct programs; throughout, set-off notes flag where FastLAS differs from its sibling system ILASP, and where the two learning algorithms (--opl and --nopl) behave differently. The document is intended as an unofficial tutorial to FastLAS 2.2.0, not as an official language specification.
comment: 49 pages. A tutorial on the FastLAS input language. All examples are verified against FastLAS 2.2.0 and clingo 5.8.0; the accompanying task files are available at https://github.com/dasaro/fastlas_manual

title: Paged Geophylogenies: A Coloring Approach to External Labeling with Tree Constraints
comments: Appears in the Proceedings of the 34th International Symposium on Graph Drawing and Network Visualization (GD 2026); 29 pages, 27 figures
summary: Geophylogenies are a common type of diagram for visualizing the evolutionary history of species in a geographic context. As a drawing problem, these diagrams are commonly modeled as a rooted binary ''phylogenetic'' tree $T$ where every leaf is associated with a point feature (''site'') in a rectangular map range. The tree is drawn downward planar, its leaves are placed at equidistant positions on the upper boundary of the map, and each leaf is connected to its corresponding site by a straight-line leader. Prior work focuses on minimizing the number of leader crossings, or avoiding leaders altogether. In this paper, we explore paged geophylogenies, where the leaders can be partitioned into multiple pages where only crossings within a page are counted. For the general case, where each page can contain an arbitrary subset of the leaders, we provide an integer linear programming (ILP) formulation for minimizing the number of pages, and a polynomial-time algorithm for a special case that is equivalent to a one-sided tanglegram. We argue that, from a visualization perspective, instead each page must contain only leaders for a single subtree, and provide an $\mathcal{O}(n^7)$ time algorithm for minimizing pages in this setting - which also involves improving the fastest known algorithm for testing the existence of a crossing-free labeling. Counter to what our worst case bound suggests, our implementation can handle instances with hundreds of sites within a second, as we show in our experimental evaluation, which further investigates the trade-offs between leader crossings and the number of pages.
comment: Appears in the Proceedings of the 34th International Symposium on Graph Drawing and Network Visualization (GD 2026); 29 pages, 27 figures

title: Towards a Relevance Posterior in Neural Information Access
summary: Modern information retrieval systems typically operationalise relevance as a query-conditional score computed at inference time. This design choice has become dominant such that alternative decompositions of relevance are rarely discussed, despite the long history of document and query priors in probabilistic retrieval and large-scale search. As neural ranking models grow more computationally expensive and retrieval pipelines expand to include multi-stage ranking, recommendation, and retrieval-augmented generation, this monolithic view of query-time scoring becomes increasingly limiting. We argue that modern information access systems are more naturally understood as performing approximate posterior inference, in which relevance is refined through a staged combination of query-dependent likelihoods and query-independent priors. We extend classical probabilistic retrieval formalisms to contemporary learned systems and show how explicit likelihood-prior decomposition exposes new opportunities to shift computation offline while disentangling document-level and interaction-level beliefs. We present empirical evidence that incorporating query-independent document utility can complement existing rankers and improve effectiveness with minimal query-time computation (solely score fusion). Concretely, a learned prior improves first-stage retrieval through rank fusion (up to 0.046 nDCG@10 on TREC DL-2019 and 0.029 nDCG@10 on TREC DL-2020) and also improves downstream re-ranking, with the largest gains observed for the LLM re-ranker RankZephyr (up to 0.054 nDCG@10 on TREC DL-2020). Finally, we discuss how this decomposition connects to broader information access and outline research directions for designing retrieval systems that explicitly allocate modelling capacity between offline priors and online interaction.

title: Random Forest-Based Prediction of Bone Volume Fraction and Fracture Position from S-Parameters
comments: 5 pages,6 figures,This is a summary report prepared by undergraduate students I supervised, formatted as a letter
summary: In this paper, we propose a method for predicting bone volume fraction (BVF) and fracture position by constructing a random forest model based on multichannel S-parameters. A nine-antenna microwave scanning system is designed and fabricated to acquire the multichannel S-parameter data. Bone-mimicking phantoms are developed, and corresponding experiments are conducted to validate the effectiveness of the proposed approach. Both synthetic and experimental results demonstrate the validity of the method.
comment: 5 pages,6 figures,This is a summary report prepared by undergraduate students I supervised, formatted as a letter

title: Anticipatory Risk-Guided Reinforcement Learning for Safe Flight Through Dynamic Clutter
comments: 8 pages, 7 figures. Accepted to the 2026 IEEE/RSJ International Conference on Intelligent Robots and Systems (IROS 2026)
summary: Safe quadrotor navigation in cluttered and dynamic environments depends not only on instantaneous geometric perception, but more critically on anticipating collision risks induced by relative motion. Conventional modular pipelines frequently suffer from perception latency, while end-to-end learning methods relying on implicit scalar rewards often struggle to extract reliable spatio-temporal features without physics-grounded supervision. To address this, we propose an anticipatory risk-guided reinforcement learning framework. Leveraging privileged simulator states, we construct a directionally aligned future collision risk map based on the Closest Point of Approach (CPA). Through an asymmetric actor-critic architecture, the network is trained to self-predict this structured risk, which explicitly guides the visual policy during deployment. A lightweight spatio-temporal encoder extracts motion cues directly from onboard depth sequences, bypassing explicit object tracking or optical flow estimation. Extensive simulated and real-world experiments demonstrate that our method effectively improves safety margins and flight efficiency in dense dynamic clutters compared to existing baselines. Furthermore, the learned policy achieves robust zero-shot Sim-to-Real transfer on a physical quadrotor, relying purely on abstracted spatio-temporal depth sequences and its self-predicted risk priors, validating the effectiveness of our approach and its robust generalization from simulation to reality.
comment: 8 pages, 7 figures. Accepted to the 2026 IEEE/RSJ International Conference on Intelligent Robots and Systems (IROS 2026)

title: Adaptive Consistency for Mimetic Finite Differences
summary: The mimetic finite difference (MFD) method provides a robust discretization for flow simulation on general polyhedral meshes, but its computational cost can become significant due to dense local operators and reduced global sparsity. While the two-point flux approximation (TPFA) offers a substantially cheaper alternative, its accuracy is generally restricted to $K$-orthogonal grids. To balance these competing considerations, we present an adaptive MFD framework based on a residual-based consistency indicator derived from the discrete constitutive equations. The indicator measures local inconsistency and enables adaptive TPFA/MFD stencil selection through a user-prescribed tolerance $τ$. Because the adaptation is performed within a mimetic framework, arbitrary TPFA/MFD partitions remain stable and structure preserving. Theoretical analysis establishes uniform coercivity and proves explicit tolerance-controlled convergence of the relative flux error. Numerical experiments on challenging polyhedral reservoir benchmarks demonstrate accuracy comparable to full MFD discretizations while substantially reducing matrix density and computational cost.

title: Optimal Polynomial Tractability Exponents for the Inverse Star Discrepancy
summary:
The inverse of the star discrepancy $n^\ast(d, \varepsilon)$ satisfies \[ d \varepsilon^{-1} \lesssim n^{\ast}(d,\varepsilon)\lesssim d\varepsilon^{-2} \] for all $d \in \mathbb{N}$ and $0 < \varepsilon < \varepsilon_0$. The upper bound was shown by Heinrich, Novak, Wasilkowski and Woźniakowski (2001) and the lower bound was shown by Hinrichs (2004). A proof of this lower bound using elementary arguments was shown by Steinerberger (2023). These bounds show that the inverse of the star discrepancy depends linearly on the dimension, but the exact exponent of $\varepsilon^{-1}$ has remained open.
  In this paper we prove a lower bound which shows that the exponent $2$ of $\varepsilon^{-1}$ in the upper bound cannot be improved. More precisely, we show that for every $0<α<1$ and fixed $0<A\le B$, there are constants $c_{α,B}>0$ and $\varepsilon_{α,A}>0$ such that for every integer $d$ satisfying \[
  A\varepsilon^{-α}\le d\le B\varepsilon^{-α} \] we have \[ n^{\ast}(d,\varepsilon)
  \ge c_{α,B}\,d\,\varepsilon^{-(2-α)}, \] for all $0 < \varepsilon < \varepsilon_{α, A}$. Along these polynomial strips the right-hand side is of order $\varepsilon^{-2}$.
  It follows that every uniform polynomial upper estimate $n^{\ast}(d,\varepsilon)\le C d^q\varepsilon^{-p}$ must satisfy $p \ge 2$. Together with the lower bound of Hinrichs (2004), which forces $q \ge 1$, this shows that the exponents $p=2$ and $q=1$ in the Heinrich--Novak--Wasilkowski--Woźniakowski upper bound are individually optimal.

AI.title_translation: 逆星号偏差的最优多项式可驯性指数
AI.tldr: 本文证明了逆星号偏差上界估计中的指数 p=2 和 q=1 分别都是最优的，解决了该领域长期未决的指数优化问题。
AI.motivation: 已知星号偏差逆 $n^\ast(d, \varepsilon)$ 满足线性维数依赖 $d \varepsilon^{-1} \lesssim n^{\ast}(d,\varepsilon)\lesssim d\varepsilon^{-2}$，但其中 $\varepsilon^{-1}$ 的确切最优指数一直悬而未决，本文旨在确定该指数的最优性。
AI.method: 通过证明在形如 $A\varepsilon^{-\alpha} \le d \le B\varepsilon^{-\alpha}$ 的多项式带（polynomial strips）上，下界满足 $n^{\ast}(d,\varepsilon) \ge c_{\alpha,B}\,d\,\varepsilon^{-(2-\alpha)}$（其右侧阶数为 $\varepsilon^{-2}$），从而推导出多项式上界中的指数约束。
AI.result: 证明了任何统一的多项式上界估计 $n^{\ast}(d,\varepsilon)\le C d^q\varepsilon^{-p}$ 必须满足 $p \ge 2$。结合已知结果 $q \ge 1$，表明上界估计中的指数 $p=2$ 和 $q=1$ 分别都是最优的。
AI.conclusion: Heinrich--Novak--Wasilkowski--Woźniakowski 提出的星号偏差逆上界中的指数 $p=2$ 和 $q=1$ 分别都是最优的，无法进一步改进。
AI.translation:
星号偏差的逆 $n^\ast(d, \varepsilon)$ 对所有 $d \in \mathbb{N}$ 和 $0 < \varepsilon < \varepsilon_0$ 满足 $d \varepsilon^{-1} \lesssim n^{\ast}(d,\varepsilon)\lesssim d\varepsilon^{-2}$。上界由 Heinrich, Novak, Wasilkowski 和 Woźniakowski (2001) 证明，下界由 Hinrichs (2004) 证明。Steinerberger (2023) 给出了该下界的一个初等证明。这些界限表明星号偏差的逆线性依赖于维数，但 $\varepsilon^{-1}$ 的确切指数一直悬而未决。
在本文中，我们证明了一个下界，表明在上界中 $\varepsilon^{-1}$ 的指数 2 是无法改进的。更准确地说，我们证明了对于每个 $0<\alpha<1$ 和固定的 $0<A\le B$，存在常数 $c_{\alpha,B}>0$ 和 $\varepsilon_{\alpha,A}>0$，使得对于满足 $A\varepsilon^{-\alpha}\le d\le B\varepsilon^{-\alpha}$ 的每个整数 $d$，对所有 $0 < \varepsilon < \varepsilon_{\alpha, A}$，我们有 $n^{\ast}(d,\varepsilon) \ge c_{\alpha,B}\,d\,\varepsilon^{-(2-\alpha)}$。沿着这些多项式带，右侧的阶数为 $\varepsilon^{-2}$。
由此可知，任何统一的多项式上界估计 $n^{\ast}(d,\varepsilon)\le C d^q\varepsilon^{-p}$ 必须满足 $p \ge 2$。结合 Hinrichs (2004) 强制要求的 $q \ge 1$ 下界，这表明 Heinrich--Novak--Wasilkowski--Woźniakowski 上界中的指数 $p=2$ 和 $q=1$ 分别都是最优的。
AI.summary: 本文研究了星号偏差逆 $n^\ast(d, \varepsilon)$ 的多项式可驯性指数问题。先前研究已知其界限介于 $d\varepsilon^{-1}$ 与 $d\varepsilon^{-2}$ 之间，但 $\varepsilon^{-1}$ 的精准指数未定。本文通过在多项式带上建立新的下界，证明了上界估计 $n^\ast(d,\varepsilon)\le C d^q\varepsilon^{-p}$ 中的指数必须满足 $p \ge 2$。结合现有的 $q \ge 1$ 结论，最终证明了已知上界中的指数 $p=2$ 和 $q=1$ 均为个体最优。
AI.keywords: 星号偏差, 逆星号偏差, 可驯性指数, 多项式可驯性, 理论下界
AI.comments: 本论文成功解决了高维数值积分与数论网格领域中关于星号偏差逆（inverse star discrepancy）界限指数的长期悬而未决的问题。其创新之处在于通过构造多项式带区间，成功证明了指数 p=2 的不可改进性，从而确定了 Heinrich 等人 (2001) 上界的个体最优性，对连续性可驯性理论（Tractability Theory）具有重要理论意义。局限在于摘要未透露证明所采用的具体几何或概率工具。

title: ISAC-Enabled On-Demand UAV Charging for Wireless Rechargeable Sensor Networks
comments: 7 pages, 3 figures, accepted for publication in the IEEE Communications Magazine
summary: Unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) equipped with wireless power transfer (WPT) extend the lifetime of wireless rechargeable sensor networks (WRSNs) by delivering energy on demand. This article presents an integrated sensing and communication (ISAC)-enabled on-demand UAV charging framework coordinated by a central base station. A prioritized charging queue captures node urgency and service cost through residual energy, traffic load, estimated UAV travel time, and flight-direction alignment. This bidirectional coupling ensures that scheduling decisions shape the UAV trajectory, while updated mobility estimates from ISAC dynamically reorder the queue. ISAC-assisted estimation of UAV distance, speed, and position updates travel-time predictions under mobility uncertainty. A time-allocated partial charging policy distributes limited hover time across queued nodes according to criticality. Simulations show gains in energy usage efficiency, travel distance, and charging delay compared with representative baselines. We discuss deployment considerations, including computational overhead, scalability, and parameter selection, to aid practitioners evaluating the framework for IoT scenarios.
comment: 7 pages, 3 figures, accepted for publication in the IEEE Communications Magazine

AI.title_translation: ISAC赋能的无线可充电传感器网络按需无人机充电
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个由中央基站协调的ISAC赋能的按需无人机充电框架，通过优先级充电队列和时间分配的部分充电策略，有效提升了无线可充电传感器网络的能效、减少了充电延迟和旅行距离。
AI.motivation: 无人机无线电力传输能够延长无线可充电传感器网络（WRSN）的寿命，但需要一个高效的按需充电框架来优化能量传输和无人机调度。
AI.method: 本文提出了一个由中央基站协调的ISAC赋能的按需无人机充电框架。该框架包含一个优先充电队列，综合考虑节点的剩余能量、流量负载、无人机估计旅行时间及飞行方向对齐来捕获节点紧急程度和服务成本。调度决策与无人机轨迹相互影响，ISAC提供的移动性估计动态调整队列。ISAC辅助估计无人机距离、速度和位置，以更新移动性不确定性下的旅行时间预测。采用时间分配的部分充电策略，根据节点关键性分配有限的悬停时间。
AI.result: 模拟结果显示，与代表性基线相比，所提出的框架在能量使用效率、旅行距离和充电延迟方面均有所提升。
AI.conclusion: 该ISAC赋能的按需无人机充电框架通过智能调度和部分充电策略，能够有效提高无线可充电传感器网络的充电效率和网络寿命。
AI.translation: 无人机（UAV）配备无线电力传输（WPT）技术，通过按需输送能量，延长了无线可充电传感器网络（WRSN）的寿命。本文提出了一种由中央基站协调的、集成感知与通信（ISAC）赋能的按需无人机充电框架。一个优先充电队列根据剩余能量、流量负载、估计的无人机旅行时间和飞行方向对齐，捕获节点的紧急程度和服务成本。这种双向耦合确保调度决策塑造无人机轨迹，同时ISAC提供的更新移动性估计动态重新排序队列。ISAC辅助估计无人机距离、速度和位置，在移动性不确定性下更新旅行时间预测。一种时间分配的部分充电策略根据关键性，在排队节点之间分配有限的悬停时间。仿真结果显示，与代表性基线相比，该方法在能量使用效率、旅行距离和充电延迟方面均有所提升。我们讨论了部署考虑因素，包括计算开销、可扩展性和参数选择，以帮助实践者评估该框架在物联网场景中的应用。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一个由中央基站协调的ISAC赋能的按需无人机充电框架，旨在延长无线可充电传感器网络的寿命。该框架通过一个考虑节点紧急程度和成本的优先充电队列来调度无人机充电，并利用ISAC动态更新无人机移动性估计和旅行时间预测。此外，采用时间分配的部分充电策略来优化有限悬停时间的分配。仿真结果表明，该框架在能量效率、旅行距离和充电延迟方面优于现有方法。

title: D3O: Dynamic Distribution Distillation for Ordinal Regression
summary: Ordinal regression is widely used in scenarios where labels are discrete yet inherently ordered. In practice, however, ordinal labels are often obtained by discretizing underlying continuous semantics through subjective human judgment, resulting in ambiguous boundaries and annotation noise. Such uncertainty challenges existing methods that rely on fixed supervision targets, which may reinforce biased ordering under subjective annotations. To address this limitation, we propose D3O, a dynamic distribution distillation framework that replaces static supervision with training-driven evolution of ordinal label distributions via self-distillation. Specifically, we introduce a contrastive ordinal-aware label enhancement module that leverages vision-language alignment to recover refined label distributions capturing both inter-class ambiguity and instance-level uncertainty. Furthermore, we design a CDF-based cross-layer interaction distillation mechanism to propagate cumulative ordinal structure across network hierarchy, ensuring consistent ordinal geometry in intermediate representations. Extensive experiments on four general ordinal regression tasks demonstrate that our proposed D3O consistently outperforms existing approaches, particularly under severe class imbalance and noisy supervision. These results highlight the effectiveness of dynamic supervision in learning robust ordinal representations beyond fixed targets. The code will be publicly available.

AI.title_translation: D3O：用于序数回归的动态分布蒸馏
AI.tldr: D3O是一个动态分布蒸馏框架，通过自蒸馏和动态监督来处理序数回归中模糊边界和标注噪声问题，在类不平衡和噪声监督下表现优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 序数回归中的标签通常通过主观判断离散化连续语义获得，导致边界模糊和标注噪声。现有方法依赖固定监督目标，可能在主观标注下强化有偏排序，因此需要解决这一局限性。
AI.method: 提出D3O，一个动态分布蒸馏框架。它用训练驱动的序数标签分布演化（通过自蒸馏）替代静态监督。具体包括：1) 引入对比序数感知标签增强模块，利用视觉-语言对齐恢复细化标签分布，捕获类间模糊性和实例级不确定性。2) 设计基于CDF的跨层交互蒸馏机制，在网络层级间传播累积序数结构，确保中间表示中序数几何的一致性。
AI.result: D3O在四项通用序数回归任务上持续优于现有方法，尤其在严重类别不平衡和噪声监督下表现更佳。
AI.conclusion: 动态监督在学习超越固定目标的鲁棒序数表示方面是有效的。
AI.translation: 序数回归广泛应用于标签离散但本质上有序的场景。然而，在实践中，序数标签通常通过主观人为判断对底层连续语义进行离散化而获得，导致模糊的边界和标注噪声。这种不确定性挑战了依赖固定监督目标的现有方法，这些方法可能在主观标注下强化有偏的排序。为了解决这一局限性，我们提出了D3O，一个动态分布蒸馏框架，它通过自蒸馏将静态监督替换为训练驱动的序数标签分布演化。具体而言，我们引入了一个对比序数感知标签增强模块，该模块利用视觉-语言对齐来恢复捕获类间模糊性和实例级不确定性的精细标签分布。此外，我们设计了一个基于CDF的跨层交互蒸馏机制，以在网络层级结构中传播累积序数结构，确保中间表示中序数几何的一致性。在四项通用序数回归任务上的大量实验表明，我们提出的D3O持续优于现有方法，尤其是在严重的类别不平衡和噪声监督下。这些结果突出了动态监督在学习超越固定目标的鲁棒序数表示方面的有效性。代码将公开可用。
AI.summary: 本文提出D3O，一个针对序数回归的动态分布蒸馏框架，旨在解决由主观标注引起的模糊边界和噪声问题。D3O通过自蒸馏实现训练驱动的序数标签分布演化，并包含一个利用视觉-语言对齐的对比序数感知标签增强模块，以及一个基于CDF的跨层交互蒸馏机制。实验证明，D3O在类别不平衡和噪声监督下，性能优于现有序数回归方法，强调了动态监督在学习鲁棒序数表示方面的有效性。
AI.keywords: 序数回归, 动态分布蒸馏, 自蒸馏, 标签不确定性, 视觉-语言对齐
AI.comments: D3O的创新之处在于引入了动态分布蒸馏和自蒸馏机制，以应对序数回归中常见的标签不确定性和噪声问题。通过结合视觉-语言对齐的标签增强和CDF-based的跨层蒸馏，D3O提供了一种新颖且鲁棒的解决方案，尤其在实际应用中面对不完美数据时具有重要意义。

title: Neuromorphic Object Detection: An In-Depth Study and Future Directions
comments: Accepted by Proceedings of the IEEE
summary: Conventional frame-based cameras face significant challenges in detecting objects under high-speed motion blur or in low-light environments. Neuromorphic cameras provide asynchronous visual streams with high temporal resolution and a wide dynamic range, offering a promising solution for object detection under challenging conditions. Despite the development of numerous models and the emergence of various applications in neuromorphic object detection, there is still a lack of deep understanding and standardized benchmarks to assess progress and address key challenges. In this paper, we provide a comprehensive survey and benchmark of existing neuromorphic object detection algorithms. Specifically, we first present a problem description, review the available datasets, and revisit the evaluation metrics. We then explore existing neuromorphic object detection approaches from various perspectives, including event representation, temporal modeling, multimodal fusion, asynchronous processing, low-latency processing, and energy-efficient computing. Furthermore, we evaluate a wide range of representative neuromorphic object detection models and offer detailed analyses of the comparative results. Finally, we discuss unresolved issues in neuromorphic object detection and propose potential future research directions. We hope this survey and benchmark will be a valuable resource for researchers and provide guidance for future advancements in neuromorphic object detection.
comment: Accepted by Proceedings of the IEEE

AI.title_translation: 神经形态目标检测：深度研究与未来方向
AI.tldr: 本文对现有神经形态目标检测算法进行了全面综述和基准测试，分析了其方法、挑战和未来方向。
AI.motivation: 传统基于帧的相机在高速运动模糊或弱光环境下检测物体面临挑战。神经形态相机提供异步视觉流，在高时间分辨率和宽动态范围下解决这些问题，但神经形态目标检测领域缺乏深入理解和标准化基准。
AI.method: 作者提供了一项全面的综述和基准测试，涵盖了现有神经形态目标检测算法。具体包括：问题描述、现有数据集回顾、评估指标再审视、从事件表示、时间建模、多模态融合、异步处理、低延迟处理和节能计算等多个角度探索现有方法。此外，还评估了各种代表性模型，并进行了详细的比较结果分析。最后，讨论了未解决的问题并提出了未来研究方向。
AI.result: 提供了对广泛的代表性神经形态目标检测模型的详细比较结果分析，并讨论了未解决的问题。
AI.conclusion: 希望这项综述和基准测试能为研究人员提供宝贵资源，并为神经形态目标检测的未来发展提供指导。
AI.translation: 传统基于帧的相机在高速运动模糊或弱光环境下检测物体面临重大挑战。神经形态相机提供具有高时间分辨率和宽动态范围的异步视觉流，为在挑战性条件下进行目标检测提供了有前景的解决方案。尽管在神经形态目标检测领域开发了众多模型并涌现出各种应用，但仍缺乏深入的理解和标准化的基准来评估进展和解决关键挑战。在本文中，我们对现有神经形态目标检测算法进行了全面综述和基准测试。具体而言，我们首先介绍了问题描述，回顾了现有数据集，并重新审视了评估指标。然后，我们从事件表示、时间建模、多模态融合、异步处理、低延迟处理和节能计算等多个角度探讨了现有的神经形态目标检测方法。此外，我们评估了各种代表性神经形态目标检测模型，并对比较结果进行了详细分析。最后，我们讨论了神经形态目标检测中未解决的问题并提出了潜在的未来研究方向。我们希望这项综述和基准测试能成为研究人员的宝贵资源，并为神经形态目标检测的未来发展提供指导。

AI.keywords: 神经形态目标检测, 事件相机, 综述, 基准测试, 目标检测

title: SketchMamba: A Lightweight State-Space Model for Joint Progressive Sketch Classification and Stroke Auto-Completion
summary: Existing vector-sketch models treat recognition and generation as separate tasks, leaving a gap for streaming interfaces that must understand a drawing as it is being made. We present SketchMamba, a single causal sequence model that continuously classifies a sketch from any partial prefix while simultaneously generating its continuation. We achieve this by applying a dense per-step classification loss to a selective state-space backbone. Evaluated on a 58-class subset of the Quick, Draw! dataset, SketchMamba yields 94.93% final-step accuracy and a progressive-accuracy Area Under the Curve (AUC) of 0.706, crossing 90% of its final accuracy by the time 70% of the strokes are drawn. In a matched-budget comparison, the 1.55 million-parameter backbone ties a causal Transformer while outperforming recurrent and convolutional baselines. Ablations confirm that the dense supervision regime, rather than the architecture alone, drives the early-prediction capability. The results demonstrate that a single causal hidden state can unify progressive recognition and autoregressive generation without auxiliary encoders or task-specific branching.

AI.title_translation: SketchMamba：一个用于渐进式草图分类和笔画自动补全的轻量级状态空间模型
AI.tldr: SketchMamba是一个轻量级的状态空间模型，它能同时进行草图的渐进式分类和笔画自动补全，解决了现有模型将识别和生成视为独立任务的问题。
AI.motivation: 现有的矢量草图模型将识别和生成视为独立任务，这对于需要实时理解绘图过程的流媒体接口来说存在不足。本文旨在弥补这一空白。
AI.method: 本文提出了SketchMamba，一个单一的因果序列模型，通过对选择性状态空间骨干应用密集的每步分类损失，实现从任意部分前缀连续分类草图，同时生成其后续内容。
AI.result: 在Quick, Draw!数据集的58个类别子集上，SketchMamba取得了94.93%的最终步准确率和0.706的渐进准确率曲线下面积（AUC），在绘制70%笔画时达到最终准确率的90%。在相同预算下，155万参数的骨干模型与因果Transformer相当，并优于循环和卷积基线。消融实验证实，早期预测能力是由密集监督机制而非单一架构驱动的。
AI.conclusion: 单个因果隐藏状态能够统一渐进式识别和自回归生成，无需辅助编码器或特定任务分支。
AI.translation: 现有矢量草图模型将识别和生成视为独立任务，这为必须在绘图过程中理解绘图的流媒体接口留下了空白。我们提出了SketchMamba，一个单一的因果序列模型，它可以从任何部分前缀连续分类草图，同时生成其后续内容。我们通过对选择性状态空间骨干应用密集的每步分类损失来实现这一点。在Quick, Draw!数据集的58个类别子集上进行评估，SketchMamba取得了94.93%的最终步准确率和0.706的渐进准确率曲线下面积（AUC），在绘制70%笔画时达到最终准确率的90%。在相同预算的比较中，155万参数的骨干模型与因果Transformer不相上下，同时优于循环和卷积基线。消融实验证实，密集监督机制而非单一架构驱动了早期预测能力。结果表明，单个因果隐藏状态可以统一渐进式识别和自回归生成，无需辅助编码器或特定任务分支。
AI.summary: SketchMamba是一个轻量级的状态空间模型，它解决了现有矢量草图模型将识别和生成视为独立任务的局限性。该模型作为一个单一的因果序列模型，能够实时地从部分草图进行分类，并同时预测后续笔画。在Quick, Draw!数据集上的实验表明，SketchMamba在准确性和早期预测能力方面表现出色，其性能与更复杂的Transformer模型相当，并超越了其他基线模型，证明了单个因果隐藏状态在统一渐进式识别和自回归生成方面的有效性。
AI.keywords: 草图分类, 笔画自动补全, 状态空间模型, 实时识别, 因果序列模型
AI.comments: 本文的创新之处在于提出了一个统一的因果序列模型SketchMamba，能够同时处理草图的渐进式分类和笔画自动补全，解决了现有模型任务分离的问题。其重要性在于为实时交互式绘图应用提供了更高效、更自然的解决方案。模型的轻量级特性和在有限笔画下达到高准确率的能力是其显著优点。

title: Verification-Notebook Learning for Source-Aware Multimodal Misinformation Detection
summary: Multimodal misinformation verification is challenging because misleading signals may come from different parts of a post and require different forms of evidence. LVLMs are well suited to this task, but their verification performance often depends on the inference procedure applied to each instance. Existing methods improve this procedure through stronger prompting, retrieval, or deliberation, but rarely retain the verification patterns learned from previous examples. We propose Verification-Notebook Learning (VNL), a non-parametric framework that learns an external verification procedure for a frozen LVLM before inference. VNL builds a compact notebook of decision principles, evidence cues, and recurring pitfalls from prior verification experience. The notebook remains fixed during inference and guides the verification of new examples. Rather than updating model parameters or storing demonstrations, VNL records learned knowledge in an artifact that can be inspected directly. Experiments show that VNL consistently outperforms a range of competitive baselines. Further analyses show that the Verification Notebook improves fine-grained source attribution while remaining compact and interpretable, providing an effective way to accumulate verification knowledge without model training.

AI.title_translation: 源感知多模态错误信息检测的验证笔记本学习
AI.tldr: 提出VNL框架，通过学习外部验证程序和构建可解释的验证笔记本，在不更新模型参数的情况下，提高LVLM在多模态错误信息检测中的性能。
AI.motivation: 多模态错误信息验证具有挑战性，因为误导信号可能来自帖子的不同部分且需要不同形式的证据。现有方法虽然改进了推理过程，但很少保留从先前示例中学到的验证模式。
AI.method: 本文提出验证笔记本学习（VNL），一个非参数框架，用于在推理前为冻结的LVLM学习外部验证程序。VNL从先前的验证经验中构建一个紧凑的决策原则、证据线索和常见陷阱的笔记本。该笔记本在推理期间保持固定，并指导新示例的验证。VNL将学习到的知识记录在一个可以直接检查的工件中，而不更新模型参数或存储演示。
AI.result: 实验表明，VNL始终优于一系列有竞争力的基线。进一步分析显示，验证笔记本在保持紧凑和可解释的同时，改进了细粒度源归因。
AI.conclusion: VNL提供了一种在不进行模型训练的情况下积累验证知识的有效方法。
AI.translation: 多模态错误信息验证具有挑战性，因为误导性信号可能来自帖子的不同部分，并需要不同形式的证据。LVLM非常适合这项任务，但其验证性能通常取决于应用于每个实例的推理过程。现有方法通过更强的提示、检索或推敲来改进此过程，但很少保留从先前示例中学到的验证模式。我们提出了验证笔记本学习（VNL），一个非参数框架，用于在推理前为冻结的LVLM学习外部验证程序。VNL从先前的验证经验中构建一个紧凑的决策原则、证据线索和常见陷阱的笔记本。该笔记本在推理期间保持固定，并指导新示例的验证。VNL不是更新模型参数或存储演示，而是将学习到的知识记录在一个可以直接检查的工件中。实验表明，VNL始终优于一系列有竞争力的基线。进一步分析表明，验证笔记本在保持紧凑和可解释的同时，改进了细粒度源归因，提供了一种在不进行模型训练的情况下积累验证知识的有效方法。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种名为验证笔记本学习（VNL）的非参数框架，用于解决多模态错误信息检测的挑战。VNL通过在推理前为冻结的LVLM学习外部验证程序，并从过往经验中构建一个包含决策原则、证据线索和常见陷阱的紧凑“验证笔记本”。该笔记本在推理过程中保持不变，并指导新实例的验证。VNL不更新模型参数或存储演示，而是将知识记录在一个可直接检查的工件中。实验证明，VNL显著优于现有基线，并在保持紧凑性和可解释性的同时，提高了细粒度源归因能力，提供了一种无需模型训练即可积累验证知识的有效途径。
AI.keywords: 多模态错误信息检测, 验证笔记本学习, LVLM, 非参数框架, 源归因
AI.comments: VNL的创新之处在于其非参数框架，通过构建可直接检查的“验证笔记本”来积累和应用验证知识，而不是修改模型参数。这提供了一种新颖且可解释的方式来增强大型多模态模型的错误信息检测能力，同时避免了模型训练的复杂性，特别是在需要持续适应和透明度验证场景中具有重要意义。其可解释性和无需训练的知识积累方式是其主要优势。

title: Are You Still the Agent I Authorized? Earned Authority under a Fixed Ceiling for Evolving Agents
summary:
Long-lived AI agents increasingly evolve after deployment by retaining experience, acquiring skills and tools, revising workflows, delegating work, and moving across task phases. This improves adaptation but creates a distinct authorization problem. Tool-enabled agents can turn model errors and prompt injections into consequential external actions; when evolution occurs under a live grant, the subject exercising that authority or the context in which it acts may no longer match what the user evaluated. Evolution can change both the effects reachable under an old grant and the authority required by the task, which may rise, fall, or become incomparable. Existing tool policies constrain actions but do not determine when a grant survives this change.
  We formulate authorization continuity: when does an existing grant remain valid, how may active authority change, and what boundary must never move? Our state-bound model fixes a transition envelope and an immutable effect ceiling at grant time. The envelope determines whether the grant survives a mutation; below the ceiling, authority may contract freely and expand only under specified evidence conditions. We distinguish requested from realized effects and prove that, under complete mediation, sound effect abstraction, attenuating delegation, and monitor integrity, mutation cannot amplify protected effects beyond the user-issued ceiling. Agent-produced evidence may allocate authority below the ceiling but cannot raise it. Finally, we map six mutation classes to their authorization consequences.

AI.title_translation: 你还是我授权的代理吗？演化代理在固定上限下的获得权限
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个状态绑定模型来解决长期运行的AI代理在演化过程中可能出现的授权问题，确保其权限不会超出用户设定的固定上限。
AI.motivation: 长期运行的AI代理在部署后会不断演化，例如保留经验、获取技能和工具等，这虽然提高了适应性，但也带来了一个独特的授权问题。演化可能导致代理实际行使的权限或其行动上下文与用户最初评估的不符，工具型代理甚至可能将模型错误或提示注入转化为具有后果的外部行动。
AI.method: 本文提出了“授权连续性”的概念，并构建了一个状态绑定模型。该模型在授权时固定了一个转换包络和一个不可变的效应上限。转换包络决定了授权是否能在突变中存活；在上限之下，权限可以自由收缩，但在特定证据条件下才能扩展。通过区分请求效应和实现效应，并基于完全中介、健全效应抽象、衰减委托和监控完整性，证明突变不能将受保护的效应放大到用户设定的上限之外。
AI.result: 证明了在完全中介、健全效应抽象、衰减委托和监控完整性条件下，代理的突变不会将受保护的效应放大到用户设定的上限之外。代理产生的证据可以在上限之下分配权限，但不能提高上限。此外，将六种突变类别映射到其授权后果。
AI.conclusion: 本文通过提出授权连续性框架和一个状态绑定模型，解决了长期演化AI代理的授权问题，确保了代理权限在演化过程中不会超出用户最初设定的安全上限，从而维护了用户授权的完整性和安全性。
AI.translation:
长期运行的AI代理在部署后越来越多地通过保留经验、获取技能和工具、修改工作流程、委托工作和跨任务阶段移动而演化。这提高了适应性，但产生了一个独特的授权问题。启用工具的代理可以将模型错误和提示注入转化为具有后果的外部行动；当在实时授权下发生演化时，行使该权限的主体或其行动上下文可能不再与用户评估的相符。演化可以改变旧授权下可达到的效应以及任务所需的权限，权限可能上升、下降或变得不可比较。现有的工具策略限制了行动，但未能确定授权何时能在这种变化中存活。
我们提出了授权连续性：现有授权何时保持有效，主动权限如何改变，以及什么边界绝不能移动？我们的状态绑定模型在授权时固定了一个转换包络和一个不可变的效应上限。包络决定了授权是否能在突变中存活；在上限之下，权限可以自由收缩，并且仅在指定证据条件下才能扩展。我们区分了请求效应和实现效应，并证明在完全中介、健全效应抽象、衰减委托和监控完整性下，突变不能将受保护的效应放大到用户发布的上限之外。代理产生的证据可以在上限之下分配权限，但不能提高上限。最后，我们将六种突变类别映射到其授权后果。
AI.summary: 本文针对长期演化AI代理可能出现的授权问题，提出了“授权连续性”的概念和一种状态绑定模型。该模型通过在授权时设定固定的转换包络和不可变的效应上限，确保代理在演化过程中，其权限不会超出用户最初设定的安全范围。研究证明，在特定条件下，代理的突变不会放大受保护的效应，且代理生成的证据只能在上限之下分配权限，而不能提高上限。文章还分析了不同突变类别对授权的影响。
AI.keywords: 演化代理, 授权连续性, 状态绑定模型, 权限管理, AI安全
AI.comments: 这篇论文提出了一种新颖且重要的授权管理框架，以应对长期演化AI代理带来的安全挑战。其创新点在于引入了“授权连续性”和“状态绑定模型”，通过设置不可变的效应上限，为AI代理的自主演化提供了一个安全边界。这对于确保AI系统的可信赖性和用户控制至关重要。该方法将理论证明与实际应用场景相结合，为未来AI系统设计提供了有价值的指导。

title: JarvisHub: An Open Harness for Canvas-Native Multimodal Creative Agents
comments: 15 pages, 9 figures. Project page: https://www.jarvishub.site/ Code github: https://github.com/LYL1015/JarvisHub
summary: Creative AI is moving from single-step asset generation toward long-horizon multimodal production. Although recent generative models can synthesize high-quality images, videos, audio clips, UI elements, storyboards, slides, and other creative assets, real-world creative work requires more than isolated prompt-output interactions. It involves references, drafts, alternatives, edits, failed attempts, version relations, tool actions, evaluation signals, and human feedback, which together form an evolving project state. Existing prompt-based, chat-based, and node-based generation systems only partially support this state, as they often discard intermediate context, rely on linear conversations, or require manually specified workflows. Recent commercial systems indicate a shift toward agent-assisted creative production, but their closed architectures make it difficult to study how agents represent context, choose tools, revise artifacts, recover from failures, and maintain consistency over time. To address this gap, we introduce JarvisHub, a canvas-native creative agent harness for long-horizon multimodal creation. JarvisHub treats an editable canvas as the user workspace, the agent's external memory, action space, and shared project state, representing multimodal artifacts, dependencies, versions, and feedback as typed canvas nodes and links. Through a three-layer architecture of canvas state, protocol bridge, and agent runtime, JarvisHub enables agents to act within an inspectable and editable creative state. This design moves creative agents beyond isolated tool use toward sustained, human-steerable creative automation, where agents can progressively plan, generate, revise, and organize multimodal projects while users remain able to inspect, guide, and intervene throughout the process.

AI.title_translation: JarvisHub：一个用于画布原生多模态创意智能体的开源框架
AI.tldr: JarvisHub是一个开源的画布原生框架，旨在支持智能体进行长周期的多模态创意生产和人机协作。
AI.motivation: 现有的生成式AI系统多为单步、线性交互或封闭架构，难以有效支持真实创意工作中涉及的复杂项目状态（如草稿、版本、失败恢复、评估等）以及多模态长期协作。
AI.method: 引入了JarvisHub，一个采用画布原生三层架构（画布状态、协议桥接和智能体运行时）的创意智能体开源框架，将多模态资产及关系表示为类型化的画布节点和链接。
AI.result: 构建了JarvisHub框架，使智能体能够在可检查、可编辑的画布状态下进行自主规划、生成、修改和组织多模态项目，同时支持人类随时进行干预和指导。
AI.conclusion: JarvisHub通过引入画布原生的三层架构，成功弥补了现有生成系统在长周期多模态创意任务中的不足，为开源社区研究和开发人机协同的创意智能体提供了强有力的平台支撑。
AI.translation: 创意AI正从单步资产生成向长周期多模态生产演进。尽管近期的生成模型可以合成高质量的图像、视频、音频、UI元素、故事板、幻灯片和其他创意资产，但现实世界的创意工作不仅限于孤立的提示-输出交互。它涉及参考资料、草稿、备选项、修改、失败尝试、版本关系、工具操作、评估信号以及人类反馈，这些共同构成了不断演进的项目状态。现有的基于提示、对话和节点的生成系统仅部分支持这种状态，因为它们经常丢弃中间上下文、依赖线性对话或需要手动指定工作流。近期的一些商业系统表明，创意生产正向智能体辅助的方向转变，但其封闭的架构使得研究智能体如何表示上下文、选择工具、修改人工制品、从失败中恢复以及长期保持一致性变得困难。为了填补这一空白，我们推出了JarvisHub，这是一个用于长周期多模态创作的画布原生创意智能体框架。JarvisHub将可编辑的画布视为用户的工作空间、智能体的外部记忆、动作空间以及共享项目状态，将多模态人工制品、依赖关系、版本和反馈表示为带类型的画布节点和链接。通过画布状态、协议桥接和智能体运行时的三层架构，JarvisHub使智能体能够在可检查、可编辑的创意状态下采取行动。这一设计使创意智能体超越了孤立的工具使用，走向持续的、可由人类引导的创意自动化，使智能体能够逐步规划、生成、组织多模态项目，同时用户在整个过程中仍能进行检查、引导和干预。
AI.summary: JarvisHub是一个面向长周期多模态创意生产的开源画布原生智能体框架，通过将画布作为外部记忆和共享项目状态，实现可持续、人类可引导的创意自动化。
AI.keywords: 创意智能体, 多模态生成, 画布原生, 开源框架, 人机协作
AI.comments: 该论文针对当前创意AI缺乏对复杂、演进的项目状态支持的问题，创新性地提出了JarvisHub——一个基于画布原生（canvas-native）的多模态创意智能体开源框架。它通过将可编辑的画布作为智能体的外部记忆与操作空间，为研究长周期、人机协作的多模态创意生成提供了强大的开源支撑。

title: Weakly Supervised Instance-Level Gleason Pattern Estimation Using Primary and Secondary Labels
summary: In prostate cancer histopathology, the Gleason Score is determined by the most frequent (Primary) and second most frequent (Secondary) Gleason patterns within a whole-slide image. Although these slide-level labels are routinely available in clinical practice, instance-level Gleason annotations are rarely provided, making patch-level learning challenging. We propose a Multiple Instance Learning (MIL) framework that estimates instance-level Gleason patterns from slide-level Primary and Secondary labels. The proposed method formulates instance-level learning according to the clinical definition of the Gleason Score by aggregating instance predictions into class counts and explicitly modeling the Primary pattern, Secondary pattern, and their dominance. Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed formulation enables effective instance-level learning and outperforms existing MIL approaches on the SICAP-MIL dataset.

AI.title_translation: 使用原发和继发标签的弱监督实例级格里森模式估计
AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一种多实例学习（MIL）框架，利用玻片级原发和继发格里森评分估计前列腺癌组织病理学中的实例级格里森模式，并优于现有MIL方法。
AI.motivation: 在前列腺癌组织病理学中，尽管玻片级原发和继发格里森评分在临床上是常规可用的，但实例级格里森注释却很少提供，这使得补丁级学习变得具有挑战性。
AI.method: 本文提出了一种多实例学习（MIL）框架。该方法根据格里森评分的临床定义，通过将实例预测聚合成类别计数，并明确建模原发模式、继发模式及其优势来制定实例级学习。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，所提出的公式能够实现有效的实例级学习，并且在SICAP-MIL数据集上优于现有的MIL方法。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的MIL框架能够有效地从玻片级原发和继发标签估计实例级格里森模式，并表现出优于现有MIL方法的性能。
AI.translation: 在前列腺癌组织病理学中，格里森评分由全玻片图像中最常见（原发）和次常见（继发）的格里森模式决定。尽管这些玻片级标签在临床实践中是常规可用的，但实例级格里森注释却很少提供，这使得补丁级学习变得具有挑战性。我们提出了一种多实例学习（MIL）框架，该框架从玻片级原发和继发标签估计实例级格里森模式。所提出的方法根据格里森评分的临床定义，通过将实例预测聚合成类别计数，并明确建模原发模式、继发模式及其优势来制定实例级学习。实验结果表明，所提出的公式能够实现有效的实例级学习，并且在SICAP-MIL数据集上优于现有的MIL方法。
AI.summary: 本论文旨在解决前列腺癌组织病理学中实例级格里森模式估计的挑战，该领域通常仅提供玻片级原发和继发格里森评分。为此，论文引入了一个多实例学习（MIL）框架，利用这些弱标签来推断实例级模式。该方法通过考虑原发、继发模式及其优势，明确建模格里森评分的临床定义。在SICAP-MIL数据集上的实验表明，这种方法能够有效地进行实例级学习，并超越了现有的MIL技术。
AI.keywords: 格里森评分, 多实例学习, 前列腺癌, 组织病理学, 弱监督
AI.comments: 该研究的创新之处在于其多实例学习（MIL）框架能够明确地建模格里森评分的临床定义，特别是整合了原发和继发模式及其优势。这使得从易于获得的弱玻片级标签中进行有效的实例级学习成为可能，解决了前列腺癌诊断中的一个实际挑战。其重要性在于，无需昂贵且耗时的实例级注释即可提高格里森模式估计的粒度。

title: HiTMS: A High-Throughput Multi-Stream Linguistic Steganography Framework
summary: Generative linguistic steganography conceals secret bits within the sampling randomness of large language models. Existing schemes are single-stream, conveying an entire secret through a single response to a single prompt. This convention incurs two limitations: it provides no protocol-level support for batched multi-stream inference, and naive co-batching does not conceal slot occupancy or payload completion. We propose HiTMS, which distributes a secret across multiple responses produced jointly over successive rounds of interaction. Each round embeds and extracts several streams within a single batched call, thereby amortizing the cost of model invocation and substantially improving throughput. To ensure recoverability, HiTMS wraps each response in a self-describing frame and employs a key-derived schedule that binds streams to slots and fills unused slots with decoys, guaranteeing exact recovery while concealing the number of active streams. The framework is agnostic to both the language model and the steganographic coder. Across eight dataset-model-coder settings, eight-stream HiTMS achieves up to 4.3 times higher embedding and extraction speeds than single-stream baselines, while reducing the steganalyzer AUROC from 0.681 to 0.601 on average.
