title: New perspectives for code locality in the rank metric
summary:
In coding theory, local recovery enables the efficient recovery of some part of (lost) coded data by accessing only a small number of other data entries. Locality was mostly but intensively studied for the recovery of individual symbols, that is, in the context of the Hamming metric.
  In this work, we propose a new definition of locality for general rank-metric codes. This definition differs from a previous work of Kadhe, El Rouayheb, Duursma and Sprintson [IEEE Trans. Inf. Theory 2019], by allowing to efficiently recover any element of the support, and without relying on any choice of bases of the underlying vector spaces.
  Our work firstly relies on a precise study of code puncturing and shortening for codes viewed as spaces of linear maps. We then provide examples and general constructions, showing the difference between our notion and that of Kadhe et al. We then derive a Singleton-like bound for rank locally recoverable codes, and we finally prove that a construction similar to classical Tamo-Barg codes is optimal with respect to this bound.

AI.title_translation: 秩度量下代码局域性的新视角
AI.tldr: 本文提出了秩度量码局域恢复的新定义，并证明了类似 Tamo-Barg 码的构造在新的 Singleton-like 界下是最优的。
AI.motivation: 传统的局部恢复研究主要集中在汉明度量（Hamming metric）下的单个符号恢复，而以往关于秩度量码局部性的定义依赖于基底的选择且有一定局限性，因此需要一种新的、更通用的秩度量码局域性定义。
AI.method: 通过对将码视为线性映射空间的代码打孔（puncturing）和缩短（shortening）进行精确研究，提出了新的局部恢复定义，推导出了秩局部可恢复码的 Singleton-like 界，并给出了类 Tamo-Barg 码的构造。
AI.result: 提出了不依赖基底选择的新局域性定义，通过与前人工作的对比展示了其差异，推导出了 Singleton-like 界，并证明了类似 Tamo-Barg 码的构造在该界下是最优的。
AI.conclusion: 本文成功提出了秩度量码局域恢复的新定义，推导出了对应的 Singleton-like 界，并证明了类似 Tamo-Barg 码的构造是最优的，拓展了编码理论在秩度量下的局域性研究。
AI.translation:
在编码理论中，局部恢复允许通过仅访问其他一小部分数据条目来高效恢复部分（丢失的）编码数据。局域性主要但在密集程度上针对单个符号的恢复进行了研究，即在汉明度量的背景下。
在这项工作中，我们为一般的秩度量码提出了一种局域性的新定义。该定义不同于 Kadhe、El Rouayheb、Duursma 和 Sprintson（IEEE Trans. Inf. Theory 2019）之前的工作，它允许高效恢复支持集中的任何元素，且不依赖于底层向量空间的任何基底选择。
我们的工作首先依赖于对被视为线性映射空间的码的代码打孔（puncturing）和缩短（shortening）的精确研究。然后，我们提供了例子和一般构造，展示了我们的概念与 Kadhe 等人的概念之间的区别。接着，我们推导出了秩局部可恢复码的类似 Singleton 的界（Singleton-like bound），最后证明了类似于经典 Tamo-Barg 码的构造对于该界是优化的。
AI.summary: 本文针对秩度量码提出了一种新的局域恢复定义，该定义无需依赖基底选择。通过研究线性映射空间的打孔与缩短性质，作者推导了相应的 Singleton-like 界，并证明了类 Tamo-Barg 构造的 optimality。
AI.keywords: rank metric, local recovery, coding theory, code puncturing, Singleton-like bound
AI.comments: 该论文在秩度量码（rank-metric codes）的局域恢复能力研究上取得了重要进展，提出了一个更加自然且不依赖特定基底的新定义，并通过深入研究其 puncturing 和 shortening 性质，给出了类似 Singleton 的界以及最优构造，具有很高的理论价值。

title: PAC-DP: PAC-Bayesian Diffusion Policy Learning
summary: Diffusion Policies (DPs) are able to perform complex manipulation tasks. However, DPs are typically trained by minimizing a denoising objective, which provides limited control over generalization in the finite-data regimes common in robotics. In this letter, we propose PAC-DP, an approach that increases the performance of DPs in robotic manipulation tasks. By modeling the DP as a Bayesian neural network, and defining a PAC-Bayes generalization bound, we derive a novel training objective that augments the standard denoising loss with a Kullback-Leibler divergence regularizer between the posterior and prior parameter distributions. From the theoretical perspective, our approach provides a principled approach to regularize the training of DPs without significantly increasing the training time. From the practical point of view, experimental results demonstrate improved denoising performance, lower variational negative log-likelihood, and higher success rates across multiple robotic manipulation benchmarks. Crucially, the largest improvements are observed in low-data training regimes and complex tasks, establishing PAC-DP as a theoretically grounded framework for robot policy learning.

AI.tldr: 提出PAC-DP，通过将PAC-Bayes泛化界引入扩散策略，显著提升了机器人在有限数据下的泛化能力和操作成功率。
AI.motivation: 传统的扩散策略（DPs）通过最小化去噪目标进行训练，在机器人领域常见的有限数据情况下，对泛化能力的控制非常有限。
AI.method: 将扩散策略建模为贝叶斯神经网络，定义PAC-Bayes泛化界，推导出一个包含标准去噪损失和后验与先验参数分布之间Kullback-Leibler散度正则化项的新型训练目标。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，PAC-DP在多个机器人操作基准测试中改善了去噪性能、降低了变分负对数似然，并提高了成功率，特别是在低数据训练阶段和复杂任务中提升最为显著。
AI.conclusion: PAC-DP作为一种理论基础扎实的机器人策略学习框架，通过PAC-Bayes正则化显著提升了扩散策略在机器人操作任务中的泛化能力和成功率，尤其适用于低数据训练场景。
AI.translation: 扩散策略（DPs）能够执行复杂的操纵任务。然而，DPs通常通过最小化去噪目标来训练，这在机器人学中常见的有限数据状态下对泛化能力的控制有限。在本快讯中，我们提出了PAC-DP，这是一种提高DPs在机器人操纵任务中性能的方法。通过将DP建模为贝叶斯神经网络，并定义一个PAC-Bayes泛化界，我们推导了一种新颖的训练目标，该目标在标准去噪损失中增加了一个后验与先验参数分布之间的Kullback-Leibler散度正则化项。从理论角度来看，我们的方法提供了一种有原则的方法来正则化DP的训练，且不会显著增加训练时间。从实践角度来看，实验结果证明了在多个机器人操纵基准测试中，其改善了去噪性能、降低了变分负对数似然，并提高了成功率。至关重要的是，最大的改进在低数据训练状态和复杂任务中观察到，这确立了PAC-DP作为机器人策略学习的理论扎实框架的地位。
AI.summary: 该论文提出了PAC-DP，这是一种将PAC-Bayesian泛化界与扩散策略相结合的新方法。通过在去噪损失中加入后验与先验分布的KL散度正则化项，该方法在不显著增加训练时间的前提下，显著提升了机器人在有限数据和复杂操作任务中的泛化能力与成功率。
AI.keywords: 扩散策略, PAC-Bayes, 机器人操作, 泛化能力, 贝叶斯神经网络
AI.comments: 该论文将PAC-Bayes理论引入扩散策略（Diffusion Policies）中，通过推导泛化界并设计KL散度正则化项，有效解决了机器人模仿学习中有限数据情况下的泛化难题。方法具有理论支撑且计算开销小，在低数据和复杂任务中表现尤为突出。

title: On the Recognition of Outerplanar Graphs with Queue Number 1
comments: Appears as a poster at GD 2026
summary: A linear layout of a graph is defined as a total order of the vertices and a partition of the edges to pages. In a stack (queue) layout, no two edges on the same page may cross (nest). The stack (queue) number of a graph is the minimum number of pages required in a stack (queue) layout. This paper focuses on characterizing and recognizing graphs that have both stack number 1 and queue number 1. It is known that the graphs with stack number 1 are exactly the outerplanar graphs. We show that (i) deciding whether a given outerplanar graph has queue number 1 is NP-hard; (ii) deciding whether a given maximal outerplanar graph has queue number 1 can be done in linear time. Moreover, we investigate the interplay between outerpaths with queue number 1 and their maximum vertex degree.
comment: Appears as a poster at GD 2026

AI.title_translation: On the Recognition of Outerplanar Graphs with Queue Number 1
AI.tldr: 该论文研究了堆栈数和队列数均为1的图的特征和识别方法。证明了判断一个给定的外planar图的队列数是否为1是NP难的，但判断一个给定的最大外planar图的队列数是否为1可以在线性时间内完成。此外，还探讨了队列数为1的外paths与其最大顶点度之间的关系。
AI.motivation: 研究具有堆栈数1和队列数1的图的特征和识别，特别是外planar图。
AI.method: 通过证明判断外planar图的队列数是否为1是NP难的，以及判断最大外planar图的队列数是否为1可以在线性时间内完成。
AI.result: （i）判断给定外planar图的队列数是否为1是NP难的；（ii）判断给定最大外planar图的队列数是否为1可以在线性时间内完成。
AI.conclusion: 虽然判断任意外planar图的队列数是否为1是NP难的，但对于最大外planar图，可以在线性时间内完成。这为理解和识别具有特定布局限制的图提供了新的见解。
AI.translation: 线性图布局被定义为顶点的总顺序和边的分页。在堆栈（队列）布局中，同一页上的任意两条边都不能交叉（嵌套）。图的堆栈（队列）数是在堆栈（队列）布局中所需的最小页数。本文着重于表征和识别同时具有堆栈数1和队列数1的图。众所周知，堆栈数1的图恰好是外planar图。我们证明了（i）判断给定外planar图的队列数是否为1是NP难的；（ii）判断给定最大外planar图的队列数是否为1可以在线性时间内完成。此外，我们还研究了队列数1的外paths与其最大顶点度之间的相互作用。
AI.summary: 本文研究了具有堆栈数1和队列数1的图的识别问题。已知堆栈数1的图即为外planar图。研究表明，判断一个外planar图的队列数是否为1是NP难问题，但对于最大外planar图，可以在线性时间内解决。此外，还分析了队列数为1的外paths与其最大顶点度之间的关系。
AI.keywords: 外planar图, 队列数, 堆栈数, 图布局, NP难
AI.comments: 该研究在图论的布局问题方面取得了重要进展，特别是在外planar图的队列数识别方面。NP难性的证明以及对最大外planar图的线性时间算法，为该领域提供了理论和算法上的贡献。然而，对于更一般的外planar图，算法效率仍是挑战。

title: UMI3D: Robust 3D Generation on Unconstrained Multi-Image Inputs via Simultaneous Focus Cross-Attention Routing
summary: Recent 3D foundation models can generate high-quality assets from a single image, but degrade markedly on unconstrained multi-image inputs, often producing distorted geometry, over-smoothed textures, and chaotic colors. We argue that this failure stems not from limited model capacity, but from a mismatch between single-image cross-attention and the multi-image setting: existing models lack a principled way to decide which image each 3D voxel should trust at each denoising step. Revisiting recent single-image 3D foundation models, we show that explicitly routing each voxel to its most informative image is sufficient to unlock strong performance on inconsistent multi-image inputs. Based on this observation, we propose UMI3D, a training-free and plug-and-play framework that restructures cross-attention for unconstrained multi-image 3D generation. Its core, Simultaneous Focus Cross-Attention (SFC-Attn), activates all conditioning images at each denoising step while allowing each voxel to focus on the single image that best explains it. To enable this routing, we derive the Voxel Reference Score (VRS), a model-intrinsic metric for voxel--image affinity that requires no external matching, segmentation, or correspondence models. Extensive experiments show that UMI3D unlocks the multi-image potential of single-image 3D generation frameworks across diverse tasks. Project Page: UMI3D-Project.github.io.

AI.title_translation: UMI3D：通过同时聚焦交叉注意力路由在无约束多图输入上实现稳健的3D生成
AI.tldr: 提出了一种名为UMI3D的无训练框架，通过新颖的交叉注意力路由机制，解决了现有单图3D模型在多图输入时表现不佳的问题。
AI.motivation: 现有的3D基础模型在处理无约束的多图输入时性能显著下降，产生几何畸变和色彩混乱，其根本原因在于单图交叉注意力机制无法在去噪每一步为3D体素选择可信的输入图像。
AI.method: 提出了UMI3D框架，核心包含Simultaneous Focus Cross-Attention (SFC-Attn)机制和Voxel Reference Score (VRS)度量指标，通过动态将每个3D体素路由到信息最丰富的图像来实现稳健的3D生成。
AI.result: 广泛的实验表明，UMI3D在各种多样化任务中有效解锁了单图3D生成框架处理不一致多图输入的潜力，实现了稳健的高质量3D生成。
AI.conclusion: UMI3D成功释放了单图3D生成框架处理无约束多图输入时的潜力，在多任务中表现出优异的鲁棒性和高质量生成能力。
AI.translation: 近期的3D基础模型能够从单张图像生成高质量的资产，但在无约束的多图输入上却显著退化，常产生畸变的几何结构、过度平滑的纹理以及混乱的色彩。我们认为这种失效并非源于模型容量有限，而是源于单图交叉注意力与多图设置之间的不匹配：现有模型缺乏一种有原则的方法来决定每个3D体素在每一步去噪中应该信任哪张图像。通过重新审视近期的单图3D基础模型，我们表明显式地将每个体素路由到其最具信息量的图像，足以在不一致的多图输入上释放强大的性能。基于这一观察，我们提出了UMI3D，这是一个无需训练且即插即用的框架，重构了无约束多图3D生成的交叉注意力。其核心“同时聚焦交叉注意力”（SFC-Attn）在每一步去噪中激活所有条件图像，同时允许每个体素聚焦于能最好地解释它的单张图像。为了实现这种路由，我们推导出了体素参考分数（VRS），这是一种用于体素-图像亲和力的模型内在度量，不需要外部匹配、分割或对应模型。大量实验表明，UMI3D在各种任务中释放了单图3D生成框架的多图潜力。
AI.summary: 该论文提出了UMI3D，一个用于无约束多图3D生成的无训练、即插即用框架。通过引入同时聚焦交叉注意力（SFC-Attn）和体素参考分数（VRS），该方法能够动态地将每个3D体素路由至最合适的条件图像，从而显著提升了3D生成的鲁棒性和质量。
AI.keywords: 3D生成, 多图输入, 交叉注意力, 无训练框架, 3D基础模型
AI.comments: 该论文针对无约束多图输入的3D生成难题，提出了一种无需训练、即插即用的框架UMI3D。其核心创新在于Simultaneous Focus Cross-Attention (SFC-Attn)和Voxel Reference Score (VRS)，无需额外的匹配或分割模型，有效解决了现有单图3D模型在多图输入时的几何失真和颜色混乱问题，具有很高的实用价值。

title: Self-Authored Verification Is Unreliable in Heuristic Self-Improving Agents
summary: Self-improving agents accumulate capability by repeatedly rewriting procedural policies, controllers, or heuristic rules. They typically rely on self-authored tests or metrics to decide whether to accept subsequent edits. The agent controls both the optimized object and its verifier. As a result, self-assigned scores can remain near perfect while real deployment performance degrades or stays low. We study this problem through the verifier--deployment gap. This gap refers to the discrepancy between an agent's self-authored verification signal and a sealed deployment evaluation that the agent cannot observe or access. We ask how self-authored verification fails under iterative policy-and-test rewriting, how the failure changes with capability, and how little exogenous trust is sufficient to prevent real regressions from being deployed. To address this problem, we introduce a Sealed Exogenous Acceptance Loop (SEAL). SEAL retains self-authored tests but compares each candidate with the incumbent through a fixed harness-side audit. The agent cannot author or inspect the audit, receives only accept/reject, and the whole incumbent state is retained after a clear regression. Our experiments show that this problem often appears in heuristic learning settings. These settings require trial-and-error discovery of the target objective. We further find that failures of self-written verification are stratified by capability. Weaker agents tend to damage previously acquired strategies behind easy self-tests. Stronger agents are more stable, but they still mismeasure the deployment distribution. Standard self-written constraints do not reliably close this gap. In contrast, SEAL outperforms unprotected baselines across six models and three random seeds. Reliable self-improvement need not abandon self-verification, but it requires at least one deployment-acceptance signal outside the agent's control.

AI.title_translation: 启发式自我改进智能体中，自我编写的验证是不可靠的
AI.tldr: 自改进智能体自我编写的验证往往不可靠，会导致自我评分虚高而实际性能下降；引入一个不受智能体控制的外部审计机制（SEAL）可以有效解决这一问题。
AI.motivation: 自改进智能体通常依赖自我编写的测试或指标来决定是否接受后续的策略修改，由于智能体同时控制着被优化对象和验证器，导致自我赋予的分数很高而实际部署性能下降（即验证器-部署差距）。
AI.method: 引入了“密封外源接受循环（SEAL）”，保留自编写的测试，但通过固定的、智能体无法查看的外部审计来对比候选策略与当前策略，并在发生明显回归时保留完整状态。
AI.result: 实验表明，自我编写验证的失败情况随智能体能力而异（弱智能体用简单的自测破坏策略，强智能体会错误衡量部署分布），而SEAL方法在六个模型和三个随机种子下均优于未受保护的基线。
AI.conclusion: 可靠的自我改进并不需要放弃自我验证，但它至少需要一个不受智能体控制的部署接受信号（如SEAL方法）。
AI.translation: 自改进智能体通过反复重写程序策略、控制器或启发式规则来积累能力。它们通常依赖自我编写的测试或指标来决定是否接受后续的修改。智能体既控制被优化对象，又控制其验证器。因此，在真实部署性能下降或保持低位的同时，自我指定的得分可以保持接近完美。我们通过“验证器-部署差距”来研究这个问题。这个差距指的是智能体自我编写的验证信号与智能体无法观察或访问的封闭式部署评估之间的差异。我们探讨了自我编写的验证在迭代策略与测试重写下是如何失效的、这种失效随能力如何变化，以及需要多大程度的外源信任才能防止真实回归被部署。为了解决这个问题，我们引入了密封外源接受循环（SEAL）。SEAL保留了自我编写的测试，但通过固定的、框架侧的审计来比较每个候选者与当前对象。智能体不能编写或检查该审计，只能接收接受/拒绝的结果，并且在出现明显回归时保留整个当前状态。我们的实验表明，这个问题经常出现在启发式学习环境中。这些环境需要通过试错来发现目标目标。我们进一步发现，自编写验证的失效受智能体能力的层级影响。较弱的智能体会通过简单的自测破坏先前获得的策略。较强的智能体更稳定，但它们仍然会错误地衡量部署分布。标准的自编写约束并不能可靠地缩小这一差距。相比之下，在六个模型和三个随机种子下，SEAL的表现优于无保护的基线。可靠的自我改进不需要放弃自我验证，但它至少需要一个在智能体控制之外的部署接受信号。
AI.summary: 该论文研究了自改进智能体中自我编写验证的不可靠性问题，指出了“验证器-部署差距”，并提出了SEAL方法通过外部审计来防止真实性能的退化，实验证明了该方法的有效性。
AI.keywords: 自我改进智能体, 自我验证, 验证器-部署差距, 策略重写, 启发式学习
AI.comments: 该论文深刻揭示了自主迭代智能体中“自我验证”机制的不可靠性（验证器-部署差距），并提出了简洁而有效的密封外源接受循环（SEAL）方法，对提升未来自改进智能体的安全性和真实性能具有重要意义。

title: Discrete time phased Petri box calculus dtphPBC
comments: Keywords: stochastic process algebra, Petri box calculus, discrete time, phase type distribution, absorbing discrete time Markov chain, phased multiaction, timed multiaction, immediate multiaction, execution, transition system, operational semantics
summary: We propose discrete time phased Petri box calculus (dtphPBC), an extension with phase type distributed multiaction delays of discrete time stochastic and deterministic Petri box calculus (dtsdPBC), previously presented by I.V. Tarasyuk. In dtphPBC, transition probability matrices (TPMs) of finite absorbing discrete time Markov chains (DTMCs) with a single absorbing state specify discrete phase type (DPH) distributed delays (including zero delay) of the phased multiactions that generalize stochastic and deterministic multiactions from dtsdPBC. The positively phased (timed) multiactions have positive DPH delays represented by the non-empty TPM matrices over transient states (transient TPMs). The zero phased (immediate) multiactions have zero DPH delay represented by the empty transient TPM. The step operational semantics of dtphPBC is constructed via labeled probabilistic transition systems. The transition systems incorporate the absorbing DTMCs of the DPH delays of the executed phased multiactions via the structural operational semantics (SOS) rules. The SOS rules define a labeling with the empty set on the transitions among transient states of the absorbing DTMC and on the self-loop in the absorbing state of it. The transitions going from the transient states (positive phases) to the absorbing state (zero phase) are labeled with the executions, being the positive phases-superscribed timed multiactions whose (positive) delays are defined by the absorbing DTMC. A series of examples demonstrates how to construct the transition systems of the dynamic expressions, combined from timed and immediate multiactions with different operations of the calculus.
comment: Keywords: stochastic process algebra, Petri box calculus, discrete time, phase type distribution, absorbing discrete time Markov chain, phased multiaction, timed multiaction, immediate multiaction, execution, transition system, operational semantics

AI.title_translation: 离散时间分相Petri盒演算 dtphPBC
AI.tldr: 本文提出了dtphPBC，一种通过离散相型分布延迟扩展Petri盒演算的新方法。
AI.motivation: 为了扩展以往的离散时间随机与确定性Petri盒演算（dtsdPBC），使其能够支持具有相型分布的多动作延迟。
AI.method: 通过有限吸收离散时间马尔可夫链的转移概率矩阵来指定离散相型分布延迟，并利用结构操作语义规则构建带标签概率转移系统的步操作语义。
AI.result: 建立了离散时间分相Petri盒演算（dtphPBC），并结合实例展示了如何构建结合了定时和即时多动作的动态表达式转移系统。
AI.conclusion: 成功提出了dtphPBC演算，通过DPH分布扩展了现有的Petri盒演算，并构建了其步操作语义。
AI.translation: 我们提出了离散时间分相Petri盒演算（dtphPBC），这是对I.V. Tarasyuk先前提出的离散时间随机与确定性Petri盒演算（dtsdPBC）的扩展，引入了相型分布的多动作延迟。在dtphPBC中，具有单个吸收状态的有限吸收离散时间马尔可夫链（DTMC）的转移概率矩阵（TPM）指定了分相多动作的离散相型（DPH）分布延迟（包括零延迟），这泛化了dtsdPBC中的随机和确定性多动作。正相（定时）多动作具有由瞬态状态上的非空TPM矩阵表示的正DPH延迟。零相（即时）多动作具有由空瞬态TPM表示的零DPH延迟。dtphPBC的步操作语义通过带标签的概率转移系统构建。转移系统通过结构操作语义（SOS）规则结合了所执行分相多动作的DPH延迟的吸收DTMC。SOS规则在吸收到DTMC瞬态状态之间的转换以及在其吸收状态的自环上定义了空集的标签。从瞬态状态（正相）到吸收状态（零相）的转换标记为执行，即正相上标的定时多动作，其（正）延迟由吸收DTMC定义。一系列示例展示了如何构建由具有演算不同操作的定时和即时多动作组合而成的动态表达式的转移系统。
AI.summary: 论文提出了离散时间分相Petri盒演算（dtphPBC），通过引入离散相型分布的多动作延迟扩展了先前的模型，并利用结构操作语义定义了其步操作语义和转移系统。
AI.keywords: 离散时间Petri盒演算, 相型分布, 离散时间马尔可夫链, 操作语义, 多动作延迟
AI.comments: 该论文通过引入离散相型分布延迟扩展了离散时间随机与确定性Petri盒演算，为并发系统的定量和定时分析提供了更强大的理论工具。

title: Multiview Multi-Person Human Mesh Recovery Under Large Scenes with Occlusions
summary: Human mesh recovery (HMR) aims to recover 3D human meshes from images. Most existing HMR benchmarks and methods focus on either multi-person reconstruction from a single view or single-person reconstruction from multiple views, where the number of subjects and the scene scale are relatively limited. Such settings are insufficient for real-world applications with large scenes and severe inter-person occlusions. To address this limitation, we introduce a large-scale synthetic benchmark for multiview multi-person HMR, termed MVMP-HMR. The proposed dataset contains 15 complex scenes with up to 50 camera views and 30 interacting persons, featuring large spatial coverage and severe occlusions, which significantly increases the difficulty of human mesh recovery. Based on this benchmark, we further propose a multiview multi-person whole-body human mesh recovery model, referred to as MVMP-HMR model. The model first fuses multiview features into a scene-level 3D feature volume, and then leverages pelvis joints predicted by a 3D pose estimation network to extract person-specific queries from the 3D feature volume. These human queries are cross-attended with the 3D feature volume and integrated to decode each person's 3D mesh. Moreover, we introduce two novel losses--the orientation loss and the 3D joint density loss--to alleviate orientation and pose ambiguities under severe occlusions. Experiments demonstrate that existing state-of-the-art HMR methods struggle on the proposed MVMP-HMR benchmark, while our method consistently outperforms prior SOTAs in large-scale scenes with severe occlusions.

AI.title_translation: 大场景且存在遮挡条件下的多视角多人体网格恢复
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个针对大场景和严重遮挡的、包含多视角多人的大规模合成基准（MVMP-HMR）以及一种新型恢复模型，有效解决了复杂环境下的3D人体网格重建难题。
AI.motivation: 现有的3D人体网格恢复（HMR）基准和方法主要集中在单视角的的多人重建或多视角的单人重建，主体数量和场景规模相对有限，无法满足具有大场景和严重人际遮挡的真实世界应用需求。
AI.method: 提出了一种多视角多人体全身网格恢复模型。该模型首先将多视角特征融合成场景级的3D特征体，然后利用3D姿态估计网络预测的骨盆关节从3D特征体中提取特定于个人的查询（human queries），并通过交叉注意力与3D特征体交互以解码每个人的3D网格。同时引入了方向损失（orientation loss）和3D关节密度损失（3D joint density loss）来缓解严重遮挡下的方向和姿态模糊。
AI.result: 实验表明，现有的最先进HMR方法在所提出的MVMP-HMR基准上表现不佳，而作者提出的方法在大规模场景和严重遮挡的情况下始终优于先前的最先进方法。
AI.conclusion: 本文成功构建了MVMP-HMR基准，并提出了相应的多视角多人体3D人体网格恢复模型及专门的损失函数，有效克服了大场景及严重遮挡带来的挑战，实验证明了其优越性。
AI.translation: 人体网格恢复（HMR）旨在从图像中恢复3D人体网格。大多数现有的HMR基准和方法主要集中在单视角的的多人重建或多视角的单人重建，其中主体数量和场景规模相对有限。这种设置对于具有大场景和严重人际遮挡的真实世界应用来说是不够的。为了解决这一局限性，我们引入了一个用于多视角多人体HMR的大规模合成基准，称为MVMP-HMR。所提出的数据集包含15个复杂场景，多达50个相机视角和30个交互人员，具有大空间覆盖率和严重的遮挡，这显著增加了人体网格恢复的难度。在此基准的基础上，我们进一步提出了一种多视角多人体全身网格恢复模型，称为MVMP-HMR模型。该模型首先将多视角特征融合成场景级3D特征体，然后利用3D姿态估计网络预测的骨盆关节从3D特征体中提取特定于个人的查询。这些人体查询与3D特征体进行交叉注意力交互并集成，以解码每个人的3D网格。此外，我们引入了两个新颖的损失——方向损失和3D关节密度损失——以减轻严重遮挡下的方向和姿态模糊。实验表明，现有的最先进HMR方法在提出的MVMP-HMR基准上表现困难，而我们的方法在大规模场景和严重遮挡下始终优于先前的SOTA方法。
AI.summary: 本文针对大场景与严重遮挡下的多视角多人3D人体网格恢复问题，推出了一个大规模合成基准MVMP-HMR（包含多达50个相机视角和30个交互人员），并提出了一种新型的多视角多人全身网格恢复模型，结合3D特征体融合、特定人体查询及两种新颖的损失函数，显著提升了复杂遮挡场景下的重建性能。
AI.keywords: 多视角多人体, 人体网格恢复, 大场景, 遮挡, 3D特征体
AI.comments: 本文针对大场景和严重遮挡下多视角多人体网格恢复这一复杂且具有现实意义的问题，提出了首个大规模合成基准MVMP-HMR和一个创新的端到端模型。创新点在于通过3D特征体融合、基于骨盆关节的特定人体查询机制，以及针对严重遮挡设计的新颖损失函数（方向损失和3D关节密度损失），有效解决了遮挡和姿态模糊问题。对未来大规模、多人的复杂环境三维重建研究具有重要推动作用。

title: Domain-Decomposition Neural Surrogates for Scalable Decentralized Ensemble Kalman Filter Based Parameter Identification in High-Dimensional Stochastic PDEs
summary: Ensemble Kalman filters (EnKF) provide an efficient framework for parameter identification of physics based laws from spatially distributed measurements. Their forecast models require a large number of samples to accurately represent uncertainties, leading to high computational costs. A NN-based surrogate model is introduced to replace the sample-based forecast model. The proposed NN surrogate maps spatial coordinates and physics-based parameters to the forecasted observation. Such maps require a large number of parameters for high-dimensional spatial domains. To overcome this limitation, a augmented Lagrange multiplier domain decomposition method (DDM) is developed, where local NN models are optimized independently before global communication and coupling. This reduces the number of NN parameters while improving local approximation accuracy. Furthermore, a distributed and decentralized ensemble Kalman filter approach based on DDM-NN surrogate model is investigated, where the parameter identification problem is decomposed into local subproblems. Each local estimator updates the material parameters using locally available information, while communication between neighboring subdomains enables the reconstruction of a consistent global estimate to reduce the computational cost. The proposed method is evaluated on a three-dimensional material parameter identification problem and compared with an EnKF and a MCMC reference solution. The results show that the proposed DDM NN-based KF captures the posterior parameter distribution and approaches the solutions obtained with both EnKF and MCMC. While MCMC provides the most accurate representation of the posterior distribution, the proposed approach achieves comparable parameter estimates with reduced computational requirements for the forecast model.

AI.title_translation: 高维随机偏微分方程中基于可扩展去中心化集合卡尔曼滤波参数辨识的区域分解神经代理模型
AI.tldr: 提出了一种结合区域分解与神经网络代理模型的去中心化集合卡尔曼滤波方法，显著降低了高维随机PDEs参数辨识的计算成本。
AI.motivation: 高维随机偏微分方程的集合卡尔曼滤波（EnKF）参数辨识需要大量样本来表示不确定性，导致计算成本极高，且传统的神经网络代理模型在高维空间域中需要大量参数，存在局限性。
AI.method: 引入基于神经网络的代理模型替代传统的样本预测模型，并结合增广拉格朗日乘子领域分解法（DDM）优化局部神经网络，最后开发了基于DDM-NN代理模型的分布式、去中心化集合卡尔曼滤波方法。
AI.result: 在三维材料参数辨识问题上的评估表明，该方法能够捕捉后验参数分布，并获得与传统EnKF和MCMC相媲美的参数估计结果，同时显著减少了预测模型的计算需求。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的基于DDM-NN的去中心化EnKF方法能够以较低的计算成本准确捕捉后验参数分布，其性能可与传统的EnKF和MCMC方法相媲美。
AI.translation: 集合卡尔曼滤波（EnKF）为从空间分布式测量中辨识基于物理定律的参数提供了一个高效的框架。其预测模型需要大量样本来准确表示不确定性，从而导致高昂的计算成本。为此，本文引入了一种基于神经网络（NN）的代理模型来替代基于样本的预测模型。所提出的NN代理模型将空间坐标和基于物理的参数映射到预测观测值。对于高维空间域，此类映射需要大量的参数。为了克服这一限制，开发了一种增强型拉格朗日乘子区域分解法（DDM），其中局部NN模型在全局通信和耦合之前独立优化。这减少了NN参数的数量，同时提高了局部逼近精度。此外，研究了一种基于DDM-NN代理模型的分布式且去中心化的集合卡尔曼滤波方法，其中参数辨识问题被分解为局部子问题。每个局部估计器使用局部可用信息更新材料参数，而相邻子域之间的通信能够重建一致的全局估计，从而降低计算成本。所提出的方法在三维材料参数辨识问题上进行了评估，并与EnKF和MCMC参考解进行了比较。结果表明，所提出的基于DDM-NN的KF能够捕获后验参数分布，并逼近通过EnKF和MCMC获得解。虽然MCMC提供了对后验分布最精确的表示，但该方法在减少预测模型计算需求的同时，实现了可比的参数估计。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种基于领域分解神经网络代理模型的可扩展、去中心化集合卡尔曼滤波方法，用于解决高维随机偏微分方程中的参数辨识问题，有效降低了计算成本并提高了局部逼近精度。
AI.keywords: Domain Decomposition, Neural Surrogates, Ensemble Kalman Filter, Parameter Identification, Stochastic PDEs
AI.comments: 该论文创新性地结合了领域分解方法（DDM）和神经网络代理模型，解决了高-dimensional随机偏微分方程中EnKF计算成本过高的痛点。分布式和去中心化的设计具有很强的可扩展性，为高维物理系统的参数辨识提供了有效途径。

title: Rethinking the Generation Order of Block Diffusion Language Models
summary: Diffusion language models enable flexible arbitrary-order generation, but existing sampling methods are mostly designed for early masked diffusion models (MDMs). In this work, we study sampling for recent block diffusion language models (BDLMs). We show empirically and analytically that these models are naturally more aligned with left-to-right decoding than MDMs. Based on this observation, we propose Parallel Autoregressive Decoding (PARD), a simple training-free sampling method that preserves left-to-right unmasking structure while allowing parallel token commitment. Extensive experiments show that PARD consistently outperforms existing parallel samplers in generation quality, while achieving substantial speedups over pure AR decoding with only a small quality gap.

AI.title_translation: 重新思考块扩散语言模型的生成顺序
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种名为PARD的无训练采样方法，利用块扩散语言模型的从左到右解码特性，实现了高质量且快速的并行文本生成。
AI.motivation: 现有的扩散语言模型采样方法大多针对早期的掩码扩散模型（MDMs）设计，忽略了近期块扩散语言模型（BDLMs）天然更倾向于从左到右解码的特性。
AI.method: 提出了并行自回归解码（PARD），这是一种无需训练的采样方法，能够保持从左到右的去掩码结构，同时允许并行提交Token。
AI.result: 实验表明，PARD在生成质量上一致优于现有的并行采样器，并且在保持很小质量差距的同时，比纯自回归解码实现了大幅加速。
AI.conclusion: PARD方法成功对齐了块扩散语言模型的从左到右解码特性，在生成质量和推理速度之间取得了极佳的平衡。
AI.translation: 扩散语言模型支持灵活的任意顺序生成，但现有的采样方法大多是为早期的掩码扩散模型（MDMs）设计的。在这项工作中，我们研究了近期块扩散语言模型（BDLMs）的采样问题。我们通过实验和分析表明，这些模型比MDMs天然更契合从左到右的解码方式。基于这一观察，我们提出了并行自回归解码（PARD），这是一种简单且无需训练的采样方法，它在保持从左到右去掩码结构的同时，允许并行提交Token。大量的实验表明，PARD在生成质量上一直优于现有的并行采样器，同时在与纯自回归解码相比只有很小质量差距的情况下实现了大幅加速。
AI.summary: 本文研究了块扩散语言模型的采样顺序问题，发现其天然契合从左到右解码。为此，作者提出了无需训练的并行自回归解码（PARD）方法，在提升生成质量的同时实现了显著加速。
AI.keywords: 扩散语言模型, 生成顺序, 块扩散, 并行自回归解码, 采样方法
AI.comments: 该论文对块扩散语言模型（BDLMs）的生成顺序进行了重新思考，提出了一种简单且无需训练的并行自回归解码（PARD）方法。这克服了传统掩码扩散模型（MDMs）采样方法的局限性，在保证生成质量的同时实现了显著的加速，具有很高的实用价值和理论洞察。

title: CONSISTRE: A Unified Consistency-Aware Framework for Document-Level Relation Extraction with Large Language Models
comments: 13 pages, 2 figures. Submitted to IEEE/ACM Transactions on Audio, Speech, and Language Processing
summary: Document-level relation extraction (DocRE) aims to extract relations among multiple entities across extended contexts while maintaining consistency across predicted triples. Although large language models (LLMs) show remarkable reasoning capabilities in information extraction, their predictions are typically generated independently for each candidate triple and may violate fundamental relational constraints such as transitivity, symmetry, and functional uniqueness, leading to contradictory and unreliable outputs. We propose CONSISTRE, a unified consistency-aware framework for DocRE that addresses this limitation through two complementary tracks. The first operates at inference time for black-box LLMs, combining constraint-aware prompting, constraint-based verification, and iterative self-reflection to refine predictions without task-specific fine-tuning. The second injects consistency knowledge into smaller open-source models via a knowledge distillation and reinforcement learning pipeline: reasoning traces from a powerful teacher are distilled into a student via supervised fine-tuning, followed by GRPO alignment using a composite reward that jointly optimizes extraction performance and relational consistency. Together, the two tracks cover both API-accessible and locally deployable scenarios under a unified consistency formulation. Experiments on DocRED show that both tracks outperform their baselines, with the inference-time track achieving competitive F1 using off-the-shelf black-box LLMs and the training-time track substantially narrowing the gap between 7--8B open-source models and state-of-the-art proprietary LLMs at a fraction of their inference cost. Ablation studies confirm that explicit consistency modeling mitigates relational contradictions and enhances the reliability of LLM-based DocRE across both deployment paradigms.
comment: 13 pages, 2 figures. Submitted to IEEE/ACM Transactions on Audio, Speech, and Language Processing

title: Energy Constrained Hierarchical Underwater Monitoring via Local Multi-Agent RAG
comments: Contains 25 pages, 11 figures. To be submitted to Elsevier Ocean Engineering
summary: Marine life monitoring is limited by strict energy constraints, poor underwater connectivity, and the high cost of transmitting raw multimodal data from remote deployments. This paper proposes a low-consumption underwater monitoring architecture that combines always-on edge sensing with selective high-performance local reasoning. The system follows a hierarchical master--satellite design in which ultra-low-power MAX78000/MAX78002 microcontrollers continuously monitor visual and acoustic signals, while an NVIDIA Jetson Orin NX is activated only for scheduled processing, event-driven analysis, or researcher interaction. Once active, the Jetson executes a fully local multimodal pipeline for data ingestion, visual target extraction, embedding-based indexing, species identification, retrieval-augmented reasoning, and automated reporting. BioCLIP/OpenCLIP embeddings are used to organize mission data, marine taxonomic references, scientific documents, and operational metadata in local ChromaDB collections. A dedicated identification layer combines visual similarity search, centroid-based classification, and supervised classifiers to support adaptive species recognition. A LangChain-based multi-agent framework coordinates query routing, structured analysis, energy management, hardware reconfiguration, and report generation. The architecture is evaluated through visual and acoustic monitoring case studies. The proposed system bridges ultra-low-power continuous sensing with local multimodal intelligence, enabling underwater stations to produce structured, researcher-ready knowledge while compressing local data for flexible acoustic, optical, or satellite transmission, minimizing both energy use and communication overhead.

title: MEGA-CL: A Molecular Foundation Model for Generalizable ADMET Prediction through Graph External Attention and Contrastive Learning
summary: Predicting the absorption, distribution, metabolism, excretion and toxicity (ADMET) properties of small molecules remains a major challenge in drug discovery. Here, we present MEGA-CL, a foundation graph neural network framework for universal molecular ADMET prediction. MEGA-CL integrates self-supervised contrastive learning with a multi-head external attention mechanism and an enhanced message-passing architecture, enabling simultaneous modeling of local chemical substructures and global inter-graph relationships while mitigating over-smoothing effects commonly observed in deep graph networks. Across 13 benchmark datasets and 21 downstream ADMET tasks, MEGA-CL consistently outperforms state-of-the-art baseline models. In particular, the framework demonstrates robust performance on challenging regression tasks, including clearance (CL) and steady-state volume of distribution (VDss), while maintaining strong generalization ability in independent external validation. Clinically relevant predictive accuracy was achieved, with more than 75% of predictions falling within a 3-fold error range. In an external evaluation on 18 novel compounds derived from recently approved FDA drugs, over 50% of human liver microsome clearance (HLMC) predictions were within a 2-fold error range. To further assess its practical applicability, MEGA-CL was prospectively evaluated on three preclinical drug candidates using in vitro hepatic microsomal metabolism assays and CYP450 inhibition assays guided by model predictions. The predicted HLMC values for all candidates were within 2.5-fold of the experimentally measured values, and 73.3% of CYP450 inhibition endpoints (11/15) were correctly classified. These results demonstrate the potential of MEGA-CL as a generalizable framework for accelerating in silico ADMET evaluation and early-stage drug candidate optimization.

AI.title_translation: MEGA-CL：通过图外部注意力和对比学习实现通用ADMET预测的分子基础模型

title: A note on the motion representation and configuration update in time stepping schemes for the constrained rigid body
summary: The dynamics of a holonomically constrained rigid body can be modeled by Newton-Euler equations subjected to geometric constraints. This is frequently formulated as a differential-algebraic equation (DAE) system of index 1. Inmultibody system (MBS) dynamics it is common (1) to numerically solve this system by means of integration schemes for ordinary differential equations, and (2) to treat the rigid body motion on the direct product Lie group SO (3)R3, although rigid body motions form the semidirect product Lie group SE (3). It is has been observed that the constraint satisfaction depends on which Lie group is used as configuration space (c-space). In this paper the problem is considered from a geometric perspective. It is shown that the constraints are exactly satisfied by a numerical integration scheme if they define a subgroup of the c-space. The subgroups of SE (3) have a significance for modeling mechanical systems, including lower kinematic (Reuleaux) pairs and are implicitly used in MBS modeling. It is concluded that SE (3) is the appropriate cspace for numerical DAE modeling of a constrained rigid body. This result does not immediately apply to MBS, however.

AI.title_translation: 关于约束刚体时间步进格式中运动表示与构型更新的注记
AI.tldr: 本文证明了半直积李群SE(3)是约束刚体数值DAE建模的合适构型空间，因为其构型子群能够被数值积分格式精确满足。
AI.motivation: 在多体系统动力学中，通常将刚体运动视为直积李群SO(3)×R^3而非半直积李群SE(3)，并且已经观察到约束满足情况取决于所使用的构型空间。因此需要从几何视角深入研究这一问题。
AI.method: 从几何视角分析约束刚体动力学中的运动表示和构型更新，研究不同李群（SO(3)×R^3与SE(3)）作为构型空间对约束满足的影响。
AI.result: 证明了如果约束定义了构型空间的子群，则数值积分格式可以精确满足这些约束；SE(3)的子群对机械系统建模具有重要意义，因此SE(3)是约束刚体数值DAE建模的合适构型空间。
AI.conclusion: SE(3)是约束刚体数值DAE建模的合适构型空间，因为其子群能被数值积分格式精确满足，但这不能直接推广到一般多体系统。
AI.translation: 受几何约束的刚体动力学可以通过满足几何约束的牛顿-欧拉方程来建模。这通常被表述为指数1的微分-代数方程（DAE）系统。在多体系统（MBS）动力学中，通常（1）通过常微分方程的积分格式数值求解该系统，以及（2）将刚体运动视为直积李群SO(3)×R^3，尽管刚体运动形成的是半直积李群SE(3)。人们已经观察到，约束的满足取决于使用哪个李群作为构型空间（c-space）。在本文中，从几何角度考虑了这个问题。结果表明，如果约束定义了c-space的一个子群，那么数值积分格式可以精确满足约束。SE(3)的子群对机械系统建模具有重要意义，包括低副（Reuleaux对），并且在MBS建模中被隐式使用。结论是SE(3)是约束刚体数值DAE建模的合适c-space。然而，该结果不能立即应用于MBS。
AI.summary: 本文从几何视角研究了约束刚体时间步进格式中的运动表示与构型空间更新问题，证明了当约束定义为构型空间的子群时数值格式可精确满足约束，并得出SE(3)是约束刚体数值DAE建模的最适构型空间的结论。
AI.keywords: 刚体动力学, 李群, 微分代数方程, 几何积分, 约束满足
AI.comments: 该论文从几何视角探讨了刚体动力学中时间步进格式的构型更新和运动表示问题，指出使用SE(3)作为构型空间对满足约束条件具有重要意义，对多体系统数值建模有很好的理论启发。

title: The Convergence and Error Analysis of Coordinate Descent Methods with Compression for Full Configuration Interaction
summary: We study the effect of compression in Coordinate Descent Full Configuration Interaction (CDFCI) within an unconstrained optimization formulation of the full configuration interaction ground-state problem. Under suitable local assumptions, we prove that the compressed iteration converges linearly to the solution of an associated restricted problem. We also characterize the convergence point of the compressed algorithm. Under an additional exponential decay assumption on the target eigenvector, we show that the resulting eigenvalue error is of order $τ^2$, where $τ$ denotes the compression threshold. Numerical results support the analysis.

AI.title_translation: 全构型相互作用下带压缩的坐标下降方法的收敛性与误差分析
AI.tldr: 本文研究了带压缩的坐标下降全构型相互作用（CDFCI）算法，证明了其线性收敛性并推导出了平方阶的特征值误差边界。
AI.motivation: 为了探究在全构型相互作用坐标下降法（CDFCI）中引入压缩算子的效果，以优化大规模量子化学计算中的性能并理论上保证其收敛性与误差边界。
AI.method: 将全构型相互作用基态问题转化为无约束优化公式，并在适当的局部假设下研究带有压缩的坐标下降迭代，结合目标特征向量的指数衰减假设进行收敛性与误差界推导。
AI.result: 证明了压缩迭代能够线性收敛到相关受限问题的解，刻画了压缩算法的收敛点，并在目标特征向量具有指数衰减假设下，证明了特征值误差阶数为压缩阈值 $\tau$ 的平方（$\tau^2$），数值结果支持了理论分析。
AI.conclusion: 本文证明了带有压缩的坐标下降全构型相互作用方法（CDFCI）的线性收敛性，并阐明了特征值误差与压缩阈值之间的平方阶关系，数值实验验证了理论分析的正确性。
AI.translation: 我们研究了全构型相互作用基态问题的无约束优化公式中，坐标下降全构型相互作用（CDFCI）算法中压缩算子的影响。在适当的局部假设下，我们证明了压缩迭代线性收敛到相关受限问题的解，并刻画了压缩算法的收敛点。在目标特征向量满足额外指数衰减假设的前提下，我们表明所得到的特征值误差阶数达到 $\tau^2$，其中 $\tau$ 表示压缩阈值。数值结果支持了上述分析。
AI.summary: 本文研究了全构型相互作用坐标下降法（CDFCI）中压缩算子的影响，通过将其转化为无约束优化问题，证明了压缩迭代的线性收敛性，并推导得出特征值误差为压缩阈值平方阶的结论。
AI.keywords: Coordinate Descent, Full Configuration Interaction, Compression, Convergence Analysis, Error Analysis
AI.comments: 本文研究了在全构型相互作用基态问题中引入压缩算子的坐标下降方法，通过严谨的收敛性和误差分析，证明了压缩迭代的线性收敛性以及特征值误差与压缩阈值的平方阶关系，为大规模量子化学计算中的算法加速与压缩策略提供了理论支撑。

title: Continual-RL for Generalization in Autonomous Racing on the RoboRacer Platform
summary: A key challenge in modern robotics is to adapt to changing environments, a challenge that is exacerbated when simulations cannot encompass every possible real-world configuration, and therefore Reinforcement Learning (RL) in the physical world becomes necessary. Continual Reinforcement Learning provides the tools to address this challenge; however, both the frameworks and the methods remain underexplored. Autonomous Racing and in particular the RoboRacer competition provide a testing ground for such methods, as learning to drive on a new track-floor combination with the least amount of new experience naturally frames a continual learning problem. This work tries to address this gap by proposing a continual RL framework based on Continual Backpropagation that is able, with only real-world data, to train a generalistic policy on a set of tracks and then fine- tune it within 15 minutes to outperform classical controllers. Furthermore, a comparison method based on offline RL is proposed, and a simulation analysis of the plasticity properties of the methods is conducted.

AI.title_translation: 基于RoboRacer平台的自主赛车泛化持续强化学习
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于持续反向传播的持续强化学习框架，仅用真实世界数据即可在15分钟内让自动驾驶赛车适应新赛道并超越传统控制器。
AI.motivation: 现代机器人技术难以适应不断变化的环境，仿真无法涵盖所有真实世界配置，因此必须在物理世界中应用强化学习，而持续强化学习是解决该挑战的重要工具，但相关框架和方法仍未充分探索。
AI.method: 提出基于持续反向传播（Continual Backpropagation）的持续强化学习框架，仅使用真实世界数据在多条赛道上训练泛化策略，并与基于离线强化学习的方法进行对比分析。
AI.result: 该框架能够在15分钟内对新赛道和地面组合进行微调，并超越传统控制器的表现。
AI.conclusion: 提出的持续强化学习框架能够在真实世界中实现高效的轨道泛化和微调，性能优于传统控制器。
AI.translation: 现代机器人技术面临的一个关键挑战是适应不断变化的环境，当仿真无法涵盖每一种可能的现实世界配置时，这一挑战会加剧，因此在物理世界中进行强化学习变得必不可少。持续强化学习（Continual Reinforcement Learning）提供了应对这一挑战的工具；然而，相关的框架和方法仍未得到充分探索。自主赛车，尤其是RoboRacer比赛，为此类方法提供了一个试验场，因为在最少的新经验下学会适应新的赛道-地面组合，自然构成了一个持续学习问题。本工作旨在填补这一空白，提出了一种基于持续反向传播（Continual Backpropagation）的持续强化学习框架。该框架仅使用真实世界数据，即可在一组赛道上训练出一个通用策略，并在15分钟内对其进行微调，从而超越传统控制器。此外，提出了一种基于离线强化学习的对比方法，并对这些方法的塑性（plasticity）属性进行了仿真分析。
AI.summary: 该论文针对自主赛车中的环境适应和泛化难题，在RoboRacer平台上提出了一种基于持续反向传播的持续强化学习框架，能够仅利用真实世界数据在短时间内实现策略的高效微调并超越传统控制器。
AI.keywords: 持续强化学习, 自主赛车, 机器人, 泛化能力, 真实世界数据
AI.comments: 该论文聚焦于具挑战性的自主赛车领域，创新性地提出结合持续反向传播的持续强化学习框架，无需仿真直接利用真实世界数据进行高效微调，展现了良好的泛化能力和实用价值。

title: Fifth-order finite volume derivative-based Hermite WENO scheme with unified stencils for hyperbolic conservation laws
summary: In this paper, we propose a derivative-based finite volume Hermite WENO (HWENO) scheme for hyperbolic conservation laws, where both the solution and its first-order derivatives are evolved in time and utilized in spatial reconstructions. The key challenge for solving hyperbolic conservation laws is the possible emergence of discontinuities in the numerical solutions. When facing discontinuities, the derivatives can become excessively large, which may compromise the robustness of HWENO schemes. In the first HWENO scheme, different sets of stencils were adopted for reconstructing the governing equation and the derivative equation, respectively, aiming to reduce the influence of the derivatives while preserving high-order accuracy. However, this approach not only substantially increases computational cost but also introduces considerable algorithmic complexity. To overcome these limitations, we exclude the information of the target cell's derivatives from spatial reconstructions, while employing the same reconstructed polynomial during temporal evolution to limit the derivatives. This strategy enhances the robustness of traditional HWENO schemes and allows unified stencils within the derivative-based HWENO framework. Furthermore, the proposed scheme supports arbitrary positive linear weights that sum to one and maintains a compact stencil. Numerical results demonstrate the high-order accuracy, efficiency, high resolution, and robustness of the proposed HWENO scheme.

AI.title_translation: 针对双曲守恒律的具有统一模板的五阶有限体积导数型Hermite WENO格式
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种高效且鲁棒的五阶有限体积导数型Hermite WENO格式，通过简化策略实现了统一的重建模板。
AI.motivation: 传统的基于导数的HWENO格式在处理导数方程和控制方程时采用不同的模板，导致计算成本大幅增加且算法复杂度高，并且在间断处导数过大容易损害格式的鲁棒性。
AI.method: 在空间重建中排除了目标细胞的导数信息，并在时间演化过程中采用相同的重建多项式来限制导数，从而支持统一模板和任意正线性权重。
AI.result: 数值结果表明，所提出的HWENO格式具有高阶精度、高效率、高分辨率和良好的鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 提出了一种用于双曲守恒律的统一模板五阶有限体积导数型HWENO格式，具有高精度、高分辨率、高鲁棒性以及更低的计算复杂度。
AI.translation: 在本文中，我们针对双曲守恒律提出了一种基于导数的有限体积Hermite WENO（HWENO）格式，其中解及其一阶导数均在时间上进行演化并用于空间重建。求解双曲守恒律的关键挑战在于数值解中可能出现间断。面对间断时，导数可能会变得过大，从而危及HWENO格式的鲁棒性。在早期的HWENO格式中，为了减少导数的影响并保持高阶精度，分别采用了不同的模板来重建控制方程和导数方程。然而，这种方法不仅大大增加了计算成本，还引入了相当大的算法复杂性。为了克服这些局限性，我们从空间重建中排除了目标细胞导数的的信息，同时在时间演化过程中采用相同的重建多项式来限制导数。这一策略增强了传统HWENO格式的鲁棒性，并允许在基于导数的HWENO框架内使用统一的模板。此外，所提出的格式支持和为一的任意正线性权重，并保持紧凑的模板。数值结果证明了所提出的HWENO格式的高阶精度、效率、高分辨率和鲁棒性。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种用于双曲守恒律的五阶有限体积导数型Hermite WENO格式。通过在空间重建中排除目标细胞导数信息并在时间演化中应用统一的重建多项式，该方法克服了传统HWENO格式计算成本高和算法复杂的缺点，同时增强了鲁棒性并支持统一模板。
AI.keywords: Hermite WENO格式, 双曲守恒律, 有限体积法, 统一模板, 高分辨率格式
AI.comments: 该论文通过简化传统HWENO格式中针对导数和原方程采用不同模板的复杂做法，成功提出了使用统一模板的五阶有限体积基于导数的Hermite WENO格式，在保证高分辨率和精度的同时显著提升了计算效率和鲁棒性。

title: DynaCalKV: Key-Value Cache Compression via Head Grouping and Adaptive Rank Allocation
summary: As the inference phase of Large Language Models (LLMs) requires handling long context windows, the Key-Value (KV) cache initially appears to address this challenge but eventually becomes a significant bottleneck as the context window continues to grow. Low-rank compression has recently been studied as an effective approach to reduce KV cache memory while maintaining model performance. However, only a few existing methods treat the Key and Value caches differently, despite their distinct roles. Moreover, these methods typically employ fixed attention-head grouping, which may not fully exploit the structural similarity among attention heads. In this paper, we propose an improved low-rank KV cache compression framework. For the Key cache, we dynamically group attention heads based on Centered Kernel Alignment (CKA) similarity and allocate the rank budget adaptively under a parameter budget. For the Value cache, we adopt the same approach as ReCalKV, refining the low-rank decomposition through offline calibration to improve reconstruction quality. Experimental results on three instruction-tuned LLMs show that our method reduces the number of Key cache parameters while maintaining competitive accuracy. We further observe that the proposed strategy is particularly effective for Multi-Head Attention (MHA) models, whereas it should be applied more conservatively to Grouped-Query Attention (GQA) models, especially in long-context settings.

AI.title_translation: DynaCalKV：通过头分组与自适应秩分配进行键值缓存压缩
AI.tldr: DynaCalKV通过动态分组和自适应秩分配压缩大语言模型的Key-Value缓存，有效缓解了长上下文推理的内存瓶颈。
AI.motivation: 随着大语言模型上下文窗口的增长，KV缓存成为内存瓶颈。现有的低秩压缩方法往往忽略了Key和Value缓存的不同角色，且多采用固定的注意力头分组，未能充分利用头之间的结构相似性。
AI.method: 提出DynaCalKV框架，对Key缓存基于中心核对齐(CKA)相似度动态分组注意力头，并在参数预算下自适应分配秩；对Value缓存采用类似ReCalKV的方法，通过离线校准改进低秩分解。
AI.result: 在三个指令微调的大语言模型上的实验表明，该方法在保持竞争力的准确率的同时，有效减少了Key缓存的参数数量；同时发现该策略对多头注意力（MHA）模型特别有效，而对分组查询注意力（GQA）模型需更保守地应用。
AI.conclusion: DynaCalKV通过动态头分组和自适应秩分配，有效降低了LLM推理过程中的Key缓存内存占用，同时在指令微调模型上保持了具有竞争力的准确率。该方法在MHA模型上表现尤为出色，但在GQA模型上需要更保守地应用。
AI.translation: 随着大语言模型（LLM）的推理阶段需要处理长上下文窗口，键值（KV）缓存最初似乎解决了这一挑战，但随着上下文窗口持续增长，它最终成为了一个重大的瓶颈。低rank（低秩）压缩最近被作为一种有效的方法来减少KV缓存内存，同时保持模型性能。然而，现有的少数方法很少区分Key和Value缓存的不同作用，尽管它们扮演着不同的角色。此外，这些方法通常采用固定的注意力头分组，这可能无法充分利用注意力头之间的结构相似性。在本文中，我们提出了一种改进的低秩KV缓存压缩框架。对于Key缓存，我们根据中心核对齐（CKA）相似度动态对注意力头进行分组，并在参数预算下自适应地分配秩预算。对于Value缓存，我们采用与ReCalKV相同的方法，通过离线校准精炼低秩分解以提高重建质量。在三个指令微调LLM上的实验结果表明，我们的方法在保持具有竞争力的准确率的同时，减少了Key缓存参数的数量。我们进一步观察到，所提出的策略对多头注意力（MHA）模型特别有效，而在长上下文设置中，对分组查询注意力（GQA）模型则应更保守地应用。
AI.summary: DynaCalKV是一种用于大语言模型推理的KV缓存压缩框架，通过基于CKA相似度的Key缓存动态头分组与自适应秩分配，结合Value缓存的离线校准优化，在减少内存占用的同时维持了模型性能。
AI.keywords: 大语言模型, Key-Value缓存压缩, 低秩近似, 注意力头分组, 自适应秩分配
AI.comments: 本文针对大语言模型推理阶段KV缓存占用过大的问题，提出了一种基于头分组和自适应秩分配的低秩压缩框架（DynaCalKV）。其创新点在于区分了Key和Value缓存的不同作用，利用CKA相似度动态分组Key缓存的注意力头，并自适应分配秩；同时结合了现有离线校准方法优化Value缓存。实验表明该方法在保持准确率的同时有效减小了参数量，对多头注意力（MHA）模型效果显著。

title: Cross-Attention Calibrated Deduplication for Retrieval-Augmented Generation System
summary: Common chunking strategies in Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems often create redundant chunks. These redundant chunks make the vector database bigger and slow down retrieval. A common fix is cosine-similarity thresholding. This method reduces each chunk to a single vector, then compares vectors using a similarity score. But a single vector can lose the fine-grained, token-level detail needed to tell a true duplicate apart from a chunk that just shares the same topic. We propose Cross-Attention Calibrated Deduplication (CACD). CACD checks each new chunk against an in-memory pool of chunks already kept, using a cross-encoder instead of a single pooled vector. This keeps token-level detail all the way to the final comparison. CACD combines three parts: the cross-encoder comparison itself, a New Information Score (NIS) that measures how much of a chunk is not explained by a candidate already kept, and a majority vote across several candidates rather than a single best match. NIS is calculated from the attention entropy of the cross-encoder. We tested CACD against five existing filtering methods, nine chunking strategies, and 18 configurations, all on the full SQuAD 1.1 validation set. In our experiments, CACD removes 9.75% of chunks on average. This drop rate is close to other semantic-level methods, and much higher than exact-match filters, which barely remove anything. In these experiments, CACD also processes each configuration in 51.0 seconds on average, about 27% faster than the strongest baseline, NERExact (69.6s), and about 7x faster than cosine-similarity filtering (356.7s). These results come from a single dataset, so we present them as an early comparison, not a general claim. Code for the baseline evaluation and for CACD is available at https://github.com/lehuyphuong/rag_bench and https://github.com/lehuyphuong/cacd_dedup.

AI.title_translation: 面向检索增强生成系统的跨注意力校准去重方法
AI.tldr: 提出了一种名为CACD的RAG系统去重方法，利用交叉编码器和新信息评分在保留细节的同时大幅提升去重效率和速度。
AI.motivation: RAG系统常见的文本分块策略会产生冗余块，导致向量数据库膨胀和检索变慢；而传统的余弦相似度阈值法将每个块简化为单一向量，会丢失区分真假重复所需的细粒度token级细节。
AI.method: 提出跨注意力校准去重（CACD）方法，使用交叉编码器代替单一池化向量进行细粒度比对，包含交叉编码器比对、基于注意力熵的新信息评分（NIS）以及多候选多数投票机制。
AI.result: 在SQuAD 1.1验证集上的实验表明，CACD平均去除9.75%的块，处理每个配置平均耗时51.0秒，比最强的基线方法快27%，比余弦相似度过滤快约7倍。
AI.conclusion: CACD通过交叉编码器和新信息评分（NIS）有效去除了RAG系统中的冗余文本块，在保持较高去重率的同时显著提升了处理速度。
AI.translation: 检索增强生成（RAG）系统中的常见分块策略经常会产生冗余的文本块。这些冗余块会使向量数据库变大并减慢检索速度。一个常见的解决方法是余弦相似度阈值法。该方法将每个块简化为一个向量，然后使用相似度分数对向量进行比较。但是，单个向量可能会丢失区分真正重复项与仅共享相同主题的块所需的细粒度、token级别的细节。我们提出了跨注意力校准去重（CACD）方法。CACD使用交叉编码器而不是单个池化向量，对照内存中已保留的块池检查每个新块。这使得token级别的细节一直保留到最后的比较。CACD结合了三个部分：交叉编码器比较本身、测量块中未被已保留候选块解释的大小的“新信息评分”（NIS），以及跨多个候选块（而非单个最佳匹配）的多数投票。NIS由交叉编码器的注意力熵计算得出。我们在SQuAD 1.1验证集的全部内容上，将CACD与五种现有过滤方法、九种分块策略以及18种配置进行了对比测试。在我们的实验中，CACD平均删除了9.75%的块。这一丢弃率与其他语义级方法接近，远高于几乎无法删除任何内容的精确匹配过滤器。在这些实验中，CACD平均处理每个配置耗时51.0秒，比最强的基线NERExact（69.6秒）快约27%，比余弦相似度过滤（356.7秒）快约7倍。这些结果来自单个数据集，因此我们将其视为早期比较，而非一般性声明。基准评估和CACD的代码可在https://github.com/lehuyphuong/rag_bench和https://github.com/lehuyphuong/cacd_dedup获取。
AI.summary: 论文针对RAG系统中的文本块冗余问题，提出了跨注意力校准去重（CACD）方法。CACD利用交叉编码器保留token级细节，并结合新信息评分（NIS）与多数投票机制，在提升去重效率的同时大幅加快了处理速度。
AI.keywords: Retrieval-Augmented Generation, Deduplication, Cross-Attention, Cross-Encoder, Vector Database
AI.comments: 该论文提出了一种新颖的跨注意力校准去重方法（CACD），用于解决检索增强生成（RAG）系统中的文本块冗余问题。通过结合交叉编码器、新信息评分（NIS）和多数投票机制，CACD在保留token级细节的同时，兼具高效的处理速度和良好的去重效果，为RAG系统的优化提供了有价值的参考。

title: Unequal Trips, Unequal Places: Diagnosing and Mitigating Delay Inequity in Autonomous Vehicle Fleet Coordination
summary: City-scale autonomous vehicle fleet coordinators are typically optimized for aggregate travel time, yet fleet averages conceal how delay is distributed across trips and regions. We conduct a distributional audit on three real-city road-network and taxi-demand datasets from Manhattan, Chicago, and San Francisco. The audit reveals pervasive trip-length inequity whose direction depends on the city and coordinator. After accounting for trip length, spatial inequity becomes more pronounced as demand grows and is consistently stronger when trips are grouped by origin rather than destination. These findings motivate SPatially Aware RErouting (SPARE), a budgeted online coordination framework that assigns limited replanning capacity to delayed vehicles and redirects them using recently observed waiting pressure. SPARE provides a per-review decision guarantee and explicitly bounds online route updates. Experiments on all three datasets against six representative baselines show that SPARE delivers the strongest joint efficiency-fairness performance while retaining city-scale scalability. The results demonstrate that bounded congestion-responsive rerouting improves performance and equity without full-fleet replanning.

AI.title_translation: 不平等的出行，不平等的地点：诊断与缓解自动驾驶车队协调中的延迟不平等
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种名为SPARE的自动驾驶车队在线重规划框架，通过有限的预算和空间感知重定向，有效解决了城市级车队调度中的行程与区域延迟不平等问题，实现了效率与公平的双赢。
AI.motivation: 传统的城市级自动驾驶车队协调器通常以总体旅行时间的最优化为目标，掩盖了延迟在不同行程和区域之间的不平等分布问题，缺乏对公平性的系统性诊断与缓解机制。
AI.method: 对曼哈顿、芝加哥和旧金山的真实城市路网及出行需求数据集进行了分布审计，并提出了SPatially Aware RErouting (SPARE)——一种预算化的在线协调框架，为延迟车辆分配有限的重新规划能力，并利用最近观察到的等待压力进行重定向。
AI.result: 审计揭示了普遍存在的行程长度不平等和空间不平等现象；基于三个数据集与六个代表性基准的实验表明，SPARE在保持城市级可扩展性的同时，实现了最强的效率与公平性综合性能。
AI.conclusion: 研究证明了有限制的、基于拥堵响应的路径重规划能够在不进行全车队重新规划的前提下，有效提升自动驾驶车队调度的性能与公平性。
AI.translation: 城市规模的自动驾驶车队协调器通常针对总体旅行时间进行优化，但车队平均值掩盖了延迟在行程和区域之间的分布情况。我们对曼哈顿、芝加哥和旧金山的三个真实城市道路网络和出租车需求数据集进行了分布式审计。审计揭示了普遍存在的行程长度不平等，其方向取决于城市和协调器。在考虑行程长度后，随着需求增长，空间不平等变得更加明显，并且当按起点而不是终点对行程进行分组时，这种不平等始终更强。这些发现促成了空间感知重路由（SPARE）的诞生，这是一个预算化的在线协调框架，它为延迟的车辆分配有限的重新规划能力，并使用最近观察到的等待压力重定向它们。SPARE提供了逐次审查的决策保证，并明确限制了在线路线更新。在三个数据集上针对六个代表性基准的实验表明，SPARE在保持城市规模可扩展性的同时，提供了最强的联合效率-公平性能。结果表明，受限的拥堵响应重路由在无需全车队重新规划的情况下改善了性能和公平性。
AI.summary: 该论文针对自动驾驶车队协调中的延迟不平等问题进行了分布审计，发现在不同城市和调度器下存在明显的行程长度与空间不平等。为此，作者提出了SPARE框架，利用有限的预算和等待压力进行在线重路由。实验表明，该方法在保证城市级可扩展性的同时，实现了效率和公平性的最优平衡。
AI.keywords: 自动驾驶车队, 路径规划, 延迟公平性, 空间公平性, 城市级调度
AI.comments: 该论文切中了当前自动驾驶车队调度中容易被忽视的公平性问题（如长短途和不同区域间的延迟不平等），并提出了一种创新且具备可扩展性的在线调度框架（SPARE），在保证系统效率的同时显著提升了公平性，具有较高的理论与实际应用价值。

title: Unsupervised Graph Representation Learning with Complementary View Alignment
summary: Unsupervised graph representation learning aims to derive meaningful node embeddings by capturing both structural and attribute information without relying on labeled data. Existing methods, such as GAEs, have demonstrated effectiveness but typically rely on message-passing mechanisms that assume homophily, leading to performance degradation on heterophilous graphs, where connected nodes exhibit dissimilar features. This homophily bias results in the loss of critical high-frequency components that are essential for identifying heterophilous patterns. To address these challenges, we propose \textsc{AlignGAE}, a novel extension of \textit{MaskGAE} that preserves the full frequency spectrum through complementary view alignment. Our framework introduces a dual-encoder architecture that separately processes structural and attribute information, incorporates node positional encoding to approximate Neighborhood Identity Distribution (NID), and employs dual reconstruction tasks for both edges and node attributes. We further propose theoretically grounded NID alignment strategies that ensure semantic consistency across views while preserving their distinct characteristics. Through comprehensive spectral analysis, we demonstrate that \textsc{AlignGAE} achieves optimal representation properties when the alignment loss converges. Extensive experiments across 12 benchmark datasets validate our approach, showing that \textsc{AlignGAE} outperforms state-of-the-art methods by up to 18.7\% on heterophilous graphs in node classification, while maintaining competitive performance on homophilous graphs. Our results establish a new paradigm for frequency-aware graph representation learning.

title: Gubernaut: A Deterministic Homeostatic Controller for Affect-Regulated LLM Agents, Validated Across Independent Model Families
comments: 26 pages, 7 figures, 3 tables. Data, transcripts, and analysis scripts: https://github.com/thegubernaut/Gubernaut_Validation Project page: https://gubernaut.com (archived at https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.21303518)
summary:
Large language model (LLM) agents inherit reactive failure modes: escalation under provocation, sycophantic drift under flattery, perseveration when stuck. These are failures of propensity, not capability; they concern what a model does under sustained pressure, which training-time alignment reduces but does not eliminate at runtime. This research led to the Gubernaut Cognitive Controller (GCC), a model-agnostic runtime control layer in a Nelson--Narens monitoring--control loop: an object level reads and writes text, while a deterministic meta level reads only the numeric telemetry {intensity, valence, repetition} and returns a regulating posture. Because the meta level ingests zero tokens, no injection channel to the controller exists by construction (an architectural property, not yet adversarially tested); the text-exposed arbiter's compliance is measured, not assumed. We evaluate the GCC with a pre-registered, generate-once/judge-many protocol across a 4x4 matrix of four frontier models (GPT-5.5, Claude Opus 4.8, Gemini 3.5 Flash, Grok 4.3), each serving as both a generator and a judge. The regulated arm is calmer in 13 of 16 cells at p<.05 and 15 of 16 by sign; the three sub-threshold cells, including a -0.04 null, all fall on the single near-saturated host. The effect survives a lineage-independent fourth judge family (xAI), strong evidence that it is no artifact of shared judge style. The clearest mechanism is the recovery signature: arousal that integrates under attack and then decays, valence-gated, on de-escalation, replicating across all four families. Transcripts and panels ship with SHA-256 provenance and are re-judgeable; five failure modes are pre-registered.
  No consciousness claims are made.
comment: 26 pages, 7 figures, 3 tables. Data, transcripts, and analysis scripts: https://github.com/thegubernaut/Gubernaut_Validation Project page: https://gubernaut.com (archived at https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.21303518)

AI.title_translation: Gubernaut：一种用于情感调节的LLM代理的确定性稳态控制器，已跨独立模型系列得到验证
AI.tldr: 本文开发了一种名为Gubernaut的确定性运行时控制器，通过元级数值遥测有效地减少了大语言模型代理在压力下的不良反应，并在多个模型系列中通过了严格验证。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型代理继承了反应性失效模式（如受挑衅升级、奉承导致谄媚漂移、卡住时固执），这些是运行时的倾向性问题，现有的训练时对齐无法在运行时彻底消除。
AI.method: 提出了Gubernaut认知控制器（GCC），这是一个基于纳尔逊-纳伦斯监控-控制循环的模型无关运行时控制层。对象级读写文本，而确定性的元级仅读取数值遥测数据（强度、效价、重复性）并返回调节姿态。
AI.result: 在四个前沿模型构成的4x4矩阵及独立第四方评判的评估中，受监管的一组在16个单元中有13个在p<.05水平上表现更平静（按符号计算为15个），证明了该控制器的有效性和鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: Gubernaut认知控制器（GCC）通过确定性的元级监控与控制循环，有效提升了LLM代理在复杂交互下的稳定性和抗压能力，且不依赖特定模型架构。
AI.translation: 大语言模型（LLM）代理继承了反应性失效模式：受挑衅时升级、受奉承时谄媚漂移、卡住时固执。这些是倾向性而非能力的失败；它们关乎模型在持续压力下做出的反应，训练时对齐减少了这种反应但在运行时未能消除。本研究开发了Gubernaut认知控制器（GCC），这是纳尔逊--纳伦斯监控--控制循环中一个与模型无关的运行时控制层：对象级读取和写入文本，而确定性的元级仅读取数值遥测数据{强度、效价、重复性}并返回调节姿态。由于元级不摄入任何代币，按结构设计不存在对控制器的注入通道（这是一个架构属性，尚未经过对抗性测试）；文本暴露仲裁器的依从性是被测量出来的，而非假设的。我们使用预注册的“生成一次/多次裁决”协议，跨由四个前沿模型（GPT-5.5、Claude Opus 4.8、Gemini 3.5 Flash、Grok 4.3）组成的4x4矩阵对GCC进行了评估，每个模型既充当生成器又充当裁判。受监管的一组在16个单元中的13个（p<.05）和符号检验的15个中表现得更平静；三个未达阈值的单元（包括一个-0.04的无效值）均落在单一接近饱和的主机上。这种效应在独立于血统的第四裁判家族（xAI）中得以存续，这强有力地证明了它不是共享裁判风格的产物。最清晰的机制是恢复特征：在受到攻击时积分并随后在降级时衰减的唤醒状态（受效价门控），这在所有四个家族中都得到了复制。抄本和面板附带SHA-256来源证明并且可重新裁决；五种失效模式已预注册。未提出意识主张。
AI.summary: 本文介绍了Gubernaut认知控制器（GCC），这是一种用于情感调节的大语言模型代理的确定性稳态控制器。它通过一个不接触文本的元级监控系统来调节模型的运行时行为，并在多个前沿模型系列中得到了验证，显著提升了代理在对抗性环境下的稳定性。
AI.keywords: 大语言模型代理, 情感调节, 运行时控制, 模型无关, 确定性机制
AI.comments: 本文提出了一种新颖的模型无关运行时控制层（GCC），通过确定性的元级情感调节机制，成功抑制了大语言模型代理在持续压力下的反应性失效模式。该研究采用了严格的预注册和多模型交叉验证方法，具有极高的可复现性和理论价值。

title: Simulating Tenant Responses to Energy Policy Interventions with Transaction-Cost-Aware LLM Age
summary: Recent studies use Large language models (LLMs) to simulate human opinions and decisions by prompting models with demographic, attitudinal, or persona-based descriptions. Yet such simulations rarely model the practical, cognitive, or social frictions that shape how people respond to policy interventions. Perceived transaction cost (PTC) provides a useful lens for modeling the practical frictions that shape policy responses, such as information burden, administrative effort, coordination demands, and perceived uncertainty. We use this lens to develop a friction-aware persona modeling approach for LLM-based simulation. In the context of energy-efficient renovation (EER), tenants are represented not only by who they are demographically, but by how they perceive the costs, benefits, barriers, and uncertainties associated with proposed renovation plans. Using survey data collected from 1,068 citizens in the Netherlands, comprising approximately 40,548 survey question and answer pairs, we compare prompt-only and fine-tuned settings across GPT-3.5-turbo, Ministral-8B-Instruct, and Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct, and evaluate supervised fine-tuning (SFT) and Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) for local open-weight models. Results show that incorporating PTC-based personas and reasoning consistently improves model performance across both prompt-only and fine-tuned settings, suggesting that PTC-based persona design provides a useful bridge between institutional policy theory and interpretable LLM-based policy simulation. Code is available at https://github.com/xiaweijie1996/socialagent.

AI.title_translation: 利用考虑交易成本的大模型智能体模拟租户对能源政策干预的反应
AI.tldr: 本研究将感知交易成本（PTC）引入大语言模型（LLM）模拟中，通过构建考虑实际政策摩擦的租户角色模型，显著提高了LLM模拟公众对能源效率改造政策反应的准确性。
AI.motivation: 现有的基于大语言模型的人类意见与决策模拟研究很少对人们对政策干预做出反应时所经历的实际、认知或社会摩擦进行建模，因此需要引入感知交易成本（PTC）来克服这一局限性。
AI.method: 开发了一种基于感知交易成本（PTC）的摩擦感知角色建模方法，结合提示词设置与微调设置（使用GPT-3.5-turbo、Ministral-8B-Instruct和Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct），并在开源模型上评估了监督微调（SFT）和群组相对策略优化（GRPO），使用来自荷兰1,068名公民的调查数据进行了验证。
AI.result: 研究结果表明，在提示词和微调设置下，结合基于PTC的角色和推理能够持续提高模型性能，证明了PTC基础角色设计在机构政策理论与可解释LLM政策模拟之间架起了有效的桥梁。
AI.conclusion: 引入感知交易成本（PTC）的基于角色的大模型模拟方法，能够显著提升LLM对租户在能源效率改造等政策干预下反应的模拟精度。
AI.translation: 近期的研究利用大语言模型（LLMs）通过提示模型输入人口统计、态度或基于角色的描述来模拟人类的意见和决策。然而，此类模拟很少对塑造人们如何对政策干预做出反应的实际、认知或社会摩擦进行建模。感知交易成本（PTC）为建模塑造政策反应的实际摩擦提供了一个有用的视角，例如信息负担、行政努力、协调要求和感知的不确定性。我们利用这一视角为基于LLM的模拟开发了一种感知摩擦的角色建模方法。在节能改造（EER）的背景下，租户不仅由其人口学身份来代表，还由他们如何看待拟议改造计划相关的成本、利益、障碍和不确定性来代表。利用从荷兰1,068名公民（包含约40,548个问答对）收集的调查数据，我们在GPT-3.5-turbo、Ministral-8B-Instruct和Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct上比较了纯提示（prompt-only）和微调（fine-tuned）设置，并评估了本地开源模型的监督微调（SFT）和群组相对策略优化（GRPO）。结果表明，在纯提示和微调设置下，结合基于PTC的角色和推理都能持续改进模型性能，这表明基于PTC的角色设计为制度政策理论与可解释的基于LLM的政策模拟之间提供了有用的桥梁。代码可通过https://github.com/xiaweijie1996/socialagent获取。
AI.summary: 该论文提出了一种结合感知交易成本（PTC）的摩擦感知大模型角色建模方法，用于模拟租户对能源效率改造等政策干预的反应。通过荷兰公民的调查数据进行多模型（GPT-3.5、Ministral、Llama等）评估，结果表明引入PTC能显著提升模型对政策反应的模拟准确性。
AI.keywords: 大语言模型, 感知交易成本, 政策模拟, 能源效率改造, 人类行为模拟
AI.comments: 该论文创新性地将心理学和政策学中的“感知交易成本”（PTC）概念引入大模型社会模拟中，通过构建考虑实际摩擦的Persona模型，提升了LLM模拟人类对政策干预反应的准确性，为弥合政策理论与大模型模拟之间的鸿沟提供了有价值的途径。

title: Beyond Aggregate Risk: Role-Stratified Conformal Risk Control for LLM Tool Calls
summary: Language-model agents act through structured tool calls whose arguments carry different risks. Untrusted content may safely influence an email body but should not determine a recipient, account, command, or credential. Existing statistical methods typically control risk over the entire action, allowing failures in rare, high-risk fields to be obscured by benign arguments. We introduce role-stratified per-field conformal risk control, a calibration layer that wraps any per-field detector and sets separate thresholds and risk budgets for semantic argument roles. For a role with prevalence $p_r$, aggregate-only certification must use an effective budget of $αp_r$ to guarantee role-specific risk $α$, whereas role-stratified calibration certifies each sufficiently sampled role directly with a finite-sample guarantee; rarer roles are handled by pooled certification. Across AgentDojo and InjecAgent with six language models, the empirical utility gap tracks this predicted price of coarseness, and our method achieves the most consistent role-specific budget compliance under model and attack transfer, detector noise, gradual drift, unseen tool suites, and adaptive attacks. It provides formal per-role guarantees under exchangeability or after recalibration, and empirical compliance under frozen distribution shift. These results suggest that structured tool calls should be certified at the semantic-role level, not the whole action.

AI.title_translation: 超越总体风险：面向大模型工具调用的角色分层保形风险控制
AI.tldr: 提出了一种面向大模型工具调用的角色分层保形风险控制方法，通过在语义角色层面进行细粒度风险认证，解决了传统总体控制中高危字段被掩盖的问题，显著提升了工具调用的安全性。
AI.motivation: 语言模型代理通过结构化工具调用执行动作，其参数具有不同的风险（例如邮件正文和收件人风险不同）。现有的统计方法通常对整个动作控制风险，导致稀有高风险字段中的失败被良性参数掩盖。
AI.method: 引入角色分层每字段保形风险控制（role-stratified per-field conformal risk control），这是一个包装任意每字段检测器的校准层，为语义参数角色设置单独的阈值和风险预算，对于稀有角色采用池化认证（pooled certification）。
AI.result: 在AgentDojo和InjecAgent数据集以及六个语言模型上的实验表明，该方法在模型和攻击转移、检测器噪声、渐进漂移、未见过的工具套件以及自适应攻击下，实现了最具一致性的角色特定预算合规性。
AI.conclusion: 结构化工具调用应当在语义角色层面进行认证，而非整个动作。角色分层保形风险控制能提供更严格的风险控制和更好的实用性。
AI.translation: 语言模型代理通过结构化工具调用进行操作，其调用的参数承载着不同的风险。不受信任的内容可以安全地影响电子邮件正文，但不应决定收件人、账户、命令或凭据。现有的统计方法通常对整个操作控制风险，这使得罕见高风险字段中的故障被良性参数所掩盖。我们引入了角色分层的每字段保形风险控制（role-stratified per-field conformal risk control），这是一种包装了任意每字段检测器的校准层，为语义参数角色设置了单独的阈值和风险预算。对于发生率为 $p_r$ 的角色，仅靠总体认证必须使用 $αp_r$ 的有效预算来保证特定角色的风险为 $α$，而角色分层校准则直接通过有限样本保证来认证每个充分采样的角色；更罕见的角色则通过池化认证来处理。在跨AgentDojo和InjecAgent数据集以及六个语言模型的实验中，实证效用差距追踪了这种预测的粗糙度代价，并且我们的方法在模型和攻击转移、检测器噪声、渐进漂移、未见过的工具套件以及自适应攻击下实现了最一致的角色特定预算合规性。它在可交换性下或重新校准后提供形式化的每角色保证，在冻结分布偏移下提供经验合规性。这些结果表明，结构化工具调用应该在语义角色级别进行认证，而不是针对整个操作。
AI.summary: 本文针对大语言模型工具调用中不同参数风险差异的问题，提出了一种角色分层的每字段保形风险控制方法。通过为不同语义角色设置独立的阈值和风险预算，并对稀有角色采用池化认证，该方法克服了传统总体风险控制的局限性，在多个基准测试中展现出卓越的理论保证、合规性和实用性。
AI.keywords: 大语言模型工具调用, 角色分层, 保形风险控制, 安全性, 鲁棒性
AI.comments: 该论文创新性地将保形风险控制（CRC）应用到大语言模型（LLM）工具调用的字段语义角色层面，解决了传统总体风险控制中高危字段风险被掩盖的问题。方法兼具理论保证和出色的鲁棒性，对提高LLM代理的安全性具有重要意义。

title: Perturbative-NeuSA: A Structured Spectral Framework for Time-Dependent PDEs
comments: 16 pages, 5 figures, 14 tables; supplementary material included
summary: Neural spectral PDE solvers often learn an entire unresolved vector field even when an inexpensive approximate model can already capture most of the trajectory. Here we introduce Perturbative-NeuSA, a residual formulation that decomposes the target solution into a low-fidelity background and a high-resolution perturbation, so that only the unresolved dynamics is learned. Starting from the exact perturbation equation, the method combines a fixed spectral operator, a background-dependent correction, the background defect in the target PDE, and an optional neural closure. This construction makes the roles of physical structure and neural closure separately measurable. Across 2D Burgers, Klein-Gordon, and heterogeneous 2D wave equations, the deterministic structured solver outperforms the trained NeuSA baseline while requiring no neural-network training. The largest gains occur on Burgers, where the deterministic correction reduces training and extrapolation errors by factors of 24 and 44, respectively. In addition, a Klein-Gordon sweep over seven background resolutions shows that the effect of the closure is conditional: it improves a poor background by 3.6 times, becomes neutral at intermediate resolutions, and degrades a well-resolved background. For the wave equation, however, the closure provides an additional 18% reduction when the remaining residual is interface-localized. Multi-initial-condition diagnostics further show that the useful closure regime depends on the initial-condition spectrum and can disappear in extrapolation when structured correction already captures the dominant Burgers dynamics. Perturbative-NeuSA therefore reframes neural closure as a conditional, diagnosable correction governed by background fidelity, residual organization, and compatibility with the closure model.
comment: 16 pages, 5 figures, 14 tables; supplementary material included

AI.title_translation: 微扰-NeuSA：用于时变偏微分方程的结构化谱框架
AI.tldr: 提出了一种用于时变偏微分方程的结构化谱框架Perturbative-NeuSA，无需神经网络训练即可通过微扰分解显著降低误差，并阐明了神经闭合的条件有效性。
AI.motivation: 现有的神经谱偏微分方程求解器通常会去学习整个未解析的向量字段，即使廉价的近似模型已经能够捕获大部分轨迹，这导致了效率低下。因此需要一个能明确分离物理结构和神经闭合的框架。
AI.method: 提出Perturbative-NeuSA残差公式，将目标解分解为低保真背景和高分辨率微扰，结合固定谱运算符、背景相关校正、目标PDE中的背景缺陷以及可选的神经闭合项。
AI.result: 在2D Burgers、Klein-Gordon和异构2D波动方程上，该确定性结构求解器在无需神经网络训练的情况下超越了训练好的NeuSA基线；例如在Burgers方程上，确定性校正将训练和外推误差分别降低了24倍和44倍。
AI.conclusion: Perturbative-NeuSA将神经闭合重新定义为一个受背景保真度、残差组织形式及与闭合模型相容性支配的条件性、可诊断的修正，为高效求解时变偏微分方程提供了新范式。
AI.translation: 神经网络谱偏微分方程求解器通常会学习整个未解析的向量场，即使廉价的近似模型已经可以捕获大部分轨迹。在此，我们引入了Perturbative-NeuSA，这是一种残差公式，它将目标解分解为一个低保真度的背景和一个高分辨率的微扰，从而只学习未解析的动力学。从精确的微扰方程出发，该方法结合了固定的谱算子、背景相关修正、目标PDE中的背景缺陷以及一个可选的神经闭合。这种结构使得物理结构和神经闭合的作用可以分别被测量。在2D Burgers、Klein-Gordon和异构2D波动方程中，确定性结构求解器在无需神经网络训练的情况下，其性能优于训练好的NeuSA基线。最大的收益出现在Burgers方程上，确定性修正将训练误差和外推误差分别降低了24倍和44倍。此外，对Klein-Gordon在七种背景分辨率下的扫描表明，闭合的效果是有条件的：它使较差的背景提高了3.6倍，在中等分辨率下表现中立，但在分辨率良好的背景下会使其恶化。然而，对于波动方程，当剩余残差是界面局域化时，闭合可额外提供18%的误差减少。多初始条件诊断进一步表明，有用的闭合机制取决于初始条件谱，并且当结构化修正已经捕获了主要的Burgers动力学时，它可能会在外推中消失。因此，Perturbative-NeuSA将神经闭合重新构想为一个受背景保真度、残差组织以及与闭合模型相容性支配的、有条件的、可诊断的修正。
AI.summary: 论文介绍了Perturbative-NeuSA，这是一种针对时变偏微分方程的结构化谱框架。它通过将解分解为低保真背景和微扰，仅对未解析的动力学进行建模。该方法在不需要神经网络训练的情况下优于现有基线，并展示了神经闭合在不同背景保真度下的条件有效性。
AI.keywords: 时变偏微分方程, 神经谱求解器, 微扰框架, 物理结构, 神经闭合
AI.comments: 该论文提出了一种创新的微扰谱框架（Perturbative-NeuSA），通过将目标解分解为低保真背景和高分辨率微扰，成功地将物理结构与神经闭合分开，并在多个偏微分方程任务中展现出卓越的性能和可解释性。

title: DeepFaith: Evidence-Grounded LLMs for Faithful Incident Reporting in Multi-Stage APT Defense
comments: This paper has been submitted to the IEEE International Conference on Network and Service Management (CNSM) 2026
summary: Advanced Persistent Threats (APTs) are difficult to detect and interpret due to their multi-stage and stealthy nature. While recent autonomous defense systems leverage provenance graphs and learning-based models for detection and mitigation, their outputs remain largely machine-oriented and difficult for analysts to interpret. Large language models (LLMs) offer a promising interface for report generation, but often produce hallucinated or weakly grounded content. In this paper, we propose DeepFaith, an evidence-grounded framework for faithful incident reporting in multi-stage APT defense. DeepFaith transforms structured outputs from autonomous defense and explainability modules into natural-language reports that are explicitly aligned with underlying system evidence. The framework integrates a unified evidence representation, evidence-grounded prompting, faithfulness-aware generation, and post-generation verification to ensure that all generated statements are supported. Experiments in a realistic enterprise testbed demonstrate that DeepFaith improves faithfulness from 0.68 to 0.92, reduces unsupported claims from 0.32 to 0.08, and increases temporal consistency from 0.6 to 0.88, while maintaining concise reports and lower error rates than existing template-based and LLM-based solutions. These results show that evidence-grounded generation enables reliable, interpretable, and actionable reporting for security operations centers.
comment: This paper has been submitted to the IEEE International Conference on Network and Service Management (CNSM) 2026

AI.title_translation: DeepFaith：基于证据支撑的大语言模型，用于多阶段APT防御中的忠实事件报告
AI.tldr: 本文提出了DeepFaith框架，通过引入证据支撑机制和验证流程，解决了大模型在APT攻击事件报告生成中的幻觉问题，显著提升了报告的真实性和可解释性。
AI.motivation: 虽然自主防御系统利用溯源图和学习模型来检测APT攻击，但其输出面向机器，难以被分析师理解；而大语言模型（LLMs）虽然能生成自然语言报告，但经常产生幻觉或缺乏足够的证据支撑，无法满足安全运维对真实性和可解释性的严格要求。
AI.method: 提出了DeepFaith框架，整合了统一证据表示（unified evidence representation）、基于证据的提示（evidence-grounded prompting）、忠实度感知生成（faithfulness-aware generation）以及生成后验证（post-generation verification），将防御模块的结构化输出转化为与底层系统证据严格对齐的自然语言报告。
AI.result: 在真实企业测试床上的实验表明，DeepFaith将报告忠实度从0.68提升至0.92，将无支撑声明从0.32降至0.08，时间一致性从0.6提升至0.88，同时保持了简洁的报告和更低的错误率。
AI.conclusion: DeepFaith通过证据支撑的生成与验证机制，有效解决了大语言模型在多阶段APT防御中生成事件报告时的幻觉问题，显著提高了报告的忠实度、时间一致性和准确性，是实现安全运营中心自动化、可解释报告的有效途径。
AI.translation: 高级持续性威胁（APT）由于其多阶段和隐蔽的特性，难以检测和解释。虽然近期的自主防御系统利用溯源图和基于学习的模型进行检测和缓解，但其输出大多面向机器，分析师难以解释。大语言模型（LLMs）为报告生成提供了一个有前景的接口，但通常会产生幻觉或弱支撑的内容。在本文中，我们提出了DeepFaith，一个用于多阶段APT防御中忠实事件报告的证据支撑框架。DeepFaith将自主防御和可解释性模块的结构化输出转换为与底层系统证据显式对齐的自然语言报告。该框架整合了统一证据表示、基于证据的提示、忠实度感知生成和生成后验证，以确保所有生成的陈述都有据可依。在一个真实的企业测试床上的实验表明，DeepFaith将忠实度从0.68提高到0.92，将无支撑的主张从0.32减少到0.08，并将时间一致性从0.6提高到0.88，同时保持了简洁的报告和比现有基于模板和基于LLM的解决方案更低的错误率。这些结果表明，基于证据的生成能够为安全运营中心实现可靠、可解释和可操作的报告。
AI.summary: DeepFaith是一个用于多阶段APT防御中生成可靠、忠实事件报告的证据支撑框架。它将自主防御系统的结构化输出转化为与底层证据对齐的自然语言报告，通过统一证据表示、证据驱动提示、忠实度感知生成和后生成验证，大幅减少了模型幻觉，提高了报告的忠实度和时间一致性。
AI.keywords: Advanced Persistent Threats, Large Language Models, Incident Reporting, Evidence-Grounded, Provenance Graphs
AI.comments: 该论文针对高级持续性威胁（APT）防御中大模型容易产生幻觉、缺乏可信度的问题，提出了DeepFaith框架。通过统一证据表示、基于证据的提示、忠实度感知生成和生成后验证，有效提升了报告的忠实度、时间一致性并减少了无支撑的主张，为安全运营中心（SOC）提供了可靠、可解释的事件报告方案，具有很高的实用价值。

title: Cyclic codes and cyclically covering subspaces
summary: A subspace of $\mathbb{F}_q^n$ is called cyclically covering if the union of $σ^i(U)$ can cover the whole space $\mathbb{F}_q^n$, where $σ$ is the cyclic shift, $0 \leqslant i \leqslant n-1$. Let $h_q(n)$ be the largest possible co-dimension of a cyclically covering subspace of $\mathbb{F}_q^n$. We show that $h_2(2p) = 2$ for every prime $p$ such that $2$ is a primitive root modulo $p$. By constacyclic codes, we show that $h_q((q-1)n) = 0$ when $h_q(n) = 0$ and $\gcd(n,q-1) = 1$. We also derive a lower bound on $h_q(n)$ by the concept of support weight distribution, which is important in coding theory. Finally, using irreducible cyclic codes, we present several families of $n$ such that $h_q(n) = 0$.

AI.title_translation: 循环码与循环覆盖子空间
AI.tldr: 本文结合编码理论研究了有限域上循环覆盖子空间的最大余维数，给出了多个精确解、界限及存在性结论。
AI.motivation: 研究有限域上循环覆盖子空间（其所有循环移位的并集能覆盖整个空间）的最大余维数及其与编码理论的关系。
AI.method: 利用constacyclic codes、支撑权重分布以及不可约循环码来分析循环覆盖子空间的最大余维数。
AI.result: 证明了对于满足特定条件的素数$p$有$h_2(2p)=2$；当$h_q(n)=0$且$\gcd(n,q-1)=1$时$h_q((q-1)n)=0$；利用支撑权重分布导出了下界；并给出了多类使$h_q(n)=0$的$n$族。
AI.conclusion: 本文通过代数编码理论的方法，研究了有限域上循环覆盖子空间的最大余维数，给出了特定条件下的精确值、一般递推规律以及下界。
AI.translation: $\mathbb{F}_q^n$ 的一个子空间被称为循环覆盖的，如果 $\sigma^i(U)$ 的并集可以覆盖整个空间 $\mathbb{F}_q^n$，其中 $\sigma$ 是循环移位，$0 \leqslant i \leqslant n-1$。设 $h_q(n)$ 为 $\mathbb{F}_q^n$ 的循环覆盖子空间的最大可能余维数。我们证明了对于每个满足 $2$ 是模 $p$ 的本原根的素数 $p$，有 $h_2(2p) = 2$。通过拟循环码（constacyclic codes），我们证明了当 $h_q(n) = 0$ 且 $\gcd(n,q-1) = 1$ 时，$h_q((q-1)n) = 0$。我们还通过编码理论中重要的支撑权重分布概念推导了 $h_q(n)$ 的一个下界。最后，利用不可约循环码，我们给出了若干使得 $h_q(n) = 0$ 的 $n$ 的族。
AI.summary: 本文研究了有限域上向量空间的循环覆盖子空间的最大余维数问题，建立了其与循环码、constacyclic codes以及支撑权重分布的联系，并给出了具体的理论结果、界限和值族。
AI.keywords: 循环码, 循环覆盖子空间, 支撑权重分布, 不可约循环码, 有限域
AI.comments: 该论文将编码理论（循环码和constacyclic codes）与线性空间的循环覆盖问题巧妙结合，通过支撑权重分布和不可约循环码推导了余维数的上下界，具有较强的理论创新性。

title: Retrieval-Augmented Large Language Models as Components of Cognitive Computing architecture for Regulatory Knowledge Management
summary: The aim of this article is to verify whether integrating large language models (LLMs) with the Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) architecture enables their transformation from standalone generative models into components of cognitive computing infrastructure with enhanced epistemic reliability. The study proposes an architectural approach based on locally deployed LLMs operating in on-premises environments without high-end GPU accelerators and examines their applicability in supporting regulatory management processes requiring continuous analysis and interpretation of legal acts. The proposed solution combines local LLMs with external knowledge repositories, creating a hybrid cognitive architecture in which the language model performs semantic interpretation while the RAG layer provides controlled knowledge retrieval, contextualization, and traceability of information sources. The implementation was validated using the Ollama and LM Studio execution environments together with the Polish language models Bielik and PLLuM running on consumer-class hardware. The results demonstrate that augmenting LLMs with RAG significantly improves the factual consistency, domain specificity and normative precision of generated texts while reducing the risk of unsupported content generation. Furthermore, the study shows that integrating RAG introduces auditability, controlled knowledge management and dynamic updating of regulatory information without retraining the language model. The findings indicate that locally deployed LLMs enhanced with RAG should be regarded not merely as text generation tools but as semantic processing modules within cognitive computing infrastructures supporting regulatory compliance and organizational decision-making in environments characterized by high legal and informational volatility.

AI.title_translation: 作为法规知识管理认知计算架构组件的检索增强大语言模型
AI.tldr: 通过将本地大语言模型与检索增强生成（RAG）架构相结合，构建出高效可靠的法规知识管理认知计算系统，在消费级硬件上实现了高精度和可审计的法规分析。
AI.motivation: 验证将大语言模型（LLM）与检索增强生成（RAG）架构相结合，是否能将其从独立的生成模型转变为具备更高认知可靠性、可审计性并适用于法规知识管理的认知计算基础设施组件。
AI.method: 提出了一种基于本地部署大语言模型（如波兰语模型Bielik和PLLuM）与RAG架构相结合的混合认知架构，使用Ollama和LM Studio等执行环境，在消费级硬件上进行验证。
AI.result: 结果表明，RAG增强的LLM显著提升了生成文本的事实一致性、领域特异性和规范精确性，减少了无根据内容的生成，并引入了可审计性、受控知识管理以及无需重新训练即可动态更新法规信息的能力。
AI.conclusion: 将本地部署的大语言模型与检索增强生成（RAG）架构相结合，可以有效将其转化为具备高度事实一致性、可审计性和领域精确性的认知计算组件，非常适合用于处理对合规要求极高的法规知识管理。
AI.translation: 本文的目的是验证将大语言模型（LLM）与检索增强生成（RAG）架构相结合，是否能使其从独立的生成模型转变为具备增强认知可靠性的认知计算基础设施组件。本研究提出了一种基于本地部署LLM（无需高端GPU加速器）的架构方法，并检验了其在支持需要持续分析和解释法律行为的法规管理流程中的适用性。所提出的解决方案将本地LLM与外部知识库相结合，创建了一个混合认知架构，其中语言模型执行语义解释，而RAG层提供受控的知识检索、语境化和信息源的可追溯性。该实现在消费级硬件上使用Ollama和LM Studio执行环境以及波兰语模型Bielik和PLLuM进行了验证。结果表明，用RAG增强LLM显著提高了生成文本的事实一致性、领域特异性和规范精确性，同时降低了生成不受支持的内容的风险。此外，研究表明，集成RAG引入了可审计性、受控的知识管理以及在无需重新训练语言模型的情况下动态更新法规信息的能力。研究结果表明，经RAG增强的本地部署LLM不应仅仅被视为文本生成工具，而应被视为支持法规合规和组织决策的认知计算基础设施中的语义处理模块，特别是在具有高法律和信息波动性的环境中。
AI.summary: 本文研究了将大语言模型与检索增强生成（RAG）架构相结合，构建本地部署的认知计算基础设施，以用于处理法规知识管理。研究表明，该混合架构在消费级硬件上运行有效，能够显著提升生成文本的准确性、可审计性和规范精确性，从而更好地支持合规和组织决策。
AI.keywords: Retrieval-Augmented Generation, Large Language Models, Cognitive Computing, Regulatory Knowledge Management, Local Deployment
AI.comments: 该论文创新性地探讨了如何在消费级硬件上利用本地部署的LLM结合RAG架构构建认知计算系统，用于处理复杂的法规知识管理，既保证了数据隐私和可审计性，又显著提升了生成文本的准确性和领域特异性。

title: PRISM: Prompt Refinement via Image-grounded Self-rewarding Mechanism for Text-to-Image Generation
summary: Text-to-image generation models can synthesize high-quality images from natural language descriptions, but their performance remains highly sensitive to prompt formulation. Existing prompt optimization methods mainly rely on text-side rewriting, prompt expansion, or external reward signals, offering limited image-grounded diagnosis and weak support for learning reusable optimisation policies. In this paper, we propose PRISM, a Prompt Refinement framework via Image-grounded Self-rewarding Mechanism. PRISM closes the prompt-image-feedback loop by interpreting generated images with structured visual diagnosis and scoring them along semantic consistency, aesthetic quality, and human preference alignment. It first initializes a unified VLM through multi-task supervised fine-tuning, and then improves the prompt policy via self-rewarding optimization with a hybrid ideal-point and Chebyshev reward. Extensive experiments show that PRISM improves holistic image quality and fine-grained semantic alignment, while providing interpretable feedback for targeted prompt refinement. The code is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/PRISM-FF81.

AI.title_translation: PRISM：基于图像基础自奖励机制的文本到图像生成提示词精炼方法
AI.tldr: PRISM是一个通过图像基础的自奖励机制和结构化视觉诊断来优化文生图提示词的框架，有效提升了生成图像的质量和语义一致性。
AI.motivation: 现有的提示词优化方法主要依赖于纯文本重写、提示词扩展或外部奖励信号，缺乏基于图像的底层诊断，且对学习可复用的优化策略支持较弱。
AI.method: 提出PRISM框架，首先通过多任务监督微调初始化统一的视觉语言模型（VLM），然后通过采用混合理想点和切比雪夫奖励的自奖励优化方法来改进提示词策略。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，PRISM能够全面提升图像质量和细粒度语义对齐，同时为有针对性的提示词精炼提供可解释的反馈。
AI.conclusion: PRISM通过构建基于图像基础的自奖励机制和结构化视觉诊断，有效解决了传统文生图提示词优化对文本端重写的依赖问题，提升了生成图像的质量与语义对齐能力。
AI.translation: 文本到图像生成模型可以从自然语言描述中合成高质量图像，但其性能对提示词的表述高度敏感。现有的提示词优化方法主要依赖于文本侧重写、提示词扩展或外部奖励信号，提供的基于图像的诊断有限，对学习可复用的优化策略支持薄弱。在本文中，我们提出了PRISM，一个通过图像基础自奖励机制进行提示词精炼的框架。PRISM通过对生成图像进行结构化的视觉诊断，并从语义一致性、美学质量以及人类偏好对齐三个维度对其进行打分，从而闭合了提示-图像-反馈循环。它首先通过多任务监督微调初始化一个统一的视觉语言模型（VLM），然后通过结合混合理想点和切比雪夫奖励的自奖励优化来改进提示词策略。大量实验表明，PRISM提高了整体图像质量和细粒度语义对齐，同时为有针对性的提示词精炼提供了可解释的反馈。代码已发布在 https://anonymous.4open.science/r/PRISM-FF81。
AI.summary: 该论文介绍了PRISM，一个通过图像基础自奖励机制进行提示词精炼的框架。PRISM通过结构化视觉诊断解释生成的图像，并从语义一致性、美学质量和人类偏好对齐三个维度对其进行评分，从而闭合了提示-图像-反馈循环。实验证明该方法在提升文生图质量和细粒度语义对齐方面表现优异。
AI.keywords: Text-to-Image Generation, Prompt Refinement, Self-rewarding Mechanism, Visual Diagnosis, Vision-Language Models
AI.comments: 该论文提出了一种创新的基于图像基础的自奖励提示词优化框架PRISM，通过闭环的图文反馈机制和结构化视觉诊断，显著提升了文生图模型的提示词优化能力和可解释性。

title: Are Prompt Optimizers Blind? Cross-Modal Visual Feedback for Automatic Prompt Optimization
summary: Automatic prompt optimization (APO) has been widely adopted to adapt vision-language models (VLMs) to downstream tasks without weight updates, yielding promising results. However, on multimodal tasks, the effectiveness of APO is fundamentally bottlenecked by a blind feedback channel: the optimizer reads the question, the prediction, and the gold answer, but never the input image on which the model failed, and therefore cannot diagnose visually grounded errors. As a remedy, we introduce Cross-Modal Visual Feedback (CMVF). CMVF incorporates (1) a failure-conditioned visual diagnosis stage, in which a stronger optimizer VLM inspects each failed image without access to predictions or labels, and (2) an error-aware aggregation stage that compresses these observations into reusable, task-level visual blind-spot patterns that drive the prompt rewrite. Crucially, the image is consumed only during optimization; the deployed artifact is an ordinary text prompt that runs at the same inference cost as any text-only baseline. Extensive results across 12 VQA datasets and 4 target VLMs demonstrate that CMVF consistently ranks first, improving over the strongest baseline on every target by 2.4 points on average, with gains of up to 6.5 points on individual benchmarks. Moreover, the optimizer self-organizes into expert-style visual checklists that transfer across models without re-optimization.

AI.title_translation: 提示词优化器是瞎的吗？用于自动提示优化的跨模态视觉反馈
AI.tldr: 本文提出了跨模态视觉反馈（CMVF）机制，解决了多模态提示优化中无法看到输入图像的“盲区”问题，显著提升了视觉语言模型在下游任务上的表现。
AI.motivation: 现有的自动提示优化（APO）方法在处理多模态任务时存在盲目的反馈通道，优化器无法看到输入图像，因此无法诊断视觉扎根错误，限制了模型性能。
AI.method: 提出跨模态视觉反馈（CMVF）方法，包含失败条件下的视觉诊断阶段（由优化器VLM检查失败图像）和误差感知聚合阶段（压缩观察结果为任务级视觉盲点模式以指导提示词重写）。
AI.result: 在12个VQA数据集和4个目标VLM上的广泛实验表明，CMVF始终排名第一，平均比最强基线提升2.4个百分点，个别基准上最高提升6.5个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 跨模态视觉反馈（CMVF）有效解决了自动提示优化在多模态任务中的视觉盲区问题，在12个VQA数据集上取得了显著的性能提升，且生成的文本提示具有良好的跨模型迁移能力。
AI.translation: 自动提示优化（APO）已被广泛用于使视觉语言模型（VLM）适应下游任务而无需更新权重，并取得了有前景的结果。然而，在多模态任务中，APO的有效性从根本上受到盲目反馈通道的瓶颈制约：优化器读取问题、预测和标准答案，但从不读取模型失败的输入图像，因此无法诊断基于视觉的错误。作为补救措施，我们引入了跨模态视觉反馈（CMVF）。CMVF包含（1）失败条件下的视觉诊断阶段，其中更强的优化器VLM在无法访问预测或标签的情况下检查每个失败的图像；（2）错误感知聚合阶段，将这些观察结果压缩为可重用的、任务级的视觉盲点模式，以驱动提示词重写。至关重要的是，图像仅在优化期间消耗；部署的产物是普通的文本提示，其运行推理成本与任何纯文本基线相同。在12个VQA数据集和4个目标VLM上的广泛结果表明，CMVF始终排名第一，在每个目标上比最强基线平均提高2.4个百分点，在单个基准测试中最高提高6.5个百分点。此外，优化器自组织成专家风格的视觉清单，无需重新优化即可跨模型迁移。
AI.summary: 本文针对多模态自动提示优化中缺乏视觉信息的问题，提出了跨模态视觉反馈（CMVF）方法。该方法通过引入失败图像的视觉诊断与聚合，使优化器能够修正视觉扎根错误，在保持推理成本不变的前提下显著提升了VLM在下游任务上的性能。
AI.keywords: 自动提示优化, 视觉语言模型, 跨模态视觉反馈, 视觉问答
AI.comments: 该论文针对多模态提示词优化中缺乏视觉反馈的痛点，提出了跨模态视觉反馈机制（CMVF），创新性地让优化器能够“看到”图像，从而诊断视觉扎根错误。这一方法不仅提升了下游任务性能，还保持了部署时的推理成本不变，具有很高的实用价值。

title: Universal Refinement without Interaction: Order-Optimal 1-Bit Mean Estimation
summary: This paper shows that interaction is unnecessary for order-optimal 1-bit mean estimation under finite central moments. For distributions satisfying $|\mathbb{E}X|\leqλ$ and $\mathbb{E}|X-\mathbb{E}X|^k\leqσ^k$ for a fixed $k>1$, we construct a fully non-adaptive public-coin protocol that fixes every measurable 1-bit query before communication. All localization and refinement queries are generated in a single batch; a subsequently decoded coarse center changes only how the stored refinement bits are interpreted. Two complementary constructions realize this decoder-side refinement: a finite dyadic scheme based on periodic residues and a continuous-scale scheme based on shifted random grids. Up to $k$-dependent constants, the refinement cost is $(σ/ε)^2\log(1/δ)$ for $k>2$, $(σ/ε)^2[1+\log(σ/ε)]\log(1/δ)$ for $k=2$, and $(σ/ε)^{k/(k-1)}\log(1/δ)$ for $1<k<2$. Together with the additive localization cost $1+\log(λ/σ)$, these rates answer the Lau--Scarlett open problem for arbitrary measurable 1-bit queries in the affirmative. In the parameter range covered by existing small-error, high-confidence lower bounds, the resulting sample complexity is minimax optimal.

AI.title_translation: 无需交互的通用精炼：阶数最优的1比特均值估计
AI.tldr: 本文证明了1比特均值估计不需要交互，并提出了达到极小极大最优的非自适应协议。
